zh: 她锻炼后要了一根蛋白棒来补充能量。

en: Many languages have Latin as their base.
zh: 许多语言都是以拉丁语为基础的。

en: You need the basic knowledge of IT to apply for this job.
zh: 申请这份工作你需要具备基本的信息技术知识。

en: Those baskets are full of fruits.
zh: 那些篮子装满水果。

en:
— Jack hurt his arms while playing basketball yesterday afternoon.
— I'm sorry to hear that.
zh:
——杰克昨天下午打篮球时把手臂弄伤了。
——听到这个消息我很难过。

en: She has a bath every day.
zh: 她每天洗澡。

en: My cat sometimes tries to drink water from the bath.
zh: 我的猫有时会试图喝浴缸里的水。

en: I like my bathroom.
zh: 我喜欢我的浴室。

en: Among all the laptops, this one has the best battery life.
zh: 在所有的笔记本电脑中，这一款的电池续航能力最佳。

en: Many soldiers died in the battle.
zh: 在这次战役中死了许多士兵。

en: I think he will be an astronaut.
zh: 我认为他会成为一名宇航员。

en: Congratulations! You've got a chance to be an exchange student.
zh: 祝贺你！你有机会成为一名交换学生。

en: What a sunny day it is today! Shall we have a picnic on the beach?
zh: 今天的天气多么晴朗啊！我们去海滩野餐好吗？

en: What a fierce bear it is!
zh: 多凶猛的熊啊！

en: The soldiers had to bear the extreme cold during their mission.
zh: 士兵们在执行任务时不得不忍受极端的寒冷。

en: The strong winds began to beat against the doors and windows.
zh: 强风开始拍打门窗。

en: Beat the mixture until it was smooth and creamy.
zh: 搅拌混合物直至丝滑的奶油状。

en: Bali is a beautiful place. It attracts a lot of tourists every year.
zh: 巴厘岛是一个美丽的地方。它每年都吸引很多游客。

en: The light music sounded very beautiful. I enjoyed every minute of it.
zh: 这首轻音乐很动听。我沉醉其中。

en: She sang beautifully while she was watching TV.
zh: 她一边看电视，一边优美地歌唱。

en: He was beginning to enjoy the beauties of nature.
zh: 他要开始享受大自然之美。

en: Please be brief because I am in a hurry.
zh: 请长话短说，因为我有急事。

en: The man is called “Wolf Dad” because of his cruel way of parenting.
zh: 那个人被称作“狼爸”是因为他残酷的养育方式。

en: When people get older, their short-term memory becomes worse.
zh: 当人老了的时候，他们的短期记忆会变差。

en: The students of Class Three became excited when they won the football match.
zh: 三班的学生赢得了这场足球赛，他们变得兴奋不已。

en: Although Peter is five years old, he is learning to make the bed by himself.
zh: 尽管彼得才 5 岁，他正在学习自己整理床铺。

en: Frank and Mary switch on the bedroom computer in the morning because they want to get the latest news.
zh: 弗兰克和玛丽一早就打开卧室的电脑，因为他们想得到最新消息。

en: Do you like stewed beef?
zh: 你喜欢吃炖牛肉吗？

en: My friend spent eighty yuan on the coat the day before yesterday.
zh: 前天我的朋友花了 80 元买这件外套。

en: Jack does exercise twice a day and he looks much healthier than before.
zh: 杰克一天做两次运动，他看起来比以前健康多了。

en: All the exercise books must be handed in before you leave school.
zh: 所有练习本都必须在放学前交上来。

en: He lives by begging.
zh: 他靠乞讨为生。

en: She wanted to know when the program would begin.
zh: 她想知道什么时候该方案将开始执行。

en: I have read the book from beginning to end.
zh: 我把这本书从头到尾看完了。

en: The students played a game at the beginning of the lesson.
zh: 学生在开始上课时做了游戏。

en: The teacher always tells his students to be on their best behaviour.
zh: 这位老师总是教导学生要展现他们最好的一面。

en: I am behind him in maths.
zh: 我数学不如他。

en: The car stopped so suddenly that the bus behind almost ran into it.
zh: 这辆汽车突然刹停，后面那辆公共汽车差点儿撞到它。

en: How long can a human being go without food?
zh: 人不吃东西能活多久？

en: That dishonest man often tells lies, and nobody believes him.
zh: 那个不诚实的人经常撒谎，没有人相信他。

en: Do you believe in the saying that honesty is the best policy?
zh: 你相信“诚实为上策”这句谚语吗？

en: There is a bell on the wall.
zh: 墙上有个钟。

en: Does this house belong to Mr. Winter?
zh: 这幢房子是属于温特先生的吗？

en: The keys belong in the drawer, not on the table.
zh: 钥匙应该在抽屉里，而不是在桌子上。

en: Please do not write below this line.
zh: 请不要写在这条线下面。

en: He buckled the safety belt when the plane was making a landing.
zh: 飞机降落时，他扣上了安全带。

en: There is a big tree beside me.
zh: 在我身旁有棵大树。

en: She has three cousins besides Eddie.
zh: 除了埃迪，她还有3个表兄弟。

en: Besides me, there are many other students present.
zh: 除了我，还有许多其他的学生出席。

en: I don't want to go. Besides, I'm too tired.
zh: 我不想去，再说我也太累了。

en: She is my best friend.
zh: 她是我最好的朋友。

en: The thing I liked best about the show was the music.
zh: 这场演出中我最喜欢的是音乐。

en: We offer only the best to our clients.
zh: 我们只提供最好的东西给顾客。

en: You must pay extra for a better seat.
zh: 你要坐更好的位子就得加钱。

en: Never mind, next time I'm sure you can do better.
zh: 不要紧，我相信你下次一定能做得更好。

en: You'd better go and see a doctor at once.
zh: 你最好马上去看医生。

en: We expect better of you in the future.
zh: 我们期待你将来有更好的表现。

en: Can you tell me the difference between these two words?
zh: 你能告诉我这两个单词之间的区别吗？

en: Six-month-old babies are not old enough to tell the difference between need and want.
zh: 6个月大的婴儿太小，无法区分需要和想要。
rewrite: Six-month-old babies are too young to tell the difference between need and want.

en: In my opinion, riding a bicycle will be more popular than driving a car in the future.
zh: 在我看来，未来骑自行车会比驾驶汽车更受欢迎。

en: Professor Lee gave us much advice on how to live a low carbon life in big cities.
zh: 关于如何在大城市低碳生活，李教授给了我们许多建议。

en: The suitcase is so big that they can't take it with them.
zh: 手提箱太大了，他们不能随身携带。

en: He never pays his bill on time.
zh: 他从不按时支付账单。

en: Please put the rubbish in the bin.
zh: 请把垃圾放到垃圾箱里去。

en: There are miles of grassland with no people, just trees and birds.
zh: 绵延数英里的草原上没有人，只有树和鸟。

en: My grandfather will celebrate his ninetieth birthday next month.
zh: 我的爷爷下个月将要庆祝他的九十大寿。

en: I got this nice present on my birthday.
zh: 我在生日那天收到了这个漂亮的礼物。

en: The children enjoy eating biscuits.
zh: 孩子们喜欢吃饼干。

en: Will you give me a bit of time?
zh: 你能给我一点时间吗？

en: Babies who are getting new teeth like something hard to bite on.
zh: 正在长牙齿的婴儿喜欢咬硬物。

en: The sandwich was so big that she could only manage to take small bites.
zh: 这个三明治太大了，她只能小口小口地吃。

en: Which colour do you prefer, black or white?
zh: 你更喜欢哪种颜色，黑色还是白色？

en: This black bag may be that driver's.
zh: 这个黑色的包可能是那个司机的。

en: Mary had to wear her glasses so that she could see the words on the blackboard clearly.
zh: 玛丽不得不戴上眼镜，这样她才能看清黑板上的字。

en: Please give me a blanket.
zh: 请给我一条毯子。

en: His father is blind.
zh: 他父亲是盲人。

en: Many apps today are designed to assist the blind with daily tasks.
zh: 如今，许多应用程序设计用来帮助盲人处理日常事务。

en: He lives in that block.
zh: 他住在那个街区。

en: Get back, don't block the traffic.
zh: 往后退，不要阻塞交通。

en: There is some blood in the glass.
zh: 玻璃杯里有些血。

en: In spring the wind blows gently. It makes us feel so comfortable.
zh: 春天里，风轻轻地吹。让我们感到很舒适。

en: The gas leak could blow the whole building into pieces if it catches fire.
zh: 如果燃气泄漏遇到明火，可能会把整栋楼炸成碎片。

en: A woman in blue walked into the store.
zh: 一位穿蓝色衣服的妇女走进商店。

en: He has a dark blue shirt on.
zh: 他穿了一件深蓝色衬衣。

en: Will you help me to take the size of the board?
zh: 帮我量一下这木板的尺寸好吗？

en: Passengers must board the ship before 6:00 p.m.
zh: 乘客必须在下午6点前上船。

en: He has his own boat.
zh: 他有他自己的小船。

en: They boated us across the bay.
zh: 他们划船把我们送过了海湾。

en: A balanced diet provides nutrition for your body.
zh: 均衡的饮食使你身体获得营养。

en: I always boil water in this kettle.
zh: 我总是用这个水壶烧水。

en: On the eighth page of the book, there is an encouraging story.
zh: 在这本书的第8页，有一个令人鼓舞的故事。

en:
— The musical Notre Dame de Paris is being staged in Shanghai Culture Square. Shall we book two tickets for the show?
— That's a good idea.
zh:
——音乐剧《巴黎圣母院》正在上海文化广场上演。我们去预订两张票好吗？
——好主意。

en: I got really bored because I had nothing to do.
zh: 我真的很无聊，因为无事可做。

en: Tom always tells us the same things whenever he meets. He is really boring.
zh: 每当汤姆见到我们，他总是告诉我们同样的事情。他真的很无聊。

en: Lucy and Linda are twins. They were born on the fourth of November.
zh: 露西和琳达是一对双胞胎。她们出生于 11 月 4 日。

en: This is a useful guidebook. I borrowed it from the school library.
zh: 这是一本有用的指导手册。我从学校图书馆借来的。

en: Do you know, he is the nicest boss I've had here.
zh: 你知道吗，他是我到这儿工作后遇到的最好的上司。

en: Both men were Italian.
zh: 两名男子都是意大利人。

en: Both of them are PLA men.
zh: 他们俩都是解放军战士。

en: Tourists can enjoy wonderful views on both sides of the Huangpu River.
zh: 游客可以欣赏黄浦江两岸的美妙景色。

en: Mary reads both entertainment and business news.
zh: 玛丽阅读娱乐和商业新闻。

en: How shall we deal with the waste paper, bottles and boxes?
zh: 我们应如何处理这些废纸、瓶子和包装盒呢？

en: Fill in your address at the bottom of the application form.
zh: 把你的地址填写在申请表下端。

en: He has a big bowl.
zh: 他有个大碗。

en: Mr. Smith bought three boxes of local snacks for the exchange students.
zh: 史密斯先生为交换生买了 3 盒当地小吃。

en: The boy collected some fallen leaves and made a nice artwork.
zh: 这个男孩收集了一些落叶，做成了一件漂亮的艺术品。

en: She has a good brain.
zh: 她头脑聪明。

en: We Chinese people are brave and industrious.
zh: 我们中国人是勇敢勤劳的。

en: Mark isn't feeling well now as he had too much bread just now.
zh: 马克现在觉得不太舒服，因为他刚才吃了太多的面包。

en: Little David hid all the broken pieces under the bed and denied breaking the vase with his basketball.
zh: 小戴维把所有的碎片都藏在床底，并否认他用篮球打破了花瓶。

en: Have a break.
zh: 休息一下。

en: You had better let John buy milk and bread for breakfast himself. He’s ten years old now.
zh: 早餐你最好让约翰自己去买牛奶和面包。他已经 10 岁了。

en: If you get nervous, take a deep breath to calm yourself down.
zh: 如果你感到紧张，就深呼吸让自己平静下来。

en: You had to listen hard to hear the old man breathe.
zh: 你要仔细听才能听见老人在呼吸。

en: The ancient Silk Road was a great success, like a bridge between East and West.
zh: 古代丝绸之路是一项伟大的成就，宛如连接东西方的桥梁。

en: The professor used humour to bridge the gap between complex theories and student understanding.
zh: 这位教授用幽默架起了桥梁，消除了复杂理论和学生理解间的隔阂。

en: What a bright idea!
zh: 好主意！

en: I will try my best to get a bright future.
zh: 我会尽我所能去创造一个光明的未来。

en: Will you bring your new book here? I’d like to have a look at it.
zh: 你能把你的新书带来吗？我想看一看。

en: He is from Britain.
zh: 他从英国来。

en: British people often begin their conversations by talking about the weather.
zh: 英国人经常以谈论天气来开始他们的谈话。

en: This is a traditional British cookery book.
zh: 这是一本传统英式烹饪书。

en: This role is played by seventeen-year-old Briton John Martin.
zh: 这个角色由 17 岁的英国人约翰·马丁扮演。

en: The radio station sets up an overseas broadcast program.
zh: 电台新设置了一个对外广播节目。

en: My brother likes drawing very much and his dream is to become an architect.
zh: 我的弟弟非常喜欢画画，他的梦想是成为一名建筑师。

en: In autumn the leaves change from green to brown.
zh: 秋天，树叶由绿色变为褐色。

en: Have you seen the man in the picture? He is thin and of average height with a brown jacket.
zh: 你见过照片上的人吗？他很瘦，中等身高，穿棕色夹克。

en: Have you brushed your teeth?
zh: 你刷牙了吗？

en: I have a brush.
zh: 我有一把刷子。

en: More underground railways will be built in Shanghai in the years to come.
zh: 未来几年上海将建造更多的地铁。

en: On the top of the building you can have a bird's eye view of the whole city.
zh: 在楼顶，你可以俯瞰整个城市。

en: Many buildings along the Bund in Shanghai were built in the 1920s or 1930s.
zh: 上海沿外滩的许多建筑建于20世纪二三十年代。

en: People used to burn an oil lamp to get light.
zh: 从前人们点油灯照明。

en: He asked the government to improve school bus safety.
zh: 他要求政府改善校车的安全。

en: I have two cell phones. One is for business; the other is for private matters.
zh: 我有两部手机。一部用于工作，另一部用于私人事务。

en: He was born to be a successful businessman.
zh: 他天生就是一个成功的商人。

en: My mum is busy making a pizza. She needs some help, doesn't she?
zh: 我妈妈正忙着做一个比萨饼。她需要一些帮助，不是吗？

en: Money is important, but it can’t buy everything.
zh: 钱很重要，但它不能买到一切。

en: The doctors tried their best to save the patient’s life, but failed.
zh: 医生们竭尽全力挽救患者的生命，但是失败了。

en: Add the butter last.
zh: 最后加上黄油。

en: Jenney’s father has a collection of beautiful butterflies.
zh: 詹尼的父亲收藏了许多美丽的蝴蝶。

en: There is a button on the wall.
zh: 墙上有一个按钮。

en: I bought a new flat in Puxi last year. It is on the ninth floor.
zh: 去年我在浦西买了一套新房子。这套房子在9楼。

en: If the prices come down in a few years, I will buy a car for myself.
zh: 几年后如果价格降下来，我会给自己买一辆车。

en: On a cold evening it is pleasant to sit by the fire.
zh: 在寒冷的夜晚坐在炉火旁边很舒服。

en: She should be back by now.
zh: 她现在应该回来了。

en: By the end of last term, the students of Class One had finished three projects.
zh: 到上学期末，1 班的学生完成了 3 个项目。

en: Tom is reading a 60-word composition. It was written all by himself.
zh: 汤姆正在读一篇 60 个字的作文。这篇作文是他本人写的。

en: Look up the word in the dictionary, and you’ll get the meaning by yourselves.
zh: 在词典里查查这个单词，你们会知道它的意思。

en: You can improve your spoken English by using it more and more.
zh: 英语说得越多，你就越能提高你的英语口语水平。

en: Are you going there by bike or by bus?
zh: 你骑车还是坐车去那里？

en: More and more people in Shanghai choose to go to work by underground.
zh: 在上海越来越多的人选择乘地铁上班。

en: I have to say good-bye to everybody.
zh: 我不得不和大家说再见了。

en: He grows cabbages on his farm.
zh: 他在自家农场里种卷心菜。

en: We went into the café for coffee and dessert yesterday.
zh: 昨天我们到咖啡馆喝了咖啡，吃了点心。

en: Mike’s mother bought him a big cake on his birthday.
zh: 迈克生日那天，他妈妈给他买了一个大蛋糕。

en: Please call me when you get home.
zh: 你到家时请给我打个电话。

en: Computers are super calculators, we usually call them electronic brains.
zh: 电脑是超级计算器，我们通常称它们为电子大脑。

en: Rafe Esquith is called the most interesting classroom teacher in the U.S.A.
zh: 雷夫·艾斯奎斯被称为美国最有趣的课堂老师。

en: The charity called for immediate action to help homeless pets.
zh: 该慈善机构呼吁立即采取行动帮助无家可归的宠物。

en: I gave him a phone call yesterday.
zh: 我昨天给他打电话了。

en: The sea is now calm.
zh: 海现在平静了。

en: I think everybody should just calm down.
zh: 我想每个人都应该冷静下来。

en: Now a camera does not cost much and most young people are certainly able to pay for it.
zh: 现在照相机花费不多，所以绝大多数年轻人都能买得起。

en: Shall we join in the Green World Summer Camp?
zh: 我们参加绿色世界夏令营好吗？

en: They brought all the necessary supplies to camp comfortably in the wilderness.
zh: 他们带了必要的物资，以便在野外能舒适地露营。

en: My son likes reading stories. Now he can tell a story as well as his sister.
zh: 我儿子喜欢阅读故事。现在，他的故事可以讲得和他姐姐一样好。

en: This can holds five litres of water.
zh: 这个容器可装 5 升水。

en: Canada has ten provinces.
zh: 加拿大有 10 个省。

en: My brother has studied in a university in Canada for three years. He will come back to China next week.
zh: 我哥哥在加拿大一所大学学习了 3 年。他将于下周回中国。

en: He went to Canada several years ago. Now he is a Canadian citizen.
zh: 几年前他去了加拿大。他现在是加拿大公民。

en: The Canadian won the championship in this event at the Olympics.
zh: 那位加拿大人赢得了奥运会这个项目的冠军。

en: We shouldn't hurry all the way to the airport, the flight was cancelled because of the foggy weather.
zh: 我们不应该急着去机场，因为有雾，航班被取消了。

en: Beijing is the capital of China.
zh: 北京是中国的首都。

en: The capital of Hainan Province is Haikou.
zh: 海南省的省会是海口。

en: Tom Zhu is a captain.
zh: 汤姆·朱是一位船长。

en: What terrible news it is! Three people died in the car accident.
zh: 多么可怕的消息！有3人在车祸中丧生。

en: A nice card was chosen for his mother by John on Mother's Day.
zh: 在母亲节，约翰为妈妈选了一张漂亮的贺卡。

en: Without great care, the old man's condition may become even worse.
zh: 如果不多加照料，这位老人的状况可能会变得更糟。

en: I don't care whether he comes or not.
zh: 我不介意他来不来。

en: Be careful while getting off the train. The ground is wet.
zh: 下车时要小心，地面是湿的。

en: Little Tom was sleeping while everybody else was listening to the teacher carefully.
zh: 小汤姆在睡觉，而其他人都在认真听老师讲课。

en: It's known to all that careless drivers are a danger to both themselves and others.
zh: 大家都知道，粗心的司机对自己和他人都是危险的。

en: I'll have some more carrots.
zh: 我还要一些胡萝卜。

en: Airplanes carry passengers.
zh: 飞机运送乘客。

en: Nowadays science fiction isn't as popular as cartoon among teenagers.
zh: 如今在青少年中，科幻小说不像漫画那样受欢迎。

en: It isn't the case.
zh: 情况不是这样的。

en: The case is so heavy that I can't move it out of the room alone.
zh: 这箱子太重了，我一个人没法把它从房间搬出去。
rewrite: The case is too heavy for me to move out of the room alone.

en: I love cats.
zh: 我爱猫。

en: He caught a huge fish.
zh: 他抓了一条大鱼。

en: If we want to catch that train, we'd better set off for the station right now.
zh: 如果想赶上那班火车，我们最好现在动身去车站。

en: Don't take off your coat, Tom! It's easy to catch cold in spring.
zh: 汤姆，别脱外套！春天很容易着凉。

en: These causes led to a bad result.
zh: 这些原因导致了不良后果。

en: Many people are passionate about environmental causes.
zh: 许多人对环境事业充满热情。

en: The child's headache may be caused by stress.
zh: 那孩子的头疼可能是紧张引起的。

en: They put the food at the entrance to the cave.
zh: 他们把食物放在洞口。

en: How did you celebrate your fourteenth birthday?
zh: 你是怎么庆祝你的十四岁生日的？

en: It costs 10 cents.
zh: 它值 10 美分。

en: He is the centre of this event.
zh: 他是这次事件的核心人物。

en: At the beginning of last century, people in China lived in darkness.
zh: 在上个世纪初，中国人民生活在黑暗中。

en: We can certainly have the job finished on time.
zh: 我们肯定能按时完成任务。

en: He now owns a chain of 970 food stores.
zh: 他现在拥有 970 家连锁食品店。

en: A chair consists of a seat with a back.
zh: 椅子是由椅座和椅背组成的。

en: He accepted his friend's challenge to swim across the river.
zh: 他接受朋友提出的挑战，游过这条河。

en: I did not think he was right, so I challenged him.
zh: 我认为他是不对的，因此向他提出质疑。

en: We should improve ourselves by taking every chance to try more new things.
zh: 我们应该抓住每一个机会去尝试更多新事物，以此提升自我。

en: At that time, the event seemed unimportant, but it changed history.
zh: 在那个时候，这件事看似无关紧要，却改写了历史。

en: Many old people find it difficult to cope with changes.
zh: 许多老人难以适应变化。

en: Keep the change.
zh: 不用找零了。

en: The weather was changeable last month and many people fell ill with cold and flu.
zh: 上个月天气多变，很多人患了感冒和流感。

en: He changed many channels but still couldn't find any interesting programmes.
zh: 他调了许多频道，但是仍然找不到任何有趣的节目。

en: What kind of character do you think you have?
zh: 你认为自己具有什么样的性格？

en: She played the character of a brave warrior in the movie.
zh: 她在电影中扮演的角色是一位勇敢的战士。

en: The ward of the hospital is in the charge of Dr. Green.
zh: 医院的这间病房由格林医生负责。

en: We have decided to try our best to raise more money for the local charity.
zh: 我们已经决定尽力为当地慈善机构筹集更多的钱。

en: She said she would like to have a chat with me.
zh: 她说她想跟我聊一聊。

en: It's too noisy here. Let's find a quieter place to chat.
zh: 这里太吵闹，让我们找个安静点的地方谈谈。

en: The pad made last year is a lot cheaper than the one made this year.
zh: 去年生产的垫子比今年生产的便宜很多。

en: Can I pay by check or credit card?
zh: 我能用支票或信用卡支付吗？

en: The boy checked his test paper carefully enough in order to get full marks.
zh: 为了获得满分，这个男孩仔细检查了他的试卷。

en: He's always full of cheer at Christmas.
zh: 圣诞节时，他总是兴致勃勃。

en: The leading actor felt happy when he saw a lot of people cheering him.
zh: 看到很多人为他喝彩，这位男主角感到很高兴。

en: The cheese cake tasted so delicious that the kids asked for more.
zh: 这奶酪蛋糕真好吃，孩子们还想要。

en: The students are doing experiments in the lab with some new chemicals.
zh: 学生正在实验室里用一些新的化学品做实验。

en: Qi Yu hopes to do some chemical research in the near future.
zh: 齐宇希望在不久的将来做一些化学研究。

en: We make experiments in chemistry every day.
zh: 我们每天都做化学实验。

en: In fact, I don't find chemistry interesting.
zh: 事实上，我不觉得化学有趣。

en: Two chess players are playing chess in the park.
zh: 两位棋手在公园下棋。

en: Mary and Alice like eating chicken, but neither of them likes eating fish.
zh: 玛丽和爱丽丝喜欢吃鸡肉，但她们都不喜欢吃鱼。

en: His father is the chief engineer of the building project.
zh: 他父亲是这项建筑工程的总工程师。

en: The chief told him to lead them to the house.
zh: 领导叫他带他们到那栋房子去。

en: In winter the more heavily it snows, the happier the children will feel.
zh: 在冬季雪下得越大，孩子们越感到开心。

en: He had an unhappy childhood because he was poor and no one took care of him.
zh: 他有一个不幸的童年，因为穷，且没有人照顾他。

en: We feel so excited to hear that China has sent its first space laboratory, Tiangong-1 into orbit successfully.
zh: 得知中国发射的第一个空间实验室“天宫1号”成功进入轨道，我们感到非常兴奋。

en: Judy collects blue-and-white china.
zh: 朱迪收集青花瓷器。

en: Some people enjoy McDonald's hamburgers, but others prefer Chinese fast food.
zh: 有些人喜欢麦当劳的汉堡包，但另一些人喜欢中式快餐。

en: I am proud that I'm a Chinese.
zh: 我为我是中国人而骄傲。

en: There are many chocolates in the fridge.
zh: 冰箱里有许多巧克力。

en: Life is simple. You make choices, and you don't look back.
zh: 生活很简单。你做出选择，就不要回头。

en: The team has no choice but to stay late at the office to finish the project.
zh: 团队别无选择，只能在办公室加班到很晚来完成这个项目。

en: I chose the flat on the ninth floor because I think "9" stands for "long lasting".
zh: 我选择了9楼的公寓，因为我认为“9”代表“持久”。

en: He can barely use chopsticks.
zh: 他几乎不会用筷子。

en: We always say "Merry Christmas" to each other at Christmas.
zh: 在圣诞节，我们总是互相说“圣诞快乐”。

en: We always go to my parents' house on Christmas Eve.
zh: 在平安夜，我们总是去我父母家。

en: My friends were showing some foreigners around the ancient church this time yesterday.
zh: 昨天的这个时候，我的朋友们正在陪一些外国人参观古老的教堂。

en: What's on at the cinema today?
zh: 今天电影院放映什么电影？

en: When I got to the cinema, the film had been on for five minutes.
zh: 我到电影院时，电影已经开始5分钟了。

en: Draw a circle.
zh: 画一个圆。

en: This is the road that circles the city.
zh: 这就是那条环城路。

en: The birds circled around the tree before landing on its branches.
zh: 鸟儿在树上盘旋了几圈，然后落在树枝上。

en: It's a duty for citizens to stop pollution for a better Earth.
zh: 为了一个更美好的地球，制止污染是公民的责任。

en: Miss Li has taught English in this school since she moved to this city from her hometown.
zh: 自从李小姐从家乡搬到这座城市，她就一直在这所学校教英语。

en: Would you please tell me when we will have our class meeting?
zh: 请你告诉我，我们什么时候开班会？

en: The students are busy with the survey on their classmates' spending habits.
zh: 这些学生正忙于调查他们同班同学的消费习惯。

en: When I got to the classroom just now, I found that Tom was working on a math problem.
zh: 我到教室时，发现汤姆正在演算一道数学题。

en: Betty can't join us in the card game. She is cleaning the classroom.
zh: 贝蒂不能参加我们的纸牌游戏。她正在打扫教室。

en: Nancy always keeps her room spotlessly clean and free of any mess.
zh: 南希总是把她的房间保持得一尘不染，毫不杂乱。

en: It's great fun to watch the beautiful stars in the sky on clear nights in autumn.
zh: 在秋季晴朗的夜晚观看空中美丽的星星, 这是非常有趣的。

en: She made it clear that she wanted to join the school basketball team.
zh: 她明确表示自己想加入校篮球队。

en: Please clear away all that rubbish.
zh: 请把那些垃圾全部清除掉。

en: You need to explain your opinions quite clearly when having a debate.
zh: 辩论时, 你需要很清楚地解释你的观点。

en: He is a clerk of that department store.
zh: 他是那家百货商店的店员。

en: She is the cleverest girl in her class.
zh: 她是她班上最聪明的女孩。

en: Reading can make us become knowledgeable and clever.
zh: 阅读能使我们知识渊博, 变得聪明。

en: The box closed with a click.
zh: 盒子咔嗒一声关上了。

en: Click the square icon again to minimize the window.
zh: 再次点击正方形图标, 把窗口最小化。

en: They were excited after they climbed up to the top of the mountain.
zh: 他们爬上山顶后非常兴奋。

en: You’d better go to the clinic and have a thorough check.
zh: 你最好去诊所，做一个彻底检查。

en: Big Ben is a famous clock in London.
zh: 大本钟是伦敦一座著名的钟。

en: Would you be kind enough to close the window?
zh: 请你把窗户关上好吗？

en: I was lucky enough to have a close relationship with my parents.
zh: 我很幸运能与父母关系亲密。

en: He was sitting close to the stranger.
zh: 他紧靠那位陌生人坐着。

en: Is it necessary for us to try on clothes before buying them?
zh: 我们有必要在买衣服之前试穿吗？

en: There are so many clouds today.
zh: 今天云特别多。

en: I like the cloudy sky very much.
zh: 我非常喜欢多云的天空。

en:
— How about making a poster to introduce our club?
— Are you kidding? It’s a waste of time and money.
zh:
——制作一张海报，介绍我们的俱乐部如何？
——你在开玩笑吧？这是浪费时间和金钱。

en: Mom, what should we buy for Dad, a shirt or a coat?
zh: 妈妈，我们应该给爸爸买什么？一件衬衫还是一件外套？

en: One of the household robots makes coffee for Mary and Frank.
zh: 其中一个家庭机器人在为玛丽和弗兰克煮咖啡。

en: His hobby is to collect coins from different countries.
zh: 他的业余爱好是收集不同国家的硬币。

en: What a cold day it is! We’d better turn on the air-conditioner.
zh: 今天好冷啊！我们最好开空调。

en: A cold kept him in bed for three days.
zh: 感冒使他卧床3天。

en: By the end of last month, we had collected enough money to help Linda’s mother.
zh: 到上个月月底，我们已经募集到足够的钱，以帮助琳达的母亲。

en: Huge amounts of information about pollution was collected by the scientist last year.
zh: 去年，这位科学家收集了大量有关污染的信息。

en: Shanghai Museum has a large collection of works of art from home and abroad.
zh: 上海博物馆收藏了大量的国内外艺术品。

en: Our daughter is going to college in autumn.
zh: 我们的女儿秋天就要上大学了。

en: I don’t like the colour of the scarf. Please show me another one.
zh: 我不喜欢这条围巾的颜色。请再给我看一条。

en: Colour it.
zh: 为它涂上颜色。

en: Never give up trying, and success will finally come to you.
zh: 永不放弃尝试，成功最终会来到你的身边。

en: I feel comfortable talking with that nice girl.
zh: 和那个可爱的女孩谈话我感觉很好。

en: It's common knowledge that the sun sets down in the west.
zh: 夕阳西下，这是常识。

en: The foreign visitor could speak only a little Chinese, but he managed to communicate with us.
zh: 这位外国游客只会说一点中文，却成功地与我们进行了交流。

en: The volunteers have offered a lot to the community for nearly ten years.
zh: 近10年来，志愿者为社区提供了许多服务。

en: He refuses to join any community.
zh: 他拒绝参加任何社团。

en: The general manager of that new company is quite a young lady.
zh: 那家新公司的总经理是一位很年轻的女士。

en: He decided to keep company with her while she waited for the bus.
zh: 他决定陪她等公交。

en: It is hard to compare.
zh: 很难比较。

en: Her success in the competition made her parents very proud.
zh: 她在比赛中的成功让父母感到无比骄傲。

en: Do you think it is useful to complain about the current situation?
zh: 你认为抱怨现状有用吗？

en: They could do nothing but complain.
zh: 他们只能抱怨。

en: The doctor advised me to take a complete rest.
zh: 医生让我彻底休息。

en: On February 29, the world's tallest broadcast tower, the Tokyo Skytree, was finally completed. 2
zh: 月29日，世界上最高的广播塔“东京晴空塔”终于完工了。

en: I completely agree that healthy living habits help people balance work and play.
zh: 我完全赞同健康的生活习惯有助于人们平衡工作与娱乐。

en: Computer is more popular than any other subject.
zh: 计算机比其他学科更受欢迎。
rewrite: Computer is the most popular of all the subjects.

en: Computers work accurately. They seldom give wrong answers, do they?
zh: 电脑运行准确。他们很少给出错误的答案，是吗？

en: We can't go to the concert because we are quite busy now.
zh: 我们不能去听音乐会，因为我们现在很忙。

en: All of us come to a conclusion that we should work better as a team.
zh: 我们所有人得出一个结论——作为一个团队，我们应该更好地合作。

en: I found the conclusion of his book very interesting.
zh: 我觉得他这本书的结尾很有趣。

en: She will leave Shanghai to attend an important conference in the U.S.A. the week after next.
zh: 她将离开上海去参加一个下下周在美国举行的重要会议。

en: They had every confidence of success.
zh: 他们对成功充满信心。

en: I feel quite confident that I will pass the Chinese exam this time.
zh: 我觉得很有信心，我会通过这次语文考试。

en: Practice made her more confident in her public speaking skills.
zh: 练习让她对自己的公众演讲技巧更有信心。

en: They asked so many questions that they confused me.
zh: 他们问了许多问题，都把我弄糊涂了。

en: Congratulations! It is the twelfth time that you have been praised this term.
zh: 恭喜你！这是你这学期第 12 次获得表扬。

en: You must connect this wire with that one.
zh: 你必须把这根电线和那根接起来。

en: I'm considering starting my own business someday.
zh: 我一直在考虑有一天自己创业。

en: Bob is considered the most hardworking of all the students in his class.
zh: 大家认为鲍勃是他们班所有学生中最勤奋的。

en: The entire world consists of matter.
zh: 整个世界都是由物质组成的。

en: Even if we cannot agree, we should maintain our contact.
zh: 即使我们不能取得一致，我们也要保持联系。

en: I'll tell our manager about it and ask him to contact you.
zh: 我会将有关情况告诉我们的经理并且请他和您联系。

en: Luckily, Charlie got the first prize in the English speech contest.
zh: 幸运的是，查理获得了英语演讲比赛一等奖。

en: The cold wave will continue.
zh: 寒潮还将继续。

en: I couldn't control myself, and I hit him.
zh: 我控制不住就打了他。

en: The situation is getting out of control.
zh: 局势正在失控。

en: Shopping online is a useful and convenient way for us to buy things.
zh: 对我们来说，网购是一种实用、便利的购物方式。

en: Life in 2050 will be more convenient because robots will be able to help us with a lot of work. 2050
zh: 年的生活将会更便利，因为机器人可以帮助我们做很多工作。

en: Conversation is one of the pleasures of life.
zh: 交谈是人生一大乐趣。

en: The cook is in charge of the kitchen helper.
zh: 这位厨师负责管理厨工。

en: My mother cooked food for us as soon as she came back from work yesterday.
zh: 昨天我妈妈一下班回来就为我们做饭。

en: How cool your new phone is! I want to have the same one.
zh: 你那新手机多酷啊！我想买个和你一样的。

en: He used a fan to help cool the room during the heatwave.
zh: 在热浪期间，他用风扇帮房间降温。

en: The book Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone sold hundreds of millions of copies.
zh: 《哈利・波特与魔法石》这本书卖出了上亿册。

en: A child copies his example.
zh: 孩子学他的模样。

en: Don't copy.
zh: 不要抄袭。

en: I drop the letter in the mailbox on the corner.
zh: 我把信投在拐角处的邮箱里。

en: We've got four different answers to that question, but none of them is correct.
zh: 那个问题我们有 4 个不同的答案, 但没有一个是正确的。

en: Your homework is well done. Just correct some small mistakes in it.
zh: 你的作业做得很好。只要改正其中的一些小错误。

en: The writer expresses himself correctly in English.
zh: 作家用英语正确地表达自己的意思。

en: The new type of bicycle cost him about 1,000 yuan, but he thought it was worth buying.
zh: 这辆新型自行车花了他 1000 元左右, 但他认为值得购买。

en: It cost him a great deal of time to complete the project.
zh: 他花了大量时间来完成这个项目。

en: The cost of living in the city is much higher than in the suburbs.
zh: 城市的生活成本比郊区高得多。

en: This shirt is made of cotton.
zh: 这件衬衣是棉布的。

en: She coughed the whole night.
zh: 她咳了一晚上。

en: Your cough sounds much better today.
zh: 今天你的咳嗽声听上去好多了。

en: The baby can read, write and count.
zh: 这个小孩能读写，还会数数。

en: We ought to try our best to make our country more powerful.
zh: 我们应该尽力使我们的国家更强大。

en: To my surprise, the young couple designed their new house by themselves.
zh: 令我惊讶的是，这对年轻夫妇亲自设计了他们的新房。

en: My cousin will stay with me for a couple of days this summer holiday.
zh: 今年暑假，我的表哥将在我这里暂住几天。

en: The college course was then cut to three years.
zh: 那时大学学制缩短到了3年。

en: Alice and Betty are my cousins.
zh: 艾丽丝和贝蒂是我的表姐妹。

en: In autumn the road is always covered with fallen leaves.
zh: 在秋天，道路总是铺满落叶。

en: The book needs a new cover.
zh: 这本书需要一个新封面。

en: She must be crazy to wear a short skirt in such freezing weather.
zh: 她一定是疯了，在这么寒冷的天气穿短裙。

en: He is so crazy about science that he wants to become an inventor.
zh: 他如此热爱科学，以至于想成为一名发明家。

en: Please put cream in her coffee.
zh: 请在她的咖啡里加奶油。

en: If you have good imagination, you can create an attractive story easily.
zh: 如果你有出色的想象力，就能轻松写出一个引人入胜的故事来。

en: The new-media industry attracts young and creative people.
zh: 新媒体产业吸引着有创意的年轻人。

en: Mark the place on the map with a cross.
zh: 在地图上用十字形记号标出这个地方。

en: Don't let the boy cross the street by himself. He is too young.
zh: 不要让这男孩自己过马路。他太小了。

en: To everyone's excitement, Jim was the first to cross the finish line.
zh: 让所有人兴奋的是，吉姆是第一个冲过终点线的人。

en: Yao Ming's height makes him stand out in the crowd.
zh: 姚明的身高使他在人群中很突出。

en: The restaurant is always crowded with people. The food there must be very delicious.
zh: 这家餐厅总是挤满了人。那里的食物一定很美味。

en: The baby can cry as soon as he is born.
zh: 婴儿生下来就会哭。

en: He jumped into the river to save the little boy as soon as he heard the cry for help.
zh: 他一听到呼救，就马上跳入河中去救那个小男孩。

en: Young people are showing interest in Guofeng culture for the time being.
zh: 目前，年轻人对国风文化表现出兴趣。

en: Would you like me to bring you a cup of tea?
zh: 我给你拿一杯茶，好吗？

en: If you travel around the world, you will be surprised at how different the foreign customs are.
zh: 如果你在世界各地旅行，你会惊奇地发现外国的习俗是如此不同。

en: If the manager can't make the service better, the shop will soon lose all the customers.
zh: 如果经理不能提高服务水平，商店会很快失去所有的客户。

en: I cut a piece of meat for you.
zh: 我给你切了一块肉。

en: It's important to properly care for a cut to prevent infection.
zh: 正确护理伤口很重要，可以预防感染。

en: The little girl is very cute.
zh: 那个小女孩非常可爱。

en: He always practises cycling with other cyclists.
zh: 他总是和其他车手一起练习骑自行车。

en: How do you feel, Dad?
zh: 爸爸，你感觉怎么样？

en: He does daily exercises to help control his weight.
zh: 他为控制体重，每天坚持锻炼。

en: The Visitor Centre is open daily from 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
zh: 游客中心每天上午 8:30 至下午 4:30 开放。

en: China Daily
zh: 《中国日报》

en: The forest fires kill many plants and animals in an eco-system so they cause damage to a forest.
zh: 森林火灾烧死生态系统中的许多动物和植物，所以会给森林带来毁灭性破坏。

en: He damaged a car with a baseball bat.
zh: 他用棒球棍损坏了一辆汽车。

en: I enjoy the popular dance “hip-hop”, but neither my father nor my mother likes it.
zh: 我喜欢流行的“嘻哈”舞蹈，但我父亲和母亲都不喜欢。

en: It was unusual for such old people to dance Swan Lake.
zh: 对于这个年纪的老年人来说，跳《天鹅湖》是不寻常的。

en: She is the best dancer in Shanghai.
zh: 她是上海最好的舞蹈演员。

en: Sadly, some drivers are still unaware of the danger of using phones while driving.
zh: 令人遗憾的是，一些司机仍然没有意识到开车时使用手机的危险性。

en: The peace-keeping armies from different countries work together in dangerous areas.
zh: 来自不同国家的维和部队在危险地区协同工作。

en: He dare not speak to her.
zh: 他不敢和她说话。

en: He didn't dare to speak to her.
zh: 他不敢和她说话。

en: Cats have a remarkable ability to see in the dark.
zh: 猫拥有在黑暗中视物的非凡能力。

en: That was a dark, moonless night.
zh: 那是一个黑暗的、无月光的夜晚。

en: March 6th is the date of his death.
zh: 他去世的日期是3月6日。

en: Kathy was delighted to find that her daughter had cleaned the room by herself.
zh: 凯茜很高兴地发现，她的女儿已经自己打扫了房间。

en: Let’s enjoy the days with our classmates. We will finish our junior high school in two months.
zh: 让我们好好享受和同班同学在一起的日子。我们将在两个月内完成初中学业。

en: The days are getting longer in summer.
zh: 夏天，白昼变长了。

en: Qingming Festival is an important Chinese festival to remember people’s dead relatives.
zh: 清明节是中国的一个重要节日，是缅怀已故亲人的节日。

en: How will you deal with these things?
zh: 你将如何处理这些事情？

en: We lost a lot of money on that deal.
zh: 我们在那笔交易中亏损了许多钱。

en: The two armies stopped fighting and agreed to a peace deal.
zh: 这两支军队停止了交战，达成了和平协议。

en: Diego Maradona’s death made the football fans from all over the world very sad.
zh: 迭戈·马拉多纳的去世使得全世界的足球迷都很伤心。

en: We're debating what to do next.
zh: 我们正在讨论下一步该做什么。

en: There is a general debate nowadays about housing problems.
zh: 目前，针对住房问题存在普遍的争论。

en: What a coincidence! Alice's birthday is on the ninth of December just as mine.
zh: 真是太巧了！爱丽丝的生日和我一样是12月9日。

en: We've decided to decorate our new flat by ourselves this weekend.
zh: 我们已经决定本周末自己来装饰我们的新房子。

en: Mr. Chen hasn't decided what to do next.
zh: 陈先生尚未决定下一步要做什么。

en: For many students, choosing a job is the most important life decision they must make at school.
zh: 对于很多学生来说，择业是他们在学校必须做的最重要的人生决定。

en: My mother likes to decorate rooms with flowers.
zh: 我妈妈喜欢用花装饰房间。

en: The river is not deep; we can walk through it.
zh: 这河不深，我们可以涉水过去。

en: The deep rumble of thunder echoed through the valley.
zh: 低沉的隆隆雷声在山谷中回荡。

en: It's at 10 degrees centigrade.
zh: 气温是10℃。

en: I have already got my master's degree of Education.
zh: 我已经获得了教育硕士学位。

en: It is getting late, don't delay.
zh: 时间已晚，不要耽搁了。

en: His delay made the teacher angry.
zh: 他的迟到使老师生气了。

en: Thank you for your delicious dinner, Tony.
zh: 谢谢您的美味晚餐，托尼。

en: The delicious aroma of flowers filled the sitting room.
zh: 宜人的花香充满了整个起居室。

en: Will you take the goods with you or shall we deliver them to your house?
zh: 你随身带走货物还是我们把货物送到你家？

en: The guest professor delivered an inspiring speech about youth and creativity.
zh: 客座教授发表了一场关于青春与创造力的鼓舞人心的演讲。

en: I have got a toothache, so I must go to a dentist.
zh: 我牙疼，必须去看牙医。

en: The driver denied causing the serious car accident during the police interview.
zh: 在警方问询时，司机否认自己引发了这起严重的车祸。

en: Within ninety minutes the ship was ready for departure.
zh: 90 分钟之内轮船准备出发。

en: Our future happiness depends on the choices we make today.
zh: 我们未来的幸福取决于我们今天所做的选择。

en: I don’t know whether he can join us for dinner tonight, it depends.
zh: 我不知道他今晚是否和我们共进晚餐，看情况吧。

en: About three-fifths of the students in our class can describe that place in English.
zh: 在我们班大约有 3/5 的学生可以用英语描述那个地方。

en: He deserves a reward for his efforts.
zh: 他积极努力，应受奖赏。

en: A new car has been designed for the film The Italian Job.
zh: 专为电影《偷天换日》设计出一款新型汽车。

en: The design of the smartphone was fashionable and innovative.
zh: 这款智能手机的设计时尚而创新。

en: She has a desire of climbing mountains.
zh: 她想去爬山。

en: We all desire happiness and health.
zh: 我们都渴望得到幸福和健康。

en: The orange on the desk is for you, David.
zh: 桌上的橙子是给你的，戴维。

en: Hundreds of buildings in that area were destroyed by the terrible flood.
zh: 那个地区有数以百计的建筑物毁于洪水。

en: If you're interested in the job, I'll send you all the details.
zh: 如果你对这份工作感兴趣，我将把所有详细说明发给你。

en: Pansy didn't read many detective stories.
zh: 潘西看过的侦探小说不多。

en: The detective found that the young man took part in many bank robberies.
zh: 这位侦探发现那个年轻人参与过多次银行抢劫。

en: We must do our best to develop the national economy.
zh: 我们必须努力发展国民经济。

en: With the development of economy, our life is getting better and better.
zh: 随着经济的发展，我们的生活越来越好。

en: Do you often dial home?
zh: 你常给家里打电话吗？

en: They had long dialogues.
zh: 他们进行了长时间的对话。

en: The teacher asked her students to keep an English diary every day.
zh: 老师要求她的学生每天写一篇英语日记。

en: You'd better look it up in the dictionary.
zh: 你最好查一下词典。

en: Many brave soldiers choose to die for honour rather than live in shame.
zh: 许多英勇的士兵选择为荣誉献身，而非屈辱地活着。

en: If you want to memorise things better, you'd better have a healthier diet.
zh: 要想记性好一点，你最好吃得健康点。

en: The mother can easily tell the difference between the twins.
zh: 母亲很容易区分这对双胞胎。

en: My new computer is different from yours.
zh: 我的新电脑与你的不同。

en: It was difficult for human beings to predict weather in the past.
zh: 在过去人们很难预测天气。

en: I had no difficulty in getting in touch with him.
zh: 我和他取得联系没有什么困难。

en: They dug a hole.
zh: 他们挖了一个坑。

en: I haven't had dinner yet.
zh: 我还没有吃饭呢。

en: Nick was having dinner when I visited him.
zh: 当我去拜访尼克的时候，他正在吃饭。

en: On your way to success, you must keep your direction.
zh: 在通往成功的路上，你必须坚持你的方向。

en: Follow the directions on the package to cook the noodles properly.
zh: 按包装上的说明操作，面条才能煮得恰到好处。

en: But even if some don't ask it directly, you can feel it.
zh: 即使一些人没有直接问出来，你仍然能够感觉到。

en: Tim wants to be a great director like Zhang Yimou when he grows up.
zh: 蒂姆希望长大后，能像张艺谋一样成为一名大导演。

en: Even in the dirtiest weather, they were driven to go out to sea.
zh: 即使是最恶劣的天气，他们也被迫出海。

en: It is our bounden duty to help the disabled.
zh: 帮助残疾人士是我们义不容辞的责任。

en: Some voluntary organisations run workshops for disabled people.
zh: 一些志愿组织为残疾人士开办作坊。

en: The children from poor families were at a distinct disadvantage.
zh: 来自贫困家庭的孩子们处于明显的不利地位。

en: Some rainforests are likely to disappear if we don't take action to protect them.
zh: 如果我们不采取行动进行保护，一些热带雨林有可能就会消失。

en: The black car drove away from them and disappeared.
zh: 那辆黑色轿车驶离了他们的视线，不见了。

en: He was disappointed at the result.
zh: 他对这样的结果感到失望。

en: These natural disasters have warned us that everyone should start to protect the environment immediately.
zh: 这些自然灾害警示我们，每个人都应该立即行动起来保护环境。

en: A good education will help you discover and develop your talents.
zh: 良好的教育，将有助于你发现和发挥你的才华。

en: All your suggestions will be discussed carefully before we come to a decision.
zh: 在我们做决定之前，您的建议将会被仔细地讨论。

en: He never contributes to the discussion.
zh: 他在讨论时从不发表意见。

en: Please remember to bring your dishes and cakes to Tom's birthday party.
zh: 请记得带上你的菜和蛋糕去汤姆的生日聚会。

en: Don't be dishonest with your friends, or you may lose their trust.
zh: 不要对朋友不诚实, 否则你可能会失去他们的信任。

en: We like him personally, but dislike his way of living.
zh: 我们喜欢他这个人, 但不喜欢他的生活方式。

en: I have walked half the distance.
zh: 我走了一半的距离。

en: We do not want to disturb what we have got.
zh: 我们不想打乱我们现有的东西。

en: The chef divided the cake into equal slices for the guests.
zh: 主厨把蛋糕平分成几块给顾客。

en: By the end of fifth grade, they should be able to multiply and divide.
zh: 到五年级结束, 他们应该有能力计算乘法和除法。

en: The generation gap often leads to a divide in understanding between parents and children.
zh: 代沟通常会导致家长和孩子间的理解差异。

en: Tom very soon decided what he would do next (= what to do next).
zh: 汤姆很快决定下一步他会做什么。

en: I'm sure that you will do well in your interviews.
zh: 我相信你在采访中会做得很好。

en: Do you remember getting some medicine for her last week?
zh: 你还记得上星期给她买药的事吗?

en: The doctor told my grandpa not to eat too much fat.
zh: 医生告诉我的爷爷，不要吃太多的脂肪。

en: The clever dog can open the gate of the garden by itself.
zh: 这条聪明的狗自己能打开花园的门。

en: Let me change the dollar bill for coins.
zh: 让我把这张美元纸钞换成硬币。

en: Do you know the man over there by the door?
zh: 你认识站在门边的那个男人吗？

en: We cannot pay double (of) this amount.
zh: 我们不能付双倍的数目。

en: He carefully doubled the map to fit it into his pocket.
zh: 他仔细地对折了地图，以便把它放进口袋。

en: We're going down a mountain.
zh: 我们正在下山。

en: Danny put down his glass.
zh: 丹尼放下他的玻璃杯。

en: You can also use the interface to download, copy, or delete objects.
zh: 您还可以使用界面来下载、复制或删除东西。

en: Are the children downstairs?
zh: 孩子们在楼下吗？

en: He drew pictures worse than me. = He didn't draw pictures as well as I.
zh: 他画得比我更糟糕。

en: In the end they had to draw lots to decide who would take part in the competition.
zh: 最后他们不得不抽签决定谁去参加比赛。

en: Hard work pays off. I believe you will enter your dream school.
zh: 努力学习是有回报的。我相信你会考入你梦想中的学校。

en: Many young people dream of becoming top models.
zh: 许多年轻人梦想成为顶级模特儿。

en:
— You look so beautiful in your new dress.
— Thank you.
zh:
——你穿这条新裙子看起来真漂亮。
——谢谢。

en: My sister likes to dress in bright colours.
zh: 我妹妹喜欢穿颜色鲜艳的衣服。

en: The nurse helped to dress the patient.
zh: 护士帮助病人穿衣服。

en: Drinking too much fruit juice can be harmful to children's teeth.
zh: 喝太多果汁对孩子的牙齿有害。

en: Coca-cola is a soft drink.
zh: 可口可乐是一种软饮料。

en: If I fail the driving test, I will have another try.
zh: 如果我驾驶考试失败了，我会再试一次。

en: Drivers must obey the traffic rules at any time when they are driving.
zh: 司机在任何时候驾驶，都必须遵守交通规则。

en: Even a drop of water mustn't be wasted because it is so important to all the living things.
zh: 即使是一滴水也不能浪费，因为水对所有生命是如此重要。

en: Temperatures can drop to freezing at night.
zh: 晚上气温能降到零度。

en: The medicine must be kept in a cool and dry place.
zh: 药必须存放在干燥阴凉的地方。

en: Dry the dishes before putting them away in the cupboard.
zh: 在把盘碟放进橱柜前先把它们擦干。

en: The children love to feed the ducks at the lake.
zh: 孩子们喜欢喂湖里的鸭子。

en: Art is not as important as life, but life without art is dull.
zh: 艺术远远没有生命重要，但是没有艺术的生活是多么乏味呀！

en: Kitty said she enjoyed herself during the summer holiday.
zh: 姬蒂说在暑假期间她过得很开心。

en: Inside I saw the head nurse, who said Miss Barkley was on duty.
zh: 我在里面见到了护士长，她说巴克莱小姐正在值班。

en: Each bird loves to hear itself sing.
zh: 每只鸟都喜欢听自己唱歌。

en: We each have different needs and interests.
zh: 我们每个人都有不同的需要和兴趣。

en: Recently, more and more people are eager to learn the traditional skills.
zh: 最近，越来越多的人渴望学习这些传统技艺。

en: Julia sang too terribly for me to believe my ears.
zh: 朱丽亚唱得太糟糕了，以至于我简直不敢相信我的耳朵。
rewrite: Julia sang so terribly that I couldn't believe my ears.

en: The policeman asked Mary whether she always caught such an early train.
zh: 警察问玛丽她是否总是赶这么早的火车。

en: He did the work as quickly as he could so as to go back home early.
zh: 他尽快干活，以便可以早点回家。

en: The more quickly he walks, the earlier he will get there.
zh: 他走得越快，就能越早到那里。

en: My brother studies in a university and he knows a lot about the Earth.
zh: 我的哥哥在大学学习，他知道很多关于地球的事情。

en: I was watching TV when the earthquake happened in Shanghai half a month ago.
zh: 半个月前上海发生地震，当时我正在看电视。

en: With the help of the app, we found the address of the theatre easily.
zh: 在这款应用程序的帮助下，我们很容易找到了这家剧院的地址。

en: a bitter east wind
zh: 一阵刺骨的东风

en: The room faces east.
zh: 这间房朝东。

en: There has been heavy rain in the east today.
zh: 今天东边下了场大雨。

en: Nobody thought it easy to finish so much work in two days' time.
zh: 没有人认为在两天之内完成这么多工作是件容易的事。

en: It's selfish of Jim to eat the whole cake and it's necessary for us to think more of others.
zh: 吉姆真自私，吃了整个蛋糕。我们有必要多想想别人。

en: The plan of our country is based on a rising economy.
zh: 我国的计划建立在不断发展的经济基础上。

en: His parents pay about 200,000 yuan for his college education in the UK each year.
zh: 父母每年为他在英国的大学教育支付 20 万元左右。

en: They hold readings, celebrations, book displays and educational events.
zh: 他们举办读书会、庆祝活动、图书展示和教育活动。

en: The new medicine will have a good effect on his illness, won't it?
zh: 这种新药会对他的病情有良好的效果，不是吗？

en: Jane Goodall's Roots & Shoots has had a huge effect on global youth environmental action.
zh: 珍妮·古道尔创办的“根与芽”组织，对全球青少年的环保行动产生了巨大影响。

en: This Chinese medicine proved to be highly effective in curing the cold.
zh: 这种中药被证明对治疗感冒非常有效。

en: Her success here depends upon effort and ability.
zh: 她在这里的成功靠的是努力和能力。

en: She has an egg for breakfast every day, doesn't she?
zh: 她每天早餐吃一个鸡蛋，不是吗？

en: You may use either printer.
zh: 两台打印机中你可以随便用哪一台。

en: Either of them will agree to this arrangement.
zh: 他们两人都会同意这样的安排。

en: The new policy enables people to buy train tickets either from the station or on the internet.
zh: 新政策使人们能够从火车站或互联网上购买火车票。

en: Mary, you can go to the museum either by bus or by underground.
zh: 玛丽，你可以乘公共汽车或者地铁去博物馆。
rewrite: Mary, you can go to the museum by bus. You can go there by underground, too.

en: No one stayed at home, either.
zh: 也没有一个人待在家里。

en: Is the girl in blue your elder sister?
zh: 穿蓝衣服的那个女孩是你的姐姐吗？

en: If oil prices continue to rise, people will start driving electric cars.
zh: 如果油价持续上涨，人们就会开始驾驶电动汽车。

en: When water moves from a high place to a lower place, it can make electricity.
zh: 当水从高处流往低处时，它可以发电。

en: The new laws deprived many people of the most elementary freedoms in that country.
zh: 在那个国家，新法律剥夺了许多人的最基本的自由。

en: I saw a baby elephant drinking.
zh: 我看见一只小象在喝水。

en: Can you show me something else?
zh: 你可以给我看点别的吗？

en: We communicate with each other in many ways, such as by email or by phone.
zh: 我们用很多方式交流，比如通过电子邮件或打电话。

en: With the help of the new technology, you can email your friends by mobile phone.
zh: 在新技术的帮助下，你可以用手机给你的朋友发邮件。

en: He looked a bit embarrassed.
zh: 他看起来有点尴尬。

en: The government is taking emergency action to deal with a housing crisis.
zh: 政府正采取紧急措施解决住房危机。

en: Except for an old lady, the bus was empty.
zh: 这辆公共汽车除了一位老妇人之外是空的。

en: The garbage truck comes once a week to empty our bins.
zh: 垃圾车一周来一次清空我们的垃圾箱。

en: Good team work will enable us to get the job done on time.
zh: 良好的团队协作能使我们按时完成这项工作。

en: The mother always encouraged her baby to stand up by himself when he fell over.
zh: 当婴儿摔倒时，母亲总是鼓励他自己站起来。

en: Kevin came from England. He had lived in Shanghai for ten years by the end of last year.
zh: 凯文来自英格兰。到去年年底，他在上海已经生活了10年。

en: The robot's sensors detected movement at the end of its mechanical arm.
zh: 机器人的传感器检测到了机械臂末端的运动。

en: The concert ended with a spectacular fireworks display.
zh: 音乐会在一场绚丽壮观的烟花表演中落下帷幕。

en: I don't know why a successful person often has many enemies.
zh: 我不知道为什么一个成功的人往往有许多敌人。

en: He brought new energy to the science department.
zh: 他为科学部门带来了新的活力。

en: The engine seems to need piles of oil.
zh: 这种发动机似乎需要很多油。

en: My father has worked as an engineer in the factory for several years.
zh: 我的父亲作为一名工程师在这家工厂已经工作几年了。

en: Do you use chopsticks in England?
zh: 在英格兰你们用筷子吗？

en: The foreign teachers in our school are mainly from some English-speaking countries.
zh: 我校的外籍教师主要来自一些讲英语的国家。

en: By the end of last term, we had learned English for four years.
zh: 到上学期结束时，我们已经学了4年英语。

en: Enjoy yourselves at the party, boys and girls.
zh: 孩子们，聚会上尽情地玩吧。

en: Billy said he enjoyed reading magazines at the beginning of his speech.
zh: 比利在演讲开始时说他喜欢看杂志。

en: We hope you had an enjoyable holiday.
zh: 我们希望您度过一个愉快的假期。

en: I like this piece of music quite a lot. It's enjoyable.
zh: 我相当喜欢这首音乐。它使人愉悦。

en: Of the two pairs of jeans, I chose the less expensive one because I hadn't enough money on me.
zh: 两条牛仔裤中，我选择了更便宜的一条，因为我带的钱不够。

en: He was lucky enough to win the game. = He was so lucky that he won the game.
zh: 他很幸运，赢得了比赛。

en: I think I have said enough.
zh: 我想我已经说得够多了。

en: Sandy likes drawing very much and she believes it can enrich her whole life.
zh: 桑迪非常喜欢绘画，她相信绘画可以丰富她的整个人生。

en: Dick would rather enter a vocational school than a high school.
zh: 迪克宁愿进职业学校也不愿进入高中。

en: Television provides universal entertainment.
zh: 电视提供大众化的娱乐。

en: David will meet his friend Martin at the entrance to the museum.
zh: 戴维将在博物馆的入口处与他的朋友马丁碰头。

en: Can I use this envelope?
zh: 我可以用这个信封吗？

en: Please tell us what to do to protect our environment.
zh: 请告诉我们应该做什么来保护我们的环境。

en: We do business with all countries, big or small, on an equal basis.
zh: 我们同所有国家做生意，无论大国小国，都一视同仁。

en: Nine percent interest less seven percent inflation equals two percent.
zh: 9% 的利率减去 7% 的通货膨胀率等于 2%。

en: I read love stories as an escape from reality.
zh: 我读爱情小说以逃避现实。

en: Do you know whether the Chinese seamen managed to escape from the pirates?
zh: 你知道中国船员是否已经设法摆脱了海盗？

en: Their ideas still influence us today, especially in the arts, science, literature and philosophy.
zh: 今天，他们的思想仍然影响着我们，尤其是在艺术、科学、文学和哲学方面。

en: Most students have not been to Europe, have they?
zh: 大多数学生都没有去过欧洲，是吗？

en: People like to go out on New Year's Eve.
zh: 人们喜欢在跨年夜出门。

en: She didn't even apologise for her mistake.
zh: 她甚至都没为她的错误道歉。

en: We hope we can cooperate even more closely in the future.
zh: 希望我们今后能更加密切地合作。

en: What an amazing performance the singer gave at the opening ceremony yesterday evening!
zh: 这位歌手在昨晚开幕式上的表演多么精彩啊！

en: Call the police in the event of an emergency.
zh: 若发生紧急事件就打电话报警。

en: Both my husband and I think it is the most amusing story we have ever heard.
zh: 我丈夫和我都认为这是我们听到过的最有趣的故事。

en: Many people are unaware of how much sugar they take in every day.
zh: 很多人没有意识到他们每天摄入了多少糖。

en: If everyone takes a bus instead of driving a car, there will be less air pollution.
zh: 如果每个人都坐公共汽车而不是驾驶汽车，空气污染将会减少。

en: Please speak louder, so that everybody in the hall can hear you clearly.
zh: 请大声点说，让在大厅里的每个人都听清楚。

en: These are my everyday shoes, not my best ones.
zh: 这些是我平常穿的鞋，不是最好的鞋。

en: Kevin is so independent that he always tries to do everything by himself.
zh: 凯文是如此独立，以至于他总是设法自己去做每一件事。

en: Where have you been? I looked everywhere for you.
zh: 你去哪儿了？我到处找你。

en: What are you busy with exactly?
zh: 那你究竟在忙什么？

en: After we pass the exams, we will celebrate by having a party next week.
zh: 我们通过考试后，下周将举办个派对庆祝一下。

en: The officers at the airport examine every traveler's passport carefully.
zh: 机场工作人员仔细检查每一个旅客的护照。

en: I don't quite understand what you said. Would you please give us another example?
zh: 我不明白你说什么。请给我们另外举一个例子好吗?

en: An excellent story is the key to making a successful film.
zh: 一个优秀的故事是拍一部成功电影的关键。

en: I think no one can help me except you.
zh: 我想除了你之外没有人能帮助我。

en: Everyone in our class has brought his dictionary to class except me.
zh: 除了我以外, 我们班上每个人都带了词典到教室。

en: The Italian exchange student was thankful to the host for his care and help.
zh: 这位意大利的交换学生感谢接待方对他的关心和帮助。

en: The students exchanged ideas during the group project.
zh: 学生们在小组项目中交换了想法。

en: Users have been very excited about the development of this AI model.
zh: 用户们对这款人工智能模型的发展感到十分兴奋。

en: How exciting it is to travel around the world by bike!
zh: 骑自行车环游世界，这是多么令人兴奋啊！

en: Excuse me, what time is it now?
zh: 对不起，请问现在几点了？

en: There's no excuse for behaviour like that.
zh: 别为那样的行为找借口。

en: To keep fit, we should get rid of unhealthy eating habits and do more exercise.
zh: 为了强身健体，我们应该摒弃不健康的饮食习惯，多做运动。

en: You should exercise more.
zh: 你应该多多锻炼。

en: Although it was getting dark, many people were still waiting outside the Shanghai Museum to visit the exhibition.
zh: 虽然天渐渐黑了，上海博物馆外还有许多人等着参观展览。

en: Does life exist on Mars?
zh: 火星上有生命吗？

en: The customer starts walking to the exit nearest where he parked.
zh: 顾客开始走向距离他的停车点最近的出口。

en: At the end of the third scene the actress exits.
zh: 这位女演员于第三场结束时退场。

en: Ben and Lily have one child and they are expecting the second one in July.
zh: 本和莉莉有一个孩子，他们预计 7 月份迎来第 2 个孩子。

en: Grandparents just called to say that they expected us to visit them very often.
zh: 爷爷奶奶刚打电话来，说希望我们能经常去看望他们。

en: This beautiful skirt is as expensive as that red scarf.
zh: 这条漂亮的裙子和那条红色的围巾一样贵。
rewrite: This beautiful skirt is the same price as that red scarf.

en: He had little experience in managing a team, but he learned quickly and soon became good at it.
zh: 他几乎没有管理团队的经验，但学得很 快，不久就驾轻就熟了。

en: The experience in Australia in July was truly unforgettable.
zh: 7 月份在澳大利亚的经历确实难忘。

en: Now the good method is widely used in the experiments.
zh: 现在这个好方法被广泛应用在实验中。

en: It is better to learn how to do the experiment right now.
zh: 现在最好立刻学习如何做实验。

en: Do I really have to explain this?
zh: 我真的需要对此做出解释吗？

en: Byrd explored the region around the South Pole.
zh: 伯德探测了南极地带。

en: Language is how you express yourself and your culture.
zh: 语言是表达自我和表达自身文化的方式。

en: He had boarded an express for Rome.
zh: 他已经登上了前往罗马的特快列车。

en: You need to be extra careful not to make any mistake.
zh: 你要格外小心，别犯错误。

en: What should we do with this extra income?
zh: 我们应该如何处理这笔额外的收入呢？

en: Reading can open up my eyes to the outside world. And books are like teachers that introduce different countries to me.
zh: 读书能够开拓我的视野，并且，书也像老师一样把不同的国家介绍给我。

en: Class, I'm going to tell you a fable.
zh: 同学们，我要给你们讲一则寓言。

en: Fancy is a pleasant girl with a cheerful face. She is a good friend of mine.
zh: 范西是一个可爱的女孩，她脸上总是洋溢着喜悦。她是我的好朋友。

en: The British government is faced with a sharp increase in refugee issues.
zh: 英国政府面临着难民问题的急剧增加。

en: The fact that I didn't have enough experience was really a big disadvantage.
zh: 我没有足够的经验，这确实是一个很大的劣势。

en: The people there did not allow them to set up a factory so as not to pollute the water in the river.
zh: 为防止污染河水，那里的人不允许他们在那儿建立工厂。

en: Hollywood was on strike because labor and management failed to reach a new deal.
zh: 由于劳方和资方未能达成新的协议，好莱坞陷入了停工状态。

en: You will fail the English exam unless you practise it more after class.
zh: 如果课后不多练习，你英语考试会不及格。
rewrite: You will fail the English exam if you don't practise it more after class.

en: Your brother failed the English test last week, didn't he?
zh: 上周你弟弟的英语考试不及格，是吗？

en: She tries to be fair to all her employees.
zh: 她尽量公平对待所有雇员。

en: She had fair skin that burned easily in the sun.
zh: 她皮肤白皙，在阳光下容易晒伤。

en: A book fair is held here each year.
zh: 每年这里都要举办书展。

en: The leaves will fall from the trees.
zh: 树叶会从树上落下。

en: He was elected a judge in the fall of 2024.
zh: 他于 2024 年秋天当选为法官。

en: Since you have been in Beijing for many years, you must be quite familiar with the city.
zh: 既然你已经在北京待了很多年，你一定很熟悉这座城市。

en: Pan Zhanle is a world-famous sports star. His name is familiar to almost everybody in China.
zh: 潘展乐是世界著名的体育明星。他的名字在中国家喻户晓。

en: I will take a holiday with my family as I finish all the exams.
zh: 考试一结束，我就会与家人一起去度假。

en: We are surprised to learn the death of the famous French actor.
zh: 我们惊讶地获悉那位法国著名影星的死讯。

en: His fans are satisfied with his latest work.
zh: 他的粉丝对他的新作感到满意。

en: It was far from my home.
zh: 那个地方离我家很远。

en: Mr. Lin gave us the further information about the competition by email just now.
zh: 林先生刚刚通过电子邮件给我们发来了关于比赛的进一步信息。

en: Tom checked his homework far more carefully than me.
zh: 汤姆检查作业比我仔细得多。

en: What's the first-class fare from Chicago to Los Angeles?
zh: 从芝加哥到洛杉矶的头等舱费用是多少？

en: Uncle Tom is a farmer. He keeps many sheep on his farm and leads a happy life.
zh: 汤姆叔叔是个农民。他在农场养了许多羊，且过着幸福的生活。

en: The farmer looked sadly at the flooded field and he became sadder and sadder.
zh: 这个农民忧郁地望着被洪水淹没的田地，他变得越来越悲伤。

en: Don't easily follow a fashion. Being yourself is the best rule.
zh: 不要轻易跟风(跟着时尚走)，做你自己是最好的准则。

en: Simon is a fast runner. John runs even faster. But Liu Xiang runs fastest.
zh: 西蒙跑得很快。约翰跑得更快。但刘翔跑得最快。

en: That clock's an hour fast.
zh: 那个钟快了一个小时。

en: She got quickly into her car and fastened the seat-belt.
zh: 她迅速钻进她的车里并系紧安全带。

en: You will become fatter and fatter if you don't go on a diet.
zh: 如果你不节食，会变得越来越胖。
rewrite: You will become fatter and fatter unless you go on a diet.

en: I don't eat much fat, for example, fatty meat.
zh: 我吃的脂肪不多，比如肥肉。

en: Wendy's father helped her invent a new way of doing business.
zh: 温迪的父亲帮助她发明了一种新的经商方式。

en: Could you please do me a favour?
zh: 你能帮我个忙吗？

en: National Treasure is one of my favourite TV shows.
zh: 《国家宝藏》是我最喜欢的电视节目之一。

en: Chocolate ice cream is Helen's favourite.
zh: 巧克力冰淇淋是海伦的最爱。

en: Bob seldom has meals in restaurants for fear of spending too much money, does he?
zh: 鲍勃因怕花费太多很少在餐馆吃饭，是吗？

en: My birthday is in February.
zh: 我的生日在2月。

en: Everyday after dinner the kind girl often goes to our campus to feed homeless cats.
zh: 每天晚饭后，这个善良的女孩经常去我们的校园喂流浪猫。

en: She felt terribly guilty for forgetting her best friend's 15th birthday.
zh: 她因为忘了最好朋友的15岁生日而深感愧疚。

en: She won the award for best female artist.
zh: 她荣膺最佳女艺术家奖。

en: The boy vaulted over the fence.
zh: 男孩翻身跳过围栏。

en: I haven't decided which ferry I shall take to Hong Kong Island.
zh: 我还没有决定坐哪一班渡轮去香港岛。
rewrite: I haven't decided which ferry to take to Hong Kong Island.

en: Thousands of people went travelling during the Spring Festival.
zh: 成千上万的人在春节期间去旅行了。

en: My uncle Jim had a high fever.
zh: 我叔叔吉姆发高烧了。

en: Few of the beach houses still had lights on.
zh: 海滩上的房子几乎没有亮着灯的。

en: With the help of their teachers, they have made fewer mistakes this term than before.
zh: 在老师的帮助下，他们这学期犯的错误比以前少多了。

en: There are so many heroes from different fields working together.
zh: 有那么多来自不同领域的杰出人物在一起工作。

en: The two armies fought together for freedom and independence.
zh: 这两支军队为了自由与独立并肩作战。

en: She has a fight with her mum about staying out late.
zh: 她因为在外面待得太晚和她妈妈吵了一架。

en: The dress she wore highlighted her elegant figure.
zh: 她穿的那条裙子突显了她优雅的体形。

en: She quickly figured the final budget for the event.
zh: 她很快计算出了活动最终预算。

en: Now, please fill out this form.
zh: 现在请您完整填写这张表格。

en: Could you tell me when the film will start tomorrow evening?
zh: 你能否告诉我明天晚上的电影什么时候放映？

en: In some cases, you can hardly tell who is the final winner.
zh: 在某些情况下，你很难分辨出谁是最后的赢家。

en: Finally, Grace made up her mind to live abroad with her daughter.
zh: 最后，格雷丝决定去国外与女儿一起生活。

en: Finally, many readers are already trying to guess what will happen in Harry Potter.
zh: 最后，许多读者已经开始猜测《哈利·波特》中会发生什么。

en: The detective wants to know what Mr. Jones found in the room.
zh: 侦探想知道琼斯先生在房间里找到了什么。

en: Join us, and you'll find learning English can be enjoyable and wonderful.
zh: 加入我们，你会发现学习英语相当有趣和快乐。

en: This was her fourth time to visit the Great Wall, but she still found it amazing.
zh: 这是她第四次游览长城，可她依旧觉得这里令人惊叹。

en: It is a fine Wednesday morning.
zh: 这是一个晴朗的周三早晨。

en: One of his fingers was wounded. What about the others?
zh: 他的一根手指受伤了。其他的呢？

en: Jenny can ask her teacher for help if she can't finish writing the report by herself.
zh: 如果珍妮自己不能完成报告的话，她可以求助于她的老师。

en: Without fires, the oldest and largest trees would stop sunlight from reaching the forest floor. Fires can get rid of some of these old trees.
zh: 没有火，那些古老而高大的树会阻挡阳光透入森林，而火恰恰能烧掉这些老树。

en: The officer ordered his men to fire at the enemy.
zh: 军官命令士兵向敌人开火。

en: A fireman usually helps people put out the fire.
zh: 消防员通常帮助人们把火扑灭。

en: There are also fabulous fireworks displays.
zh: 还有精彩的烟火表演。

en: That band was the first rock band to perform at the Bird’s Nest.
zh: 那支乐队是第一支在鸟巢演出的摇滚乐队。

en: The Battle of Shanghai was first performed by Shanghai Acrobatic Troupe and Shanghai Circus School in 2019. 2019
zh: 年，《战上海》首次由上海杂技团和上海马戏学校演出。

en: From the very first, we knew the project would be a success.
zh: 从一开始，我们就知道这个项目会成功。

en: Damin taught his grandsons how they could catch more fish.
zh: 达明教他的孙子如何能捕到更多的鱼。
rewrite: Damin taught his grandsons how to catch more fish.

en: It is better to teach a man to fish than to give him fish.
zh: 授人以鱼，不如授人以渔。

en: Did you see several fishermen sitting on the beach, repairing their nets?
zh: 你看到几个渔夫坐在海滩上修补渔网了吗？

en: Do you have any ready-made clothes that will fit me?
zh: 你们这儿有适合我穿的成衣吗？

en: You look very fit.
zh: 你看上去很健康。

en: Perhaps Sam can fix your TV set.
zh: 或许萨姆能修好你的电视机。

en: We mixed up our basket with theirs, but we soon fixed it.
zh: 我们把自己的篮子和他们的弄混了，但很快就分清了。

en: Our flag is red and yellow.
zh: 我们的旗帜是红黄两色的。

en: Everything will be all right in a flash.
zh: 转瞬间什么事情都会好的。

en: My uncle lives on the twentieth floor. The flat has a nice view of the Huangpu River.
zh: 我叔叔住在20楼。这套房间能看到黄浦江的美景。

en: The road was flat and easy to drive on.
zh: 道路平坦且易于驾驶。

en: Our plans need to be flexible enough to cater (
zh:
满足) for the needs of everyone.
我们的计划必须能够变通，以满足每个人的需要。

en: Would you please find out the time of my flight for me?
zh: 请帮我查一下这个航班的起飞时间，好吗？

en: The flood deposited a layer of mud.
zh: 洪水过后沉积了一层泥浆。

en: I have bought a new flat and it's on the eighth floor of the building.
zh: 我买了一套新公寓，它在这栋楼的8楼。

en: There were so many beautiful flowers on show at the park yesterday.
zh: 昨天在公园有这么多美丽的鲜花展示。

en: He had come down with the flu before he could board his flight.
zh: 他在登机前染上了流感。

en: My parents spent two hours flying to Beijing.
zh: 我的父母坐了两个小时飞机到北京。
rewrite: It took my parents two hours to get to Beijing by plane.

en: I can fly a kite.
zh: 我会放风筝。

en: You can see lots of flies flying inside the dirty restaurant.
zh: 你可以在那家脏乱的餐馆里看到许多苍蝇飞来飞去。

en: Their talks are expected to focus on arms control.
zh: 他们的会谈预计会聚焦于军备控制问题。

en: I would follow your advice.
zh: 我会听从你的劝告。

en: I had my first date with Polly the following evening.
zh: 第二天晚上，我和波丽有了第一次约会。

en: I'm very fond of country music.
zh: 我非常喜欢乡村音乐。

en: This truck is used to deliver frozen food from the factory to the supermarket.
zh: 这辆卡车是用来将冷冻食品从工厂运送到超市的。

en: Is it possible that I am a fool?
zh: 难道我是一个傻瓜吗？

en: I’ve been fooled!
zh: 我被骗了。

en: I was very foolish to believe him and lend him the money.
zh: 我真蠢，竟相信了他，还借钱给他。

en: My feet hurt awfully.
zh: 我的脚很痛。

en: How about playing football now?
zh: 现在踢足球怎么样？

en: The postman cried out downstairs, “Mr. Anderson, here is a letter for you.”
zh: 邮递员在楼下大叫：“安德森先生，这里有你的信。”

en: They made a rush for the exit.
zh: 他们猛然冲向出口处。

en: By the end of last year, Ben had worked as a postman for ten years.
zh: 到去年年底，本作为一名邮递员已工作了 10 年。

en: For this, he failed.
zh: 由于此原因他失败了。

en: Fortunately for him, he can swim.
zh: 幸亏他会游泳。

en: Prepare to alight, for we are almost there.
zh: 我们马上要到了，准备下车吧。

en: What’s the weather forecast today?
zh: 今天的天气预报怎么说？

en: We’ll forecast the weather.
zh: 我们将预报天气。

en: Most foreign students in our school are used to the changeable weather in Shanghai.
zh: 我们学校的大多数外国学生习惯了上海的易变天气。

en: With the development of China, more and more foreigners will choose to invest in China in the future.
zh: 随着中国的发展，越来越多的外国人将会选择在中国投资。

en: The air in the forest is much fresher than that in the city.
zh: 森林里的空气比城市中的要清新得多。

en: This moment will stay in my memory forever.
zh: 这一刻将永远留在我的记忆中。

en: Never forget to say “Thanks”.
zh: 永远别忘了说“谢谢”。

en: As time passes, he is getting more and more forgetful.
zh: 随着时间的推移，他正变得越来越健忘。

en: Forgive me, I don’t mean to insult you.
zh: 请原谅，我并非有意侮辱你。

en: There is a fork in my one hand, and a knife in my other hand.
zh: 我一手拿叉，另一手拿刀。

en: A test is a form of measuring what students have learned.
zh: 测验是检验学生学习成果的一种方式。

en: Over time, a strong bond formed between the two friends.
zh: 久而久之，一条牢固的纽带在两位朋友之间形成了。

en: We must only look forward.
zh: 我们必须只向前看！

en: Keep going past the fountain.
zh: 一直走，经过那个喷泉。

en: Paris is the capital and largest city of France.
zh: 巴黎是法国的首都和第一大城市。

en: After six months in prison, the famous music producer and director was set free.
zh: 经过6个月的监禁，这位著名的音乐制作人兼导演被释放了。

en: We're old enough to have the freedom to do what we like.
zh: 我们已长大，有自由去做我们喜欢做的事。

en: I left water outside last night and it froze solid.
zh: 我昨晚把水放在外面，结果它冻得结结实实的。

en: If your phone freezes, try holding down the power button to restart it.
zh: 如果手机屏幕卡住了，可以长按电源键重启。

en: I won't feel very cold in freezing weather.
zh: 在极冷的天气下，我也不会感到很冷。

en: The Eiffel Tower is a famous French landmark.
zh: 埃菲尔铁塔是一个著名的法国地标。

en: The French take great pride in their cultural heritage.
zh: 法国人对他们的文化遗产深感自豪。

en: With the help of apps and textbooks, these students teach themselves French.
zh: 在应用程序和课本的帮助下，这些学生自学法语。

en: She kept the windows open to let the fresh air in.
zh: 她把窗户打开，让新鲜空气进来。

en: We moved into the flat last Friday.
zh: 我们是上星期五搬进公寓的。

en: There is some bread in the fridge. It is not necessary to go to the store today.
zh: 冰箱里有一些面包。今天没有必要去商店了。

en: The main dish is a fried steak.
zh: 主菜是煎牛排。

en: The lady over there is a friend of mine.
zh: 那边的那位女士是我的一个朋友。

en: A friend of hers visited Beijing three days ago.
zh: 她的一位朋友3天前游览了北京。

en: When we were visiting the small town, the people there were very friendly to us.
zh: 我们参观小镇时，那里的人们对我们很友好。

en: Jenny likes the new neighbourhood because people here are friendly.
zh: 珍妮喜欢新小区，因为这儿的人很友好。

en: Real friendship is more valuable than money.
zh: 真正的友谊比金钱更宝贵。

en: What makes you happy in life? Perhaps it is the love of your family or the friendship of your classmates.
zh: 是什么使你的生活快乐？也许是你家人的爱或是同学的友谊。

en: Even a mouse can frighten a guilty man.
zh: 做贼心虚。

en: My dog is gentle and never bites, so you needn't be frightened.
zh: 我的狗很温驯，从不咬人，所以你不必害怕。

en: My trip to Phuket Island was really a frightening experience.
zh: 我的普吉岛之旅真是一次可怕的经历。

en: How far is it from the office to your home?
zh: 从办公室到你家有多远？

en: One starry night, when the seven little dwarfs went back home from work, they found something unusual at once.
zh: 一个星光灿烂的夜晚，当七个小矮人下班回家，他们立刻发现了一些不同寻常的东西。

en: The meeting will last from 2 p.m. to 4 p.m.
zh: 会议将从下午 2 点持续到 4 点。

en: The restaurant is only a few blocks away from my house.
zh: 这家餐厅离我家只有几个街区的距离。

en: She received some gifts from her friend.
zh: 她收到了来自朋友的礼物。

en: The front seats are sold out.
zh: 前排的座位已经售罄。

en: I'm in front of you.
zh: 我在你前面。

en: I don't think I like frozen food. It's not fresh.
zh: 我想我不喜欢冷冻食品。它不新鲜。

en: It's important to eat a variety of fruits and vegetables.
zh: 吃各种各样的水果和蔬菜很重要。

en: They ran out of fuel.
zh: 他们的燃料用完了。

en: If you are full of confidence, you'll be happy all the time.
zh: 如果你充满自信，你会一直开开心心。

en: What great fun it is to have a barbecue in the park on such a sunny day!
zh: 在这样一个晴朗的日子，在公园烧烤是多么有趣啊！

en: It is not nice to make fun of someone because of their appearance.
zh: 因为别人的外貌而取笑他们是不好的。

en: Mark Twain's stories are funny and full of surprising events of his childhood.
zh: 马克·吐温的故事很有趣，里面都是他童年时期的奇闻趣事。

en: I wonder if the floor can support such a weight of furniture.
zh: 我不知这地板能否承受住这样重的家具。

en: Now we live further away from the city centre.
zh: 现在我们住得离市中心更远了。

en: She took the new job to further her career.
zh: 她接受了这项新工作以进一步发展她的事业。

en: We need further consideration on this matter.
zh: 我们需要更深入地考虑此事。

en: We should take serious responsibilities and work for a better future.
zh: 我们应当承担起重大的责任，为更美好的未来而努力。

en: Gaining knowledge through experience is more valuable than learning from books.
zh: 通过实践获得知识比从书本上学更有价值。

en: No pain, no gain.
zh: 一份耕耘，一份收获。

en: Online games are very interesting, but we can't spend too much time on them.
zh: 网络游戏很有趣，但我们不能花太多时间。

en: Football is a team game.
zh: 足球是一项团队运动。

en: The game lasted 2 hours.
zh: 比赛进行了两个小时。

en: How happily Little Tommy is playing with his cousin in the garden!
zh: 小汤米和他的表弟在花园里玩耍多么快乐！

en: A lot of gases are harmful.
zh: 有许多气体是有害的。

en: A friend of theirs is waiting for the manager at the gate of the company.
zh: 他们的一个朋友正在公司门口等经理。

en: This is the general trend.
zh: 这是总体趋势。

en: A soldier who doesn't want to be a general is not a good soldier.
zh: 不想当将军的士兵不是好士兵。

en: Some famous speeches in history have left a lasting impact on future generations.
zh: 历史上一些著名的演讲对后世产生了深远的影响。

en: She is a warmhearted, generous old lady.
zh: 她是一位热心、慷慨的老太太。

en: I want to play with the gentle cat.
zh: 我想和那只温驯的猫玩耍。

en: I am a gentleman.
zh: 我是一个绅士。

en: Ladies and gentlemen, we'll arrive in Shanghai.
zh: 女士们、先生们，我们将到达上海。

en: He picked the injured bird up gently.
zh: 他小心翼翼地捡起受伤的小鸟。

en: Geography is an important subject.
zh: 地理是一门很重要的学科。

en: They are Germans, so they can speak German.
zh: 他们是德国人，所以他们会说德语。

en: Do you think the Germans clever?
zh: 你认为德国人聪明吗？

en: Shall we have lunch at the German restaurant?
zh: 我们在德国餐厅吃午饭好吗？

en: Do you know what the population of Germany is?
zh: 你知道德国的人口是多少？

en: After taking tennis classes, Tim is getting much stronger than he was one year ago.
zh: 上了网球课之后，蒂姆比一年前强壮多了。

en:
— She looked unhappy today. What's wrong with her?
— She got a "D" in English.
zh:
——她今天看上去不高兴。她怎么了？
——英语她得了一个“D”。

en: I got to the station at half past four.
zh: 我于4点半到达车站。

en: Lucy has got a lovely pet dog. Its name is Taffy.
zh: 露西有一条可爱的宠物狗。它的名字叫“太妃糖”。

en: It's our family tradition to exchange gifts on New Year's Eve.
zh: 在除夕夜交换礼物是我们家的传统。

en: It was unusual for such a little girl to solve this hard problem in ten minutes.
zh: 对于这样一个小女孩，在10分钟内就解决了这个棘手的问题，太不寻常了。

en: What a useful suggestion you have given me!
zh: 你给我的建议是多么有用啊！

en: On leaving school, all the students felt thankful to the teachers for giving them a good education.
zh: 离开学校时，所有的学生都感谢老师给了他们良好的教育。

en: I am glad to hear from you.
zh: 我很高兴收到你的来信。

en: I will be glad to do it for you.
zh: 我很乐意为你做这件事。

en: It is said that eight glasses of water a day can help you keep fit.
zh: 有人说，每天 8 杯水可以帮助你保持健康。

en: The glasses are made of fine glass.
zh: 眼镜是由优质玻璃制成的。

en: Mike hurt one of his feet in an accident yesterday. Shall we go and see him after school?
zh: 昨天的事故中迈克伤了一只脚。放学后我们去看看他好吗？

en: I won't go to the party unless I'm invited.
zh: 除非我受到邀请，否则我不会去参加聚会。

en: Finally, Jack achieved his goal and became the owner of a company.
zh: 最后，杰克实现了他的目标，成为了一家公司的老板。

en: She kicked the ball into the net, scoring a goal for her team.
zh: 她把球踢进球网，为球队得了分。

en: Fire is the test of gold.
zh: 真金不怕火炼。

en: Her hair is golden.
zh: 她的头发是金黄色的。

en: Nadal is a good tennis player, but I think Djokovic is better.
zh: 纳达尔是一名优秀的网球运动员，但我认为德约科维奇更优秀。

en: The government is going to widen the road this coming summer.
zh: 政府打算今年夏天拓宽道路。

en: Kitty is in Grade Eight.
zh: 姬蒂读八年级。

en: He received a failing grade.
zh: 他得了一个不及格的成绩。

en: Mum has been working in this school since she graduated from university in 2000.
zh: 妈妈自 2000 年大学毕业后就一直在这所学校工作。

en: Li Fang is a graduate of Fudan University.
zh: 李芳是一名复旦大学的毕业生。

en: Does Jane often read newspapers to her 90-year-old grandma after school?
zh: 放学后，简经常给她 90 岁的奶奶读报吗？

en: My grandpa is so forgetful that he always leaves things about.
zh: 我的爷爷很健忘，他总是到处丢东西。

en: Wine is made from grapes.
zh: 葡萄酒由葡萄酿制而成。

en: She was very frightened at the sight of a snake on the grass.
zh: 看到草地上的蛇，她很害怕。

en: The great ship Titanic went down into the water and over 1,500 lives were lost.
zh: 巨轮“泰坦尼克号”沉入水中，1500 多人失去了生命。

en: We are very thankful to our teachers for their great help.
zh: 我们非常感谢老师给予的巨大帮助。

en: It is great for me to see her.
zh: 看见她对我来说真好。

en: Don't start moving the car until the traffic lights change to green.
zh: 交通信号灯变绿之前，不要启动汽车。

en: I like green grass.
zh: 我喜欢青草。

en: There are a lot of beans in the greenhouse.
zh: 暖房里有许多豆子。

en: When you first meet the interviewer, greet him or her politely.
zh: 当你第一次见到面试官时，必须有礼貌地向他或她打招呼。

en: Look out! There is a dead cat on the ground.
zh: 小心！地上有一只死猫！

en: The STEM course in our school requires students to do some projects in groups.
zh: 我们学校的 STEM 课程要求学生分组完成一些项目。

en: She has grown up.
zh: 她长大了！

en: Grandpa grew vegetables in his garden.
zh: 爷爷在他的园子里种了蔬菜。

en: As the days passed, her love for literature grew stronger.
zh: 随着时间的推移，她对文学的热爱变得愈发强烈。

en: I guess you are right.
zh: 我想你是对的！

en: His guess about the outcome of the game turned out to be correct.
zh: 他对比赛结果的猜测是正确的。

en: All the guests are pleased with the restaurant for its excellent service.
zh: 所有的客人都对这家餐厅的优质服务表示满意。

en: You can follow the guide.
zh: 你可以跟着导游。

en: Can you pass me the travel guide?
zh: 你能将旅行指南递给我吗？

en: The GPS system guided us safely to our destination in the unfamiliar city.
zh: 在陌生的城市里，导航系统将我们安全引到了目的地。

en: She was trying to teach him to play the guitar.
zh: 她在试着教他弹吉他。

en: Put the gun down!
zh: 把枪放下！

en: To improve your writing skills, you'd better develop a habit of reading.
zh: 为了提高写作技巧，你最好养成阅读习惯。

en: The beautiful girl has long hair.
zh: 这个美丽的小女孩有一头长发。

en: Joe spent nearly half a year planning his journey around the world.
zh: 乔用了将近半年的时间来规划他的环球之旅。

en: We will meet at half past four.
zh: 我们将在4点半集合。

en: There was hardly anything interesting in today's party. We all left the hall early.
zh: 今天的派对几乎没什么有趣的。我们都很早离开了会堂。

en: Would you like to eat a hamburger?
zh: 你想吃一个汉堡吗？

en: Although Liu Wei has no hands, he can play the piano very beautifully.
zh: 虽然刘伟没有手，但他能非常优美地弹奏钢琴。

en: He handed me the glass.
zh: 他把玻璃杯递给了我。

en: Hand in please!
zh: 请交上来！

en: He was the last man to be hanged for murder in this country.
zh: 他是这个国家里最后一个因谋杀被处绞刑的人。

en: The picture used to hang here and there are some marks on the wall.
zh: 这幅画以前挂在这儿，墙上还有些痕迹呢。

en: The fight happened so quickly that nobody could describe the start and the finish of it.
zh: 这场打斗发生得太快，以至于没人能描述它是怎么开始和结束的。

en: They happened to see the famous Chinese tennis player at the airport yesterday.
zh: 他们昨天碰巧在机场看到了那位著名的中国网球运动员。

en: Mary and Peter are playing happily.
zh: 玛丽和彼得快乐地玩耍着。

en: I want to live happily.
zh: 我想生活幸福。

en: Diligence is the path leading to happiness.
zh: 勤劳是获得幸福的途径。

en:
— Happy birthday! Here is a present for you.
— Thank you!
zh:
——祝你生日快乐！这是送给你的礼物。
——谢谢！

en: Every student in Grade Nine is studying hard to achieve more.
zh: 为了获得更多的知识，九年级的每一位学生都在努力学习。

en: It's hard to eat the hard bread.
zh: 硬面包不好啃。

en: Becoming a better person would not be hard if you follow all these instructions.
zh: 如果你遵循这些指示，要成为一个更好的人是不难的。

en: Linda, pass my glasses to me, please. I can hardly read the words in the newspaper.
zh: 琳达，请把我的眼镜递给我。报纸上的字我几乎看不清。

en: It hardly snows in Shanghai in winter, does it?
zh: 上海的冬天几乎不下雪，是吗？

en: The Chinese nation is hardworking and brave.
zh: 中华民族是勤劳勇敢的。

en: Don't harm your eyes by reading in dim light.
zh: 不要在昏暗的灯光下看书，以免损伤眼睛。

en: It wouldn't do any harm to ask for advice.
zh: 向别人征询建议是不会有任何害处的。

en: The organisation has set strict rules on the release of harmful chemicals.
zh: 该组织对有害化学品的排放制定了严格的规定。

en: The red hat is too small to wear.
zh: 这顶红帽子太小了，不能戴。

en: I hate to see posers showing off.
zh: 我最恨看装腔作势的人一副卖弄的样子。

en: Dad sometimes goes to the supermarket with us though he hates going shopping.
zh: 爸爸虽然讨厌购物，但有时会和我们一起去超市。

en: I was seventeen and filled with a lot of hate.
zh: 我那时 17 岁，满腔仇恨。

en: I have something important to discuss with Tim. I will wait for Tim until he gets back.
zh: 我有一些重要的事情要与蒂姆讨论。我会一直等到他回来。

en: Could you tell me when we will have a meeting?
zh: 你能告诉我，我们什么时候开会吗？

en: She had a fever last night.
zh: 她昨晚发烧了。

en: We've never seen a more amazing creature. It has no head but is alive.
zh: 我们从没见过比这更令人惊异的生物。它没有头，但是活的。

en: I have a terrible headache.
zh: 我头痛得厉害。

en: The headline is important.
zh: 大标题很重要。

en: The headmaster gave a wonderful speech despite the rain.
zh: 校长冒雨发表了一场精彩的演讲。

en: Smoking is harmful to our health.
zh: 吸烟有害健康。

en: Healthy eating and doing exercise every day can keep us fit.
zh: 健康饮食和每天运动能让我们保持健康。

en: Can you speak louder, please? I can't hear you clearly.
zh: 你可以大声一点吗？我听不清楚。

en:
— Billy lost his bike yesterday and had to walk home.
— Oh, I'm sorry to hear that.
zh:
——昨天比利的自行车丢了，他只好步行回家。
——哦，听到这个消息我很抱歉。

en: We heard two people arguing when we walked past that area.
zh: 当我们走过那个地方的时候，听到两人正在争论。

en: I will remember you in my heart.
zh: 我将把你记在心中。

en: The sun gives off heat.
zh: 太阳散发出热量。

en: The stove heats the room.
zh: 暖炉使房间暖和起来。

en: The gentleman lost his temper for the first time and shut the door heavily when he left.
zh: 这位绅士第一次发了脾气。他离开时重重地关上了门。

en: How heavy is that typewriter? = What is the typewriter's weight?
zh: 那台打字机有多重？

en: Jim is of average height in our class, but he is still taller than Tommy.
zh: 吉姆在我们班身高中等，但他仍比汤米高。

en: Hello, how are you?
zh: 喂，你好吗？

en: Can you help me to get some help?
zh: 你能帮我找人帮个忙吗？

en: Professor Wang personally thanked everyone who helped with the project.
zh: 王教授亲自向所有为这个项目提供过帮助的人表示了感谢。

en: The students have recently finished their group project with the teacher's help.
zh: 在老师的帮助下，同学们最近完成了他们的小组课题。

en: But have you ever heard of a forest fire that can be helpful for a forest?
zh: 但你有没有听说过森林火灾有助于森林生态的发展呢？

en: The Greeks were glad to find the wooden horse was helpful in capturing the city.
zh: 希腊人很高兴地发现这匹木马对攻占这座城市很有帮助。

en: The mother felt so helpless when she knew her child was seriously ill.
zh: 当这位母亲得知自己的孩子病得很重时，她感到非常无助。

en: I was born here. I'm quite familiar with the streets in this town.
zh: 我出生在这里。我对这个小镇的街道相当熟悉。

en: Though they are really great, they have never thought of themselves as heroes.
zh: 虽然他们真的很伟大，但他们从来没有认为是英雄。

en: I'm still hesitating.
zh: 我仍然在犹豫。

en: The boy hid in the tree.
zh: 这个小男孩躲在树里。

en: Nowadays the oil price in the world is getting much higher than before.
zh: 如今世界上的石油价格比以前高得多。

en: Shanghai Tower is one of the highest buildings in Shanghai.
zh: 上海中心大厦是上海最高建筑物之一。

en: I got out of breath running up the hill from the station.
zh: 我从车站跑上山顶，连气都喘不上来了。

en: The book is based on historical events.
zh: 这本书是根据历史事件写成的。

en: Southwold, a seaside town in England, has a history of more than thirteen centuries.
zh: 索思沃尔德，一个英国海边的小镇，有1300多年的历史。

en: You hit my head.
zh: 你打了我的头。

en: The company's sales hit a record high last quarter.
zh: 公司上季度的销售额达到了历史新高。

en: You know Mike's hobby is playing football, but mine is collecting stamps.
zh: 你知道迈克的爱好是踢足球，但我的爱好是集邮。

en: I can hold the baby.
zh: 我能抱这个小孩。

en: The Eighth China International Import Expo was held successfully in Shanghai.
zh: 第八届中国国际进口博览会在上海成功举办。

en: This hall can hold more than one hundred people.
zh: 这个大厅可以容纳100多人。

en: She held the door open for her friend as they entered the building.
zh: 进楼的时候她为朋友们把着门。

en: The hole is too small, I cannot push my arm through.
zh: 这个洞太小了, 我的胳膊伸不过去。

en:
—I will fly to Qingdao for my holiday this weekend.
—Wonderful!
zh:
——这个周末我将飞往青岛度假。
——太好了!

en: Frank works with others from home through computers.
zh: 弗兰克在家里通过电脑与其他人联系办公。

en: We have spent all our money, so we have to walk home now.
zh: 我们已经花光了所有的钱, 所以现在不得不步行回家。

en: The earthquake in that country left thousands of people homeless.
zh: 发生在那个国家的地震使成千上万的人无家可归。

en: He returned to his hometown in the spring of 1917.
zh: 他在 1917 年的春天回到了家乡。

en: Don't go out of the classroom until your homework is finished.
zh: 做完家庭作业前不准离开教室。

en: Children are educated to be honest when they are very young.
zh: 在孩子们还很小的时候, 就要教育他们诚实。

en: Honesty is the most important thing for a person.
zh: 对一个人来说，诚实是最重要的。

en: I like to eat honey.
zh: 我喜欢吃蜂蜜。

en: “Good morning, honey,” Mum said with a smile. “
zh: 早上好，宝贝。”妈妈笑着说。

en: It is an honour for me to be chosen as a group leader of our class project.
zh: 被选为我们班级项目的组长，对我来说是一种荣誉。

en: If we don't give up hope, we will surely succeed.
zh: 如果我们不放弃希望，我们一定会成功的。

新的国家博物馆占地面积 20 万平方米，已成为世界上最大的
