zh: 他给我们作了一次有关物理学的演讲。

en: Put up your left hand.
zh: 举起左手。

en: Turn left!
zh: 向左转！

en: The bank is on your left.
zh: 银行在你的左边。

en: A spider has 8 legs.
zh: 一只蜘蛛有 8 条腿。

en: There is something wrong with my computer, so Mary lent me hers.
zh: 我的电脑坏了，玛丽就把她的借给了我。

en: The length of that bridge is over 200 metres.
zh: 那座桥的长度超过了 200 米。

en: If Tony isn't careful enough with his lesson, more mistakes will be made later.
zh: 托尼如果不仔细做功课，他以后将犯更多的错误。

en: Don't let such a thing happen again, or you will lose your job!
zh: 不要让这样的事情再次发生，否则你会失去你的工作！

en: They let me have a look at the new flat.
zh: 他们让我去看了这套新公寓。

en:
— What did your son say in the letter?
— He told me that he would visit the Disney World the next day.
zh:
——你儿子在信里说什么了？
——他告诉我他第二天要去迪士尼世界。

en: This is a high level conference on economy.
zh: 这是一场有关经济的高水平交流会。

en: Benjamin is a librarian.
zh: 本杰明是个图书馆管理员。

en: I’ve borrowed two books from our school library.
zh: 我从学校图书馆借了2本书。

en: Don’t tell lies. Nobody likes those dishonest people.
zh: 不要说假话。没有人喜欢那些不诚实的人。

en: Whenever Jerry lies, he doesn’t dare to look at me.
zh: 每当杰瑞说谎时，他都不敢看我。

en: Gork lay down on his bed.
zh: 高克躺在床上。

en: The firefighter helped operate the rescue equipment, saving many lives.
zh: 这位消防员帮忙操作救援设备，救下了许多生命。

en: These creative pictures truly bring every character and scene to life!
zh: 这些创意画作让每个角色和场景都栩栩如生！

en: Everybody needs a shoulder to cry on sometime in his life.
zh: 每个人在他人生的某个时刻都需要有个肩膀来哭泣。

en: I cannot lift this box.
zh: 我举不起这个盒子。

en: The lift is out of order again.
zh: 这部电梯又出故障了。

en: People turn off their lights for an hour on Earth Day every year.
zh: 每年地球日那天，人们关灯一个小时。

en: — I like light music better than pop music. — Me too.
zh: ——比起流行音乐我更喜欢轻音乐。——我也是。

en: She used a match to light the candles on the birthday cake.
zh: 她用火柴点燃了生日蛋糕上的蜡烛。

en: They had hobbies like fishing and sailing.
zh: 他们爱好捕鱼和出海。

en: We must solve this problem like detectives studying clues.
zh: 我们必须像侦探探查线索那样解决这个问题。

en: How do you like the film Avatar?
zh: 电影《阿凡达》你认为怎么样？

en: Generally speaking, I don't enjoy swimming, but I'd like to swim this afternoon.
zh: 总的来说，我不喜欢游泳，但今天下午我想去游泳。

en: The organisers are very likely to cancel the fireworks display.
zh: 主办方很有可能会取消烟花表演。

en: Profit will most likely have risen by about $25 million.
zh: 利润将极有可能增长约 2500 万美元。

en: There is a limit to the amount of pain we can bear.
zh: 我们对疼痛的忍耐是有限度的。

en: He limited payments on the country's foreign debt.
zh: 他对该国外债的偿还作出了限制。

en: Fresh water is so limited that we can't waste it any more.
zh: 净水如此有限，我们再也不能浪费。

en: The middle line has seven words.
zh: 中间的一行有7个单词。

en: This factory uses advanced robots to operate the production lines.
zh: 这家工厂使用先进的机器人来操作生产线。

en: The line on the graph shows a steady increase in sales over the past year.
zh: 图表上的线条显示了过去一年销售额稳步增长。

en: My stomach is growling. Let's line up.
zh: 我饿得肚子咕咕叫，我们排队吧。

en: Some people link the world warming to the El Nino Phenomenon.
zh: 有些人把全球气温上升跟厄尔尼诺现象联系在一起。

en: Do you know the link between smoking and lung cancer?
zh: 吸烟和肺癌之间的关系，你知道吗？

en: She was frightened by the roars of a lion.
zh: 她被狮子的吼叫声吓呆了。

en: Air is a fluid but not a liquid.
zh: 空气是流体而不是液体。

en: The medicine was in liquid form, making it easy to swallow.
zh: 这药是液体的，很容易吞服。

en: Please choose three books from the list for your winter reading.
zh: 请从这份书单里挑选三本书作为你的寒假读物。

en: The travel agency will list the available tour packages on their website.
zh: 旅行社将在他们的网站上列出可用的旅行套餐。

en: How wonderful the music is! I will listen to it again.
zh: 这音乐多么美妙！我会再听一遍的。

en: Don't leave litter everywhere.
zh: 不要把垃圾扔得到处都是。

en: If you litter, you will spoil the natural beauty of the surroundings.
zh: 如果你随手乱扔垃圾的话，就会破坏周围环境的自然美。

en: There is little pollution here in Shanghai, is there?
zh: 上海这里很少有污染，是吗？

en: The Shanghai Airport Link Line will be open to traffic, so it will take us less time to go to Pudong International Airport.
zh: 上海机场联络线将要通车，所以我们去浦东国际机场会花费更少时间。

en: I have seen him very little recently.
zh: 最近我很少见到他。

en: Little remains to be done about it.
zh: 关于这一点，几乎没有什么可做的。

en: Miss Wang has got a big room to live in.
zh: 王小姐住在一间大房间里。

en: This is my favourite live album of all time.
zh: 这是我有史以来最喜爱的现场版专辑。

en: During the war, the old lady was protected by a local family in Shanghai in her fifties.
zh: 战争期间，这位老妇人在她 50 多岁时受到上海一户人家的保护。

en: I'm a local.
zh: 我是本地人。

en: Where shall we locate our new office building?
zh: 我们的新办公楼将坐落于何处？

en: It also shows the location of the products.
zh: 它还显示了产品的摆放位置。

en: A golden key will open every lock.
zh: 金钥匙可以打开每一把锁。

en: Lock the door when you're away.
zh: 不在家时，门要锁上。

en: What time does the train from London get in?
zh: 从伦敦来的火车何时进站？

en: He doesn't feel lonely when he is left alone.
zh: 在只剩下他一个人的时候，他并不感到孤独。

en: We couldn't believe that it was her real hair because it was so long.
zh: 我们简直不敢相信这是她自己的头发，因为它是那么长。

en: She waited long for the bus to arrive.
zh: 她等了很久才等来公交车。

en: Let's have a look!
zh: 我们去看看！

en: Look at the blackboard, please.
zh: 请看黑板。

en: She looks unhappy today, and she has been very quiet since this morning.
zh: 她今天看起来闷闷不乐，从早上起就一直很安静。

en: Four people were hurt in the car accident, but luckily no lives were lost.
zh: 在车祸中有 4 人受伤，幸好无人丧生。

en: John lost his new calculator on his way to school yesterday.
zh: 昨天约翰在去学校的路上弄丢了他的新计算器。

en: When Andy was unhappy about his lost smartphone, his friend gave him a big hug.
zh: 当安迪为丢失了智能手机而郁闷时，他的朋友给了他一个大大的拥抱。

en: The intricate plot of the movie left many viewers feeling lost.
zh: 这部电影错综复杂的情节让许多观众感到困惑。

en: Lots of students went to the school hall to enjoy the wonderful paintings by Mr. Hu.
zh: 很多学生前往学校礼堂来欣赏胡先生的精彩画作。

en: The music is too loud. Could you turn it down, please?
zh: 音乐声太大了。你可以开得轻一点吗？

en: She spoke loud enough for everyone to hear.
zh: 她大声讲话以便所有人都能听见。

en: The baby cried loudly when he emptied his bottle.
zh: 婴儿一喝完瓶里的东西就大哭起来。

en: The door of parents' love for children will never be closed.
zh: 父母对孩子永远敞开爱的大门。

en: I love you, everyone.
zh: 我爱你们每个人。

en: She looks lovely in the pink dress!
zh: 她穿粉红色连衣裙看起来很可爱！

en: The children are looking happily at these lovely dogs.
zh: 孩子们高兴地看着这些可爱的狗狗们。

en: When prices are low, he buys in.
zh: 价格便宜时他买进。

en: This bird is flying quite low.
zh: 这只鸟飞得相当低。

en: I had the luck to get a ticket.
zh: 我侥幸弄到了一张票。

en: Luckily, the small ship came back safely after a big storm.
zh: 幸运的是，一场大风暴后，小船安全回来了。

en: With the help of the police, Tim was lucky enough to get back his lost bike.
zh: 在警察的帮助下，蒂姆幸运地找回了丢失的自行车。

en: Most Chinese people think that eight is a lucky number.
zh: 大多数中国人认为8是一个幸运数字。

en: I need a cart for my luggage.
zh: 我需要一辆行李车来装行李。

en: Nobody at the lunch table believed the truth of his story.
zh: 在午餐桌上，没人相信他的故事是真的。

en: The silk clothes can't be washed in the washing machine.
zh: 丝绸衣服不可以用洗衣机洗。

en: The noise will drive me mad.
zh: 这噪音会使我发疯的。

en: Look! There is a magazine on the teacher's desk. Is it yours?
zh: 瞧！老师的办公桌上有一本杂志。是你的吗？

en: The magician is going to perform magic at the party.
zh: 这位魔术师将在晚会上表演魔术。

en: As the sun set over the ocean, she captured the magic moment with her camera.
zh: 当太阳在海上落下，她用相机捕捉到了这个神奇的时刻。

en: A postman's job is to deliver mail.
zh: 邮递员的工作就是送邮件。

en: They asked her to mail him a letter.
zh: 他们要她给他寄封信。

en: The main idea of the paragraph usually appears in the first sentence of the paragraph.
zh: 段落的主要意思通常出现在该段的第一句上。

en: The old man's money mainly comes from family business.
zh: 这位老人的财产主要来自家族企业。

en: The two major dancers are level with each other.
zh: 两个主要舞蹈演员水平相当。

en: Mathematics is my major.
zh: 我的专业是数学。

en: Most passengers were talking happily with each other when the bus made a sudden stop.
zh: 当大部分乘客正高兴地交谈时，汽车突然停了下来。

en: Could you please make a plan for our class trip?
zh: 你能为我们的班级旅行做一个计划吗？

en: It has little effect on the study if you make the students write all the time.
zh: 如果你让学生一直写，这对学习几乎是没有效果的。

en: The school master is a male teacher.
zh: 校长是位男老师。

en: He was the only male in the dance class.
zh: 他是舞蹈班里唯一的男性。

en: Look at the photo! The fifth man from the right is my class teacher.
zh: 看照片！从右边起第五个男人是我的班主任。

en: I manage a team of six engineers.
zh: 我管理一个由 6 位工程师组成的小组。

en: With only a few minutes left, they managed to turn the game around.
zh: 只剩几分钟了，他们成功扭转了比赛局势。

en: If you don't like the products, feel free to make a complaint to the manager.
zh: 如果你不喜欢这产品，请随时向经理投诉。

en: People need to work things out in their own manner and in their own time.
zh: 人们需要以自己的方式和时间来处理问题。

en: I won't believe the five-year-old boy can read so many words until I have tested him myself.
zh: 直到我亲自对他进行了测试, 我才相信这个 5 岁的孩子会读这么多的单词。

en: I asked my friends for suggestions, and many were very helpful.
zh: 我向朋友们征求建议, 很多建议都相当有帮助。

en: Emma stopped the car and looked at the map.
zh: 艾玛停下车, 看了一下地图。

en: A large number of trees are planted on March 12 every year.
zh: 每年的 3 月 12 日要种植大量的树木。

en: You will be able to get good marks if you do some revision every day.
zh: 如果你每天都复习一下, 你可以获得好成绩。

en: Please mark where you have some questions.
zh: 在有问题的地方作个记号。

en: Where is the nearest market?
zh: 最近的集市在哪儿?

en: Marry me.
zh: 嫁给我吧。

en: — Our class failed in the school's football match last week. — What a pity!
zh: ——上周学校的足球比赛我们班输了。——多可惜!

en: No one can match him in singing.
zh: 论唱歌谁也比不过他。

en: Jack measured the length of the table to calculate how much material would be needed.
zh: 杰克测量了这张桌子的长度, 以便计算所需材料的用量。

en: Tim spoke so quietly that he was asked to repeat himself in the maths class.
zh: 蒂姆说话太轻了，数学课上他被要求再说一遍。

en: It's a personal matter.
zh: 这是件私事。

en: No matter what they tell us, what we believe is true.
zh: 无论他们告诉我们什么，我们坚信的是真理。

en: Depend on your passion and it will guide you towards what truly matters in life.
zh: 坚守你的热爱，它会指引你找到人生中真正重要的东西。

en: We will leave Beijing on the twenty-fifth of May.
zh: 我们将在5月25日离开北京。

en: You may lose your way if you walk alone in the mountains at night.
zh: 如果晚上你独自一人在山里走，你可能会迷路。

en: — May I park my car here for a while? — No, you mustn't. Do you see the sign “NO PARKING”?
zh: ——我可以把车停在这里一会儿吗？——不，你不能。你看到“禁止停车”的标志吗？

en: It's clouding up. Maybe it'll rain this afternoon.
zh: 天阴起来了，今天下午也许有雨。

en: Linda often helps her parents with the housework after meals.
zh: 琳达饭后经常帮助父母做家务。

en: What do you mean?
zh: 你什么意思？

en: The little girls had locked themselves in upstairs because Mack had been mean to them.
zh: 小姑娘们把自己锁在楼上，因为麦克对她们很刻薄。

en: These words are empty of meaning.
zh: 这些话毫无意义。

en: “Mr. Zhu, you'd better not eat too much meat. You are already overweight,” said the doctor.
zh: 医生说：“朱先生，您最好不要吃太多的肉。您已经超重了。”

en: He has been at the forefront of medical progress for years.
zh: 多年来，他一直处于医学发展的最前沿。

en: How often should you take the medicine?
zh: 这药你应该多长时间服一次？

en: A medium coffee please.
zh: 请给我一杯中杯咖啡。

en: Art serves as a powerful medium for expressing complex emotions and ideas.
zh: 艺术是表达复杂情感和思想的强有力媒介。

en: Guess who I met in Nanjing Road?
zh: 你猜我在南京路遇见了谁？

en: To meet the needs of people from different countries, that book was published in different languages.
zh: 为了满足来自不同国家读者的需求，这本书用不同语种出版。

en: The athletic meet attracted participants from all over the country.
zh: 这次运动会吸引了全国各地的参赛者。

en: The 8th School Sports Meeting was put off because of the heavy rain.
zh: 因下大雨，第8届校运动会推迟了。

en: The meeting between the two leaders was highly anticipated by the media.
zh: 两位领导人的会见备受媒体关注。

en: One member of the surgical team administers the checklist.
zh: 外科小组的一名成员负责管理清单。

en: All the beautiful memories came into my mind when I saw these pictures.
zh: 当我看到这些图片时，所有美好的回忆都涌入我的脑海。

en: Although Mr. Wang is quite old, he still has a good short-term memory.
zh: 虽然王先生年纪很大了，但他仍然有很好的短期记忆力。

en: She did not mention her mother's absence.
zh: 她并没有说起她母亲不在场的事。

en: Could you give us another menu?
zh: 你可以再给我们一份菜单吗？

en: The room was in a mess.
zh: 这个房间杂乱不堪。

en: If you cancel now, you'll mess up all my arrangements.
zh: 如果你现在取消，就会打乱我所有的安排。

en: I telephoned Jane just now, but she wasn't in. I had to leave her a message.
zh: 刚才我打电话给简，但她不在，我不得不给她留下口信。

en: The frame is made of metal.
zh: 这框子是金属做的。

en: He introduced us to a new method of work.
zh: 他向我们介绍了一种新的工作方法。

en: The newly-built bridge is about fifteen metres wide.
zh: 新建的桥大约有15米宽。

en: She placed the vase in the middle of the table.
zh: 她在桌子中间放了个花瓶。

en: The design is the most suitable for middle-aged women.
zh: 这款式最适合中年妇女。

en: He walked for miles yesterday.
zh: 他昨天走了好几英里路。

en: Peter doesn't have bread or milk for breakfast.
zh: 彼得早餐没有吃面包或牛奶。

en: The farmer milks the goats twice a day to collect fresh milk for sale.
zh: 农夫一天挤两次新鲜的山羊奶，收集起来贩卖。

en: Is she still of the same mind?
zh: 她仍持原来的想法吗？

en: — Would you mind my sitting here, sir? — I'm afraid you can't. It's for my wife.
zh: ——先生，你介意我坐在这儿吗？——恐怕不行。这是留给我妻子的。

en: Three minus two is one.
zh: 3 减 2 等于 1。

en: I'm giving him a B minus.
zh: 我准备给他一个 B-。

en: It's five minutes' walk from my home to school. How happy I am!
zh: 从我家走到学校只要5分钟。太高兴了！

en: The Evil Queen has a magic mirror.
zh: 邪恶的皇后有一面魔镜。

en: We were lucky that our cat came home safely after being missing for two days.
zh: 我们很幸运，我们的猫失踪两天后平安回家了。

en: Do you miss the food from your hometown?
zh: 你会惦记家乡的食物吗？

en: Therefore, Miss Jiang called Ms. Brown.
zh: 于是，姜小姐给布朗女士打了电话。

en: The mistakes in the report will be corrected by the group leaders after class.
zh: 小组长下课后将纠正报告中的错误。

en: It was impossible to mistake it.
zh: 那是不可能弄错的。

en: Mix the butter and flour together.
zh: 将黄油和面粉搅拌在一起。

en: The ball is filled with gaseous mixture.
zh: 那个球充满了气体混合物。

en: My father wants to buy a car of this model, but my mother thinks it's too expensive.
zh: 我爸想买一辆这个型号的车，但我妈认为它太贵了。

en: Modern technology helps us realise our dreams in many amazing ways.
zh: 现代科技以许多奇妙的方式帮助我们实现梦想。

en: This is an important moment.
zh: 这是一个重要的时刻。

en: We have seven classes on Monday.
zh: 星期一我们有7节课。

en: Peter doesn’t need any money from his parents because he has found a good job and can earn money by himself.
zh: 彼得不必向他的父母要钱，因为他已经找到一份好工作，可以自己挣钱。

en: How surprised we were to hear of our monitor’s failure in the P.E. test!
zh: 听说我们的班长体育测试不及格，我们太惊讶了！

en: The monkey was swinging in the tree.
zh: 猴子在树上荡来荡去。

en: Mary missed her parents after she had spent a few months abroad.
zh: 在国外生活了几个月后，玛丽非常想念她的父母。

en: He is clearly in a good mood today.
zh: 明摆着，他今天心情不错。

en: What shape is the moon, Mike?
zh: 迈克，月亮是什么形状的？

en: We have a lot more work to do.
zh: 我们还有很多工作要做。

en: David has been in Garden City for more than three months.
zh: 戴维住在花园城市已有3个多月了。

en: The pipeline of deals promises more.
zh: 一系列交易有望带来更多成果。

en: You'd better have a big breakfast in the morning so as not to be hungry before lunch.
zh: 你最好上午吃一顿丰盛的早餐，这样午餐前就不会觉得饿了。

en: The article was written by the reporter on the morning of April 10th.
zh: 本文是记者在 4 月 10 日的早晨写的。

en: The frightening accident happened on a cold morning.
zh: 那起可怕的事故发生在一个寒冷的早晨。

en: Peter made the most mistakes of all the class.
zh: 全班同学中，彼得犯的错最多。

en: It was the most exciting holiday I've ever had.
zh: 那是我经历过的最令人兴奋的假日。

en: Most of the guests arrived early for the party.
zh: 大多数客人都早早来参加派对。

en: My mother is nearly 80 and she's starting to get a bit forgetful.
zh: 我的母亲近 80 岁，她开始有点健忘。

en: Gilbert went there by motorcycle.
zh: 吉尔伯特骑摩托车去的那儿。

en: On the Double Ninth Festival, people usually climb mountains.
zh: 在重阳节，人们通常去爬山。

en: The baby likes to watch Mickey Mouse cartoons best.
zh: 宝宝最喜欢看米老鼠卡通片了。

en: Don't speak with your mouth full.
zh: 嘴里塞满东西时不要讲话。

zh: 在搬进新房子之前，安迪先生想买几件家具。

en: Many historical movies will be shown on National Day.
zh: 许多历史影片将在国庆节上映。

en: He owes a lot of money to Mr Smith.
zh: 他欠史密斯先生许多钱。

en: Mrs Jones gave music lessons at a school.
zh: 琼斯太太在一所学校教音乐。

en: I know how much trouble you have suffered.
zh: 我知道你遭受过多大的痛苦。

en: My deskmate Tom's handwriting is much better than mine.
zh: 我的同桌汤姆的字写得比我的好。

en: She doesn't say much.
zh: 她话不多。

en: You saw her, Mum?
zh: 你看见她了吗，妈妈？

en: The museum has various old things that show the history of our city.
zh: 这座博物馆收藏着各种各样能展现我市历史的古老物件。

en: Do you like mushroom soup?
zh: 你喜欢蘑菇汤吗？

zh: 他演奏的音乐是如此优美。我们都陶醉了。

en: —Must I get everything ready for the discussion before the weekend? —No, you needn't. You may finish that next week.
zh: ——为这次讨论，我必须在周末前准备好一切吗？——不，不需要。你可以在下周完成。

en: My name is Alice. I'm a girl.
zh: 我的名字叫爱丽丝，是一个女孩。

en: Can you name the flower?
zh: 你能叫出这花儿的名字吗？

en: On his way home he came to a narrow bridge over a stream.
zh: 在回家的路上，他来到一座横跨在小河上的窄桥。

en: The nation's economy is growing rapidly.
zh: 这个国家的经济在快速增长。

en: What day is your National Day?
zh: 你们的国庆节是哪一天？

en: What's your nationality, Chinese or Japanese?
zh: 你是什么国籍，中国籍还是日本籍？

en: At the end of every year some people go back to their native homes.
zh: 每年年终，有些人要回故乡去。

en: Are you a native, or just a visitor?
zh: 你是本地人还是游客？

en: Earthquake is one of the natural disasters on the earth.
zh: 地震是地球上的自然灾害之一。

en: Nature is the glass reflecting truth.
zh: 自然是反映真实的镜子。

en: The teacher kept the student in because he was naughty.
zh: 那个学生因为顽皮，放学后被老师留在学校里。

en: Don't play near the road.
zh: 不要在马路附近玩。

en: Can you tell me the nearest way to the station?
zh: 你能告诉我去火车站最近的路吗？

en: Come nearer, please.
zh: 请走近一些。

en: He works in the nearby police station.
zh: 他在附近的警察局工作。

en: Mum has bought a lot of frozen food from the supermarket nearby.
zh: 妈妈从附近超市买了很多冷冻食品。

en: I watch a match nearly every weekend on TV.
zh: 我几乎每个周末都看电视上的比赛。

en: We all want people to like us, so it is necessary for us to do what we can to please others.
zh: 我们都希望别人喜欢我们，所以我们必须做一些能使其他人开心的事情。

en: It is necessary that one should obey the law.
zh: 一个人遵守法律是必要的。

en: You needn't wash your car at the moment. It's going to rain.
zh: 你这会儿不用洗车。要下雨了。

en: I don't need to buy a new pair of shoes.
zh: 我不需要买一双新鞋子。

en: More houses will be built to meet the needs of the citizens.
zh: 为满足市民的需要，将建造更多的房屋。

en: This old woman is my neighbour.
zh: 这个老妇人是我的邻居。

en: We have learned to help our parents at home and people in our neighbourhood.
zh: 我们学会了在家里帮助父母，在小区帮助居民。

en: Peter's parents are good at physics, but neither of them is good at English.
zh: 彼得的父母擅长物理，但他们的英语都不行。

en: They may win the game in neither situation.
zh: 在这两种情况下，他们都不可能赢得比赛。

en: She doesn't like swimming and neither does her sister.
zh: 她和姐姐都不喜欢游泳。

en: Neither Tony nor Frank likes the CD. They think the music is too noisy.
zh: 托尼和弗兰克都不喜欢这张 CD。他们认为音乐太吵。

en: The fishermen are mending their nets.
zh: 渔民们正在补渔网。

en: They have built the national network.
zh: 他们建成了全国性的网络。

en: He never plays football in the street, does he?
zh: 他从不在街上踢足球，是吗？

en: — You never had eight lessons a day last year, did you? — Yes. We only had six or seven a day.
zh: ——去年你们从不一天上 8 节课，是吗？——是的。我们一天只上 6 节课或 7 节课。

en: The girl is so clever that she can memorise all these new words quickly.
zh: 这个女孩很聪明，她很快就能记住所有这些新单词。
rewrite: The girl is clever enough to memorise all these new words quickly.

en: The students have already learned the good news, haven't they?
zh: 学生们已经知道这个好消息了，不是吗？

en: What a wonderful newspaper 21st Century is!
zh: 《21 世纪报》是一份多么好的报纸啊！

zh: 报纸上的这篇报道听起来很真实，但女记者是从哪儿得到的呢？

zh: 巴兹尔告诉我们，下次用电他会小心。

zh: 然后，单击“查看文件”按钮。

zh: 你好，安娜！很高兴认识你。

zh: 享受日出时，看到飞鸟是一件开心的事。
rewrite: It's nice to see birds when enjoying the sunrise.

zh: 小孩每天晚上电视看得太多是有害的。

zh: 我敢肯定，只有你能做这样的事情，别人没有这样的能力。

en: Please be quiet. We are not allowed to make much noise in the reading room.
zh: 请安静。不允许在阅览室里发出噪音。

en: It's too noisy here.
zh: 这里太吵了。

en: —I'm hungry. Is there any bread in the fridge? —None, but we have cakes. Would you like to have one?
zh: ——我饿了。冰箱里有面包吗？——没有，但有蛋糕。你想要一个吗？

en: I think you can have noodles.
zh: 我想你们可以点面条。

zh: 她4点到不了那儿，我也不能。

zh: 这种鱼在北方地区难得看到。

zh: 这条河朝北流。

en: The needle of a compass points to the north.
zh: 罗盘的指针指向北方。

zh: 我的鼻子也是黄色的。

en: Please take the note to the teacher.
zh: 请把这张便条交给老师。

en: Can you help me to change this note?
zh: 你能帮我把这张纸币兑换成零钱吗？

en: Students should learn to protect themselves. Nothing is more important than life.
zh: 学生要学会保护自己。没有什么比生命更重要。

en: We'd better put up a notice here.
zh: 我们最好在这儿贴一张布告。

en: Did you notice him leave the house?
zh: 你注意到他离开那个房子了吗？

en: She spent a peaceful afternoon by the river, reading a novel.
zh: 她在河边看小说，度过了一个宁静的下午。

zh: 美国的感恩节是在11月的第四个星期四。

en: Now let's talk about what a main idea is and how to find out the main idea.
zh: 现在让我们来谈谈什么是主要思想，及如何找出主要思想。

en: Now that all the passengers are here, why don't we start at once?
zh: 既然所有乘客都到了，我们为什么还不出发呢？

en: Nowadays vlogs are much more useful than traditional diaries and especially welcomed by young people.
zh: 如今，视频博客比传统的日记更实用，尤其是受到年轻人的欢迎。

en: And it really had nowhere to go.
zh: 因为确实无处可去。

en: The winning number in the lottery was announced by the media.
zh: 彩票中奖号码被媒体公布了。

zh: 告诉我，今天早晨有多少学生迟到。
rewrite: Tell me how many students were late this morning.

zh: 李平的母亲是护士还是医生？

zh: 司机应该遵守交通规则，以确保自己和他人的安全。

zh: 察言观色对巴杰莉修女来说也同等重要。

zh: 他想找个与自身能力相配的职业。

en: The world really has one big ocean.
zh: 世界上其实只有一个海洋。

en: I woke up at four o'clock this morning.
zh: 今天早上我4点钟就醒了。

en: Would you tell me what you did on the evening of 8th October?
zh: 能否告诉我10月8日晚上你在干嘛？

en: They had two children of their own.
zh: 他们有两个自己的孩子。

en: We said good-bye, then he turned and walked off without another word.
zh: 我们说了声“再见”，他便转身离去，没再说一句话。

en: I'm sorry we were cut off.
zh: 抱歉！刚刚电话断了。

zh: 他很快吃完了两碗鸡汤面。

en: His hair began to come off.
zh: 他开始掉头发。

en: Please keep off the grass.
zh: 请别踩踏草地。

zh: 今天推出的特价线路有3个目的地可供选择。

zh: 国家博物馆每周一为学生提供免费门票。

zh: 杰克是一个健忘的家伙，因为他总把这个或那个东西落在办公室。

en: An officer is receiving her.
zh: 一位官员正在接待她。

en: A senior UN official hopes to visit China this month.
zh: 一位联合国高级官员希望于本月访问中国。

en: It is official policy line.

zh: 姬蒂是这样一位诚实的学生，她经常受到老师的表扬。

en: Oil is liquid.
zh: 石油是液体。

en: It's natural for us to become more forgetful when we get old.
zh: 当我们老了，我们变得更健忘，这是自然的。

en: He is an Olympic champion.
zh: 他是一位奥运会冠军。

en: She won the individual gold medal at the Winter Olympics.
zh: 她在冬奥会上获得了个人金牌。

en: What great fun it is to chat with our friends on the internet!
zh: 在互联网上与我们的朋友聊天多么有趣啊！

zh: 他准时到达机场。

zh: 汤姆穿上他的鞋子。

en: The film will be on in 10 minutes.

zh: 我最近变得特别健忘，有一次甚至没带笔就进了考场。

en: He was once unlucky in his work.
zh: 他一度工作不顺利。

en: Once we lived in London.

en: Once is enough.

zh: 一旦染上坏习惯，想改掉就难了。

en: He is one who never troubles about his personal interests.
zh: 他是一个从不计较个人利益的人。

en: Besides, you need to make up a story. Can you write your own one?
zh: 此外，你需要编一个故事。你可以写写你自己的故事吗？

zh: 随着在线支付服务的发展，我们的生活确实变得方便多了。

en: Mike's parents were worried that he spent too much time chatting online.
zh: 迈克的父母担心他花太多时间在网上聊天。

en: There is only a little milk.
zh: 只有一点牛奶了。

en: Our only resort is to inform the police.
zh: 我们唯一的办法是向警方报案。

en: His spoon dropped onto the ground.
zh: 他的汤勺掉到了地上。

zh: 牙医生说：“请张大嘴，便于我检查你的牙齿”。

en: Keep the window open while you are in.
zh: 在房里时请把窗打开。

en: The reading room in our neighbourhood is open from 9 a.m. to 9 p.m. on weekdays.
zh: 我们小区的阅读室平日开放时间是从上午 9 时至下午 9 时。

zh: 林医生刚才匆匆赶去为一个受伤的年轻男子动手术。

zh: 美术课的学生经过练习后，能够操作这些数字绘图工具。

en: Computers are widely used to operate railways and fly planes in our life.
zh: 在我们的生活中，计算机被广泛用于铁路运营和飞机飞行操控。

en: The doctor performed an operation on her brain last week.
zh: 上周医生为她做了脑部手术。

zh: 在我看来，蒂姆的英文没有他妹妹写得清楚。

en: I should have written the notes in the opposite order.
zh: 我本应按相反的顺序记笔记的。

en: Jennie had sat opposite her at breakfast.
zh: 珍妮吃早餐时坐在她对面。

en: Take the exam carefully, or you won't get full marks.
zh: 考试时要仔细，否则你就得不到满分。

en: Orange juice contains things which help keep you healthy.
zh: 橘子汁里含有益于健康的东西。

en: I prefer that orange blouse.
zh: 我更喜欢那件橙色的女衬衫。

zh: 指挥官向士兵下达命令。

en: The cups were arranged in order of size.
zh: 杯子按大小排列。

en: I have ordered an egg for you.
zh: 我已经帮你点了个蛋。

en: I just want an ordinary car.
zh: 我只想要一辆普通的车。

zh: 联合国组织由 190 多个国家组成。

en: We organize the “Low-Carbon Life” activity every month to protect the environment.
zh: 为了保护环境，我们每个月都会组织“低碳生活”主题活动。

en: Once the repair is finished, I’m sure no other playground is better than ours.
zh: 修缮完成后，我敢肯定没有哪个操场比我们的更好了。

en: Of the five memory exercises, two are really hard, and the other three are much easier.
zh: 在这五项记忆练习中，有两项真的很难，另外三项则容易得多。

en: New Zealand has two islands. One is North Island and the other is South Island.
zh: 新西兰有两个岛。一个是北岛，另一个是南岛。

en: He ought to keep his promise.
zh: 他应该遵守诺言。

en: Let’s go out for a walk.
zh: 我们出去散散步吧。

en: The streetlights were out after the storm.
zh: 暴风雨过后，路灯都熄灭了。

en: I like outdoor sports.
zh: 我喜欢室外运动。

en: We were just thinking of an outing, but the odds were against us and it began to rain.
zh: 我们正想去郊游，不料天公不作美，下起雨来了。

en: For example, you might want to speak about your interests and hobbies outside school.
zh: 比如说，你可能想说说你在校外的兴趣和爱好。

en: It's raining outside. I'd rather watch TV at home than go to the cinema.
zh: 外面在下雨。我宁愿在家看电视也不愿去看电影。

en: She took the pie out of the oven.
zh: 她将馅饼从烤箱中拿出来。

en: We live over a small bookstore.
zh: 我们住在一家小书店的楼上。

en: The war was over about three months ago.
zh: 大约3个月前战争结束了。

en: We all know that success in study mainly depends on one's own effort.
zh: 我们都知道学习的成功主要取决于自己的努力。

en: With the help of AI, people needn't spend much time searching for the information on their own.
zh: 在人工智能的帮助下，人们无需花费大量时间自行搜索信息。

en: He owns three cars.
zh: 他有3辆汽车。

en: Who is the owner of that motorcycle?
zh: 谁是那辆摩托车的主人？

en: He visited the Pacific Islands yesterday.
zh: 他昨天访问了太平洋岛屿。

en: The tourist carried a pack on his back.
zh: 观光旅行者背了个包。

en: When I was seventeen, I packed my bags and left home.
zh: 17 岁时，我背起行囊离开了家。

en: Do the exercises on page ten.
zh: 做第 10 页上的练习。

en: He has a pain in his stomach.
zh: 他胃痛。

en: The loss of her beloved pet pained her deeply.
zh: 失去心爱宠物使她深深感到痛苦。

en: — Have you moved into the new house? — Not yet, the rooms are being painted.
zh: ——你搬进新房了吗？——没有，房间还在粉刷呢。

en: He bought me a box of paints.
zh: 他给我买了一盒颜料。

en: There is a beautiful painting on the wall in each room of my house.
zh: 我住所里每个房间的墙上都有一幅美丽的画。

en: This pair of shoes fits me well.
zh: 这双鞋我穿很合脚。

en: In ancient times, many palaces were built in Beijing, Xi’an and Nanjing.
zh: 在古代，北京、西安和南京建有许多宫殿。

en: She was pale with fear.
zh: 她吓得脸色发白。

en: The panda attracted many children.
zh: 那只熊猫吸引了不少孩子。

en: He wrote a number on a piece of paper.
zh: 他在一张纸上写了一个数字。

en: I read the news in the papers.
zh: 我在报纸上看到了这则消息。

en: Peter will cook for his parents when the International Day of Families comes.
zh: “国际家庭日”到来时，彼得将为他的父母做饭。

en: Paris is the capital of France.
zh: 巴黎是法国首都。

en: Mr. Smith thought the Century Park was the second largest park in Shanghai.
zh: 史密斯先生认为，世纪公园是上海第二大公园。

en: He found a place to park the car.
zh: 他找到了一个停车位。

en: What an important part computers have played in our daily life!
zh: 计算机在我们的日常生活中扮演着多么重要的角色啊！

en: They were partners in crime.
zh: 他俩是同谋。

en: Lucy introduced herself before the welcome party.
zh: 露西在欢迎派对开始前做了自我介绍。

en: He passed the ball to Edwards.
zh: 他把球传给了爱德华。

en: The students were celebrating the Art Festival when I passed by their school.
zh: 当我经过他们学校时，学生们正在举行艺术节庆祝活动。

zh: 她申请了一张访客通行证以进入政府大楼。

en: People have different interpretations of the passage.
zh: 人们对这一段文字有不同的解释。

en: This bus can carry fifty passengers.
zh: 这辆公交车可载 50 名乘客。

en: A person who travels abroad must carry a passport.
zh: 出国旅行要携带护照。

en: I arrived at half past ten.
zh: 我 10 点半到的。

en: Travelling by bus is more comfortable nowadays than in the past.
zh: 现在乘公共汽车出行比过去更舒适。

zh: 在过去 10 年里，我和父亲在同一个地方拍了很多照片。

zh: 病人越早接受治疗，康复的可能性就越大。

en: He's a very patient man.
zh: 他是个很有耐心的人。

zh: 费尔蒙先生不敢相信他的妻子花一万美元买了一个手提包。
rewrite: Mr. Fermont couldn't believe that his wife purchased just a handbag for $10,000.

zh: 梨是一种美味的水果，我非常喜欢。

en: The necklace is made of natural pearls.
zh: 这条项链是用天然珍珠做成的。

en: Students are required to write their exercises in pen.
zh: 学生被要求用钢笔做练习。

en: Who has taken my pencil away? I used it minutes ago.
zh: 谁拿了我的铅笔？几分钟前我还在用呢。

en: It is reported that more than two thousand people have been killed in this big earthquake.
zh: 据报道，在这次的大地震中死亡人数已超过两千人。

en: The lunch is $3.50 per person.
zh: 午餐费是每人 3.5 美元。

en: Twenty percent of the products are exported.
zh: 百分之二十的产品外销。

en: The store is offering a fifty percent discount on prices.
zh: 这家商店正在 5 折销售产品。

en: Gold price rose seventy percent last year.
zh: 去年黄金价格上涨了百分之七十。

en: The length of the hiking route in the national park is perfect for a walk.
zh: 国家公园里这条徒步路线的长度很适合散步。

en: The performance of Class A students is much better than that of Class B students.
zh: A 班学生的表演明显优于 B 班学生。

en: Perhaps I can help you.
zh: 也许我能帮你忙。

en: Nobody would like to make friends with those dishonest persons.
zh: 没有人会和那些不诚实的人交朋友。

en: It's all a matter of personal taste.
zh: 这纯粹是个人的品味问题。

en: Many people like to keep pet dogs because dogs will love people faithfully forever.
zh: 很多人都喜欢养宠物狗, 因为狗会永远对人忠实。

en: The children were excited to pet the rabbits at the farm.
zh: 孩子们兴奋地在农场抚摸兔子。

en: Doug's 14-year-old son Jamie answered the phone.
zh: 道格 14 岁的儿子杰米接了电话。

en: Yesterday he phoned Laura to see if she was better.
zh: 昨天他打电话给劳拉, 问她是不是好些了。

en: We took many photos at Grandpa's birthday party.
zh: 我们在爷爷的生日聚会上拍了很多照片。

en: Playing basketball is one form of physical exercise.
zh: 打篮球是体育锻炼的一种形式。

en: Physics isn’t so difficult. You needn’t be disappointed. I’m sure you’ll pass it next time.
zh: 物理不是那么难。你不必感到失望。我确信你下一次会通过。

en: Alice loves music. Every day she practises playing the piano for an hour.
zh: 爱丽丝热爱音乐。她每天练习弹钢琴一个小时。

en: Would you please help me pick up the umbrella on the floor?
zh: 请你帮我把地板上的伞拾起来好吗？

en: Children are often told that they mustn’t pick flowers in public gardens.
zh: 孩子们经常被告知，他们不应该在公园摘花。

en: If it doesn’t rain tomorrow, we will have a picnic in the park.
zh: 如果明天不下雨，我们就去公园野餐。

en: The students asked Mrs. Yang when they would have a picnic at Century Park.
zh: 学生问杨老师他们什么时候去世纪公园野餐。
rewrite: The students asked Mrs. Yang when to have a picnic at Century Park.

en: I had a picture taken this morning.
zh: 今天上午我请人给我拍了张照片。

en: Could you give me a piece of paper?
zh: 你能给我一张纸吗？

en: She was really unhappy to see her favourite vase break into pieces right in front of her.
zh: 看到心爱的花瓶就在眼前摔得粉碎，她非常难过。

en: He raises pigs for a living.
zh: 他以养猪为生。

en: Why do I have to take all these pills?
zh: 我为什么非得服下所有这些药丸？

en: Robin was once a fighter pilot during World War II.
zh: 罗宾在二战期间曾当过战斗机飞行员。

en: The secretary pinned the papers together.
zh: 秘书把文件钉在一起。

en: Mary used a pin to fasten the loose hem of her dress.
zh: 玛丽用针把松开的裙子下摆固定起来。

en: She drank a cup of pineapple juice.
zh: 她喝了一杯菠萝汁。

en: She was dressed in pink.
zh: 她穿着粉红色的衣服。

en: The pink sky in the evening means a clear day will follow.
zh: 傍晚粉红色的天空说明次日是晴天。

en: They were the pioneers of the American West.
zh: 他们是美国西部的开拓者。

en: She never asked for pity before.
zh: 她过去从未乞求怜悯。

en: What a pity you can't come to my birthday party!
zh: 你不能来我的生日聚会，真可惜！

en: He likes to eat pizzas.
zh: 他喜欢吃比萨饼。

en: There are many interesting places for children everywhere. But Disneyland is called the happiest place on the earth.
zh: 有许多有趣的地方供孩子们玩。但迪士尼乐园被称为世界上最快乐的地方。

en: I placed the desk.
zh: 我放置了桌子。

en: Two-thirds of people said yes to the new plan.
zh: 三分之二的人同意这个新计划。

en: Wang Fang plans to take plenty of presents to her friends in New York when she goes there at Christmas.
zh: 王芳计划在圣诞节去纽约的时候带很多礼物给她那儿的朋友。

en: The pilot landed the plane safely at its home airport.
zh: 飞行员将飞机安全地降落在驻地机场。

en: The planets move around the sun.
zh: 行星绕着太阳转。

en: People had planted a lot of trees along the lake by the end of last month.
zh: 到上月底，人们沿湖种植了很多树木。

en: These are perennial plants.
zh: 这些是多年生的植物。

en: The company sells plastic products.
zh: 这家公司出售塑料制品。

en: The toy manufacturer switched to using biodegradable plastics in their products.
zh: 玩具厂商转而在他们的产品中使用可生物降解的塑料。

en: He had a plate of beef for lunch.
zh: 他午餐吃了一盘牛肉。

en: I must put my thoughts together before I go on the platform.
zh: 在走上讲台讲演之前，我要把我的思绪整理一下。

en: Although Yao Ming has made himself known to the whole world for his talent in playing basketball, he still stays very humble.
zh: 虽然姚明已经让全世界知道他有打篮球的天赋，他依然非常谦虚。

en: Mike practised playing the piano for five hours a day in order to get a prize in the contest.
zh: 为了能在比赛中获奖，迈克每天练习5个小时钢琴。

en: Did you enjoy the play?
zh: 你喜欢那个戏剧吗？

en: People crowded round the player with congratulations.
zh: 人们簇拥着那个运动员向他祝贺。

en: You can find him on the playground, I think.
zh: 我想你去操场能找到他。

en: His sister sings well. She has a pleasant voice.
zh: 他的姐姐唱歌唱得很好。她有一副悦耳的嗓音。

en: Will you please tell him the news when you see him?
zh: 当你看到他时，请告诉他这个消息好吗？

en: This book will please you.
zh: 这本书会让你满意的。

en: We are very pleased with our new house.
zh: 我们对自己的新居很满意。

en: Mrs. Zhou always helps her students with great pleasure.
zh: 周老师总是非常乐意帮助她的学生。

en: The garden was blooming with colourful flowers in plenty.
zh: 花园里开满了五颜六色的花。

en: He has plenty of humourous stories to tell.
zh: 他有许多幽默故事可讲。

en: Five plus two equals seven.
zh: 5 加 2 等于 7。

en: It's 1:00 p.m. now.
zh: 现在是下午 1 点。

en: The policeman made the thief turn out his pockets.
zh: 警察叫小偷把口袋都翻出来。

en: This poem is so wonderful.
zh: 这首诗太棒了。

en: It's rude to point your fingers at people.
zh: 用手指指人是不礼貌的。

en: Then think about yourself — your strong points and weak ones.
zh: 然后想想你自己——你的优点和缺点。

en: We used a branch as a fishing pole.
zh: 我们用树枝做钓竿。

en: The old man was thankful to the policeman who found the lost car for him.
zh: 这位老人感激警察找到了他丢失的汽车。

en: I've never seen such a polite clerk.
zh: 我从未见过这样有礼貌的店员。

en: “Would you please stop smoking?” the little girl said to the man politely.
zh: 小女孩有礼貌地对那个男子说：“请你不要吸烟好吗？”

en: Politics was one of his university subjects.
zh: 政治学是他大学的课程之一。

en: The environment will be seriously polluted if people don't take any action.
zh: 如果人们不采取任何行动，环境将受到严重污染。

en: All the students in Shanghai should help fight against pollution to protect the environment.
zh: 上海所有的学生都应该为保护环境与污染作斗争。

en: After the heavy rain there were pools on the road.
zh: 大雨过后路上有一些小水塘。

en: My family used to be poor.
zh: 我家过去很穷。

en: The poor couple dreamed of having a flat of their own some day in the future.
zh: 这对贫穷的夫妻梦想在未来的某一天拥有一套自己的房子。

en: My brother is poor at history.
zh: 我哥哥历史不好。

en: City Walk has become extremely popular between local people in Shanghai.
zh: 城市漫步在上海当地人中变得极为流行。

en: Now she is quite popular with her friends and she has also gained more confidence.
zh: 现在她很受朋友欢迎，也获得了更多的自信。

en: More nursing homes will be built for the aging population in the next few years.
zh: 在未来几年将建造更多的养老院，以应对人口老龄化。

en: How much pork do you need to make dumplings for the family and the guests?
zh: 为家人和客人包饺子你需要多少猪肉？

en: Is such a thing possible?
zh: 这种事可能吗？

en: Mary is good at writing. She will possibly be a reporter in the future.
zh: 玛丽擅长写作。她将来可能会成为一名记者。

en: If you could get the book, please send it to me by post.
zh: 如果你能弄到那本书，请邮寄给我。

en: If I write a letter, would you post it for me?
zh: 如果我写封信，你能替我寄出去吗？

en: She posted a photo of her vacation on social media to share with her friends.
zh: 她在社交媒体上发了一张度假照片，与朋友分享。

en: He sent me a postcard from the United Nations.
zh: 他从联合国给我寄来一张明信片。

en: He put up a poster advertising the circus.
zh: 他贴出了一张宣传马戏团的海报。

en: His ambition is to be a postman.
zh: 他的志向是成为一名邮递员。

en: Most of the flower pots were moved into the house by Mrs. Green last night.
zh: 昨晚大多数的花盆都被格林太太搬进了房子里。

en: They bought some fresh potatoes at the supermarket yesterday.
zh: 昨天他们在超市买了一些新鲜的土豆。

en: I bought two pounds of apples at the supermarket.
zh: 我在超市买了两磅苹果。

en: Will you change me five ten-pound notes?
zh: 你给我换 5 张 10 英镑的纸币好吗？

en: They have built three nuclear power stations this year.
zh: 今年他们建造了 3 座核电站。

en: The powerful engine powered the car up the steep hill effortlessly.
zh: 强大的引擎驱动汽车轻松地爬上了陡峭的山坡。

en: Her voice was so powerful that it reached every corner of the concert hall.
zh: 她的声音如此响亮，以至于传到了音乐厅的每个角落。

en: Only practice can achieve mastery.
zh: 只有实践才能达到精通。

en: In our debate club, we practise writing and giving short speeches every week.
zh: 在我们的辩论社里，我们每周都练习写作并发表简短的演讲。

en: His good behaviour deserves praise.
zh: 他的好品行值得表扬。

en: I was praised for my progress last night. And my father was pleased with me, too.
zh: 昨晚我的进步受到表扬，我的父亲对我也很满意。

en: Time is precious.
zh: 时间是宝贵的。

en: People cannot predict how things will pan out.
zh: 人们无法预料事情会有什么样的结果。

en: I prefer running to swimming.
zh: 比起游泳，我更喜欢跑步。

en: We are preparing for the party.
zh: 我们在为派对做准备。

en: John gave Mary a wonderful present on her thirtieth birthday.
zh: 在玛丽 30 周岁生日时，约翰给了她一个精美的礼物。

en: Mr. Smith is on holiday at present.
zh: 史密斯先生现在在休假。

en: He insists on being present.
zh: 他一定要出席。

en: To prove his point, Paul presented detailed evidence in his presentation.
zh: 为了证明自己的观点，保罗在介绍中展示了详细的证据。

en: The president will give a speech on the morning of the National Day.
zh: 总统将在国庆节的上午发表讲话。

en: Please press this button.
zh: 请按这个按钮。

en: She closed her eyes and pretended to be asleep.
zh: 她闭上眼睛装睡。

en: What a pretty doll it is!
zh: 多漂亮的洋娃娃！

en: He did pretty well on his exam.
zh: 他考试考得相当不错。

en: How to prevent disease?
zh: 怎么预防疾病？

en: The heavy rain prevented us from going on our planned hike.
zh: 大雨阻止了我们原计划的徒步旅行。

en: Nowadays people complain that food prices are higher than before.
zh: 现在人们都抱怨食品价格比以前高了。

en: She studies in a primary school.
zh: 她在上小学。

en: The primary goal of this project is to reduce environmental pollution.
zh: 该项目的主要目标是减少环境污染。

en: Print the word in italics.
zh: 用斜体印刷这个字。

en: The building over there is a prison.
zh: 那边的那幢建筑是一座监狱。

en: Some young people are now rich enough to buy private cars.
zh: 现在有一些年轻人有能力买私家车。

en: Andy was surprised to know that his science project won the first prize.
zh: 得知自己的科学项目获得了一等奖，安迪感到十分惊讶。

en: It is probable that he told her everything.
zh: 很可能他把一切都告诉她了。

en: John probably told his father all about the matter.
zh: 约翰很可能把这一切都告诉了他父亲。

en: I'm sure you will succeed in working out the problem unless you give up.
zh: 我相信你会成功解决这个问题，除非你放弃。

en: How fast does the computer process the data?
zh: 这台计算机处理数据有多快？

en: Learning is a process of trying and failing and trying and succeeding.
zh: 学习是一个尝试、失败、再尝试，最后成功的过程。

en: The new factory will produce goods for export.
zh: 这家新工厂将生产出口产品。

en: This plan was the product of many hours of careful thought.
zh: 这个计划是经过长时间仔细思考的产物。

en: After graduation, she became a professional accountant.
zh: 毕业以后，她成为一名专业会计。

en: I love the programme “Schools in students’ eyes” made by Shanghai Educational TV Station.
zh: 我喜欢由上海教育电视台制作的《学生眼中的学校》这个节目。

en: The personal trainer will programme a customised workout plan for each client.
zh: 私人教练将为每位客户量身定制训练计划。

en: You can make much progress in your study if you work hard.
zh: 如果努力学习，你就会取得很大进步。
rewrite: You can't make much progress in your study unless you work hard.

en: Linda did her project on Chinese traditional food far more carefully than I did.
zh: 琳达在做中国传统食物这个项目时，远远比我仔细。

en: Not only did he make a promise, but also he kept it.
zh: 他不仅作出了许诺，而且履行了诺言。

en: The police promised to catch the kidnappers and rescue the actor.
zh: 警方承诺会抓获绑匪并救出这位演员。

en: He can pronounce this word correctly.
zh: 他能正确地念这个字。

en: Healthy food is very important to help our minds work properly.
zh: 健康食品对我们大脑的正常运转非常重要。

en: It's necessary for us to know how to protect ourselves in an earthquake.
zh: 我们有必要知道在地震中如何保护自己。

en: She had an umbrella to protect her from the rain.
zh: 她带了把伞来遮雨。

en: After winning the game, the team felt very proud of themselves.
zh: 赢得比赛后, 队员们感到无比自豪。

en: It is unnecessary to prove your ability to anyone. Just focus on your own progress.
zh: 没必要向任何人证明你的能力, 专注于自己的进步就好。

en: Most people are familiar with the proverb: Rome was not built in a day.
zh: 大多数人都熟悉这个谚语: 罗马不是一天建成的。

en: To protect the environment, supermarkets don't provide free plastic bags for shoppers.
zh: 为了保护环境, 超市不再为顾客提供免费塑料袋。

en: The organisation provides poor children with educational resources.
zh: 这个组织向贫困儿童提供教育资源。

en: Mary’s father rarely smokes in public places, does he?
zh: 玛丽的父亲很少在公共场所抽烟，是吗？

en: The museum is open to the public.
zh: 这家博物馆是对公众开放的。

en: By the age of ten, the little girl had published her first collection of poems. She’s now very famous.
zh: 这个小女孩在10岁的时候已经出版了她的第一本诗集。她现在很出名。

en: Many old houses around our school will be pulled down next year and a large green area will appear.
zh: 明年我们学校周围许多旧房子要被拆除，将出现一片大型的绿化区域。

en: The main purpose of the charity project is to offer help to homeless people.
zh: 这个慈善项目的主要目的是帮助无家可归的人。

en: Push your chair in gently.
zh: 轻轻地把你的椅子推进去。

en: The students were encouraged to push their hips back in downward dog pose.
zh: 学员们在做下犬式时被鼓励着推臀。

en: In its push for economic growth it has ignored projects that would improve living standards.
zh: 在努力追求经济增长的同时，它却忽视了那些能改善生活水平的项目。

en: One of their tasks is to put an ice radar in the station.
zh: 他们的任务之一是把冰雷达放在雷达站里。

en: Henry didn’t put on his scarf before he left the office.
zh: 亨利在离开办公室之前没有戴上围巾。

en: In production, we demand not only quantity but also quality.
zh: 我们的产品不但要求数量而且要求质量。

en: It's a quarter to seven.
zh: 现在是6点45分。

en: The queen was sad.
zh: 皇后很伤心。

en: Well done! You have answered all the questions correctly.
zh: 干得好！你已正确回答了所有的问题。

en: Among the boys, Tom is the quickest to learn new things.
zh: 在男孩中，学习新事物学得最快的是汤姆。

en: When he heard a cry for help, he ran out as quickly as he could.
zh: 一听到呼救声，他就尽快跑了出来。

en: Online team-buying services are developing quickly in China, aren't they?
zh: 在中国，网上团购服务正在迅速发展，不是吗？

en: I'm going to move somewhere quiet. It's too noisy in our neighbourhood.
zh: 我打算搬到一个安静的地方。我们的小区太吵了。

en: The patient lay on his bed quietly when the doctor came to examine him.
zh: 当医生来给这位病人检查时，他静静地躺在床上。

en: This arrangement is quite satisfactory, so far as I am concerned.
zh: 就我来说，这样的安排相当好。

en: We'll have a quiz at the end of class.
zh: 下课前我们将进行一次测试。

en: Are you going to race your horse at Newmarket next week?
zh: 你准备让你的马参加下周在纽马克特的赛马会吗？

en: Peter and Bill each say they came first in the race.
zh: 彼得和比尔都说自己跑了第一。

en: Father bought her a stereo radio.
zh: 父亲给她买了台立体声收音机。

en: The railway is still under construction.
zh: 这条铁路仍在建设之中。

en: In fact, there isn't so much rain in the city as they think.
zh: 事实上，这座城市不像他们想的那样有这么多的雨水。

en: We will go to the Happy Valley tomorrow unless it rains.
zh: 如果明天不下雨，我们会去欢乐谷。

en: Most tropical areas have rainy and dry seasons.
zh: 大多数热带地区有雨季和旱季。

en: The government plans to raise the living standard of citizens.
zh: 政府计划提高市民的生活水平。

en: It is not easy to raise three children on a small income.
zh: 靠微薄的收入抚养三个孩子并不容易。

en: The charity event successfully raised enough money to help the homeless.
zh: 这场慈善活动成功筹集到了足够的资金来帮助无家可归的人。

en: The government's decision on building a factory in the city centre has raised many questions among the local people.
zh: 政府决定在城市中心建造一家工厂，这在当地人中已经引发了许多质疑。

en: People in western countries rarely talk loudly in public, do they?
zh: 在西方国家，人们很少在公共场所大声说话，是吗？

en: They have been friends for years and have rarely argued.
zh: 他们成为朋友已经好几年了，很少发生争执。

en: I'm feeling rather sleepy.
zh: 我感到十分困倦。

en: She was not angry, but rather disappointed by his actions.
zh: 她没有生气，而是对他的举动很失望。

en: I rather suspect that he is not telling the truth.
zh: 我有点儿怀疑他没说实话。

en: My uncle will send me postcards and stamps after he reaches France.
zh: 我的叔叔到达法国后，会给我寄一些明信片邮票。

en: He reached a high level of proficiency in playing the piano.
zh: 他在演奏钢琴方面达到了高水平的熟练程度。

en: It's easy to memorise the words if we know how to read them correctly.
zh: 如果我们知道如何正确地读出这些单词，就很容易记住它们了。

en: Tommy asked me if I was interested in reading science fiction.
zh: 汤米问我是否对读科幻小说感兴趣。

en: Jenny was reading the text of Lesson Three at 8:00 last night.
zh: 昨天晚上 8 点珍妮正在读第 3 课的课文。

en: He is ready for the trip.
zh: 他已准备好去旅行。

en: The real value of the book lies in its wonderful characterisation.
zh: 这本书真正的价值在于精彩的人物塑造。

en: If you want to realize your dream, study hard from now on.
zh: 如果你想实现自己的梦想，从现在开始就要努力学习。

en: It's really impossible for a child of five to take care of himself.
zh: 要 5 岁儿童自己照顾自己，这真的是不可能的。

en: That is the reason why we must go now.
zh: 那就是我们现在必须走的理由。

en: The house was rebuilt after the fire.
zh: 这房子是火灾后重建的。

en: By the end of last month, Mrs. Lin had received many interesting comic strips created by the students.
zh: 到上月底，林老师收到了许多由学生创作的有趣的漫画。

en: There have been many changes in our school in recent years.
zh: 近几年，我们学校发生了许多变化。

en: Recently, we have all worked harder to improve ourselves in many ways.
zh: 最近，我们所有人都更加努力，在各个方面提升自己。

en: She had changed so much that I could hardly recognize her.
zh: 她的变化这么大，我简直认不出来了。

en: Several world records were broken by Bolt at the Olympics.
zh: 博尔特在奥运会上打破了多项世界纪录。

en: She has recorded some popular songs.
zh: 她录了一些通俗歌曲。

en: We should recycle garbage, not burn it.
zh: 我们应该回收利用垃圾，而不是焚烧。

en: He was wearing a white shirt and a red tie.
zh: 他穿着一件白衬衫，系了一条红领带。

en: I prefer red to blue.
zh: 比起蓝色，我更喜欢红色。

en: We have reduced the number of classes from eight to six.
zh: 我们已将班级数量由 8 个减少到 6 个。

en: The author does not give references.
zh: 作者没有注明参考(所引资料的)出处。

en: I don't know why he refused the job offer.
zh: 我不明白他为什么拒绝那份工作。

en: The proud lady refuses to accept any advice.
zh: 这位高傲的女士拒绝接受任何建议。

en: Regular exercise is an effective way to stay healthy and reduce stress.
zh: 规律运动是保持健康、缓解压力的有效方法。

en: She found it impossible to extricate herself from the relationship.
zh: 她发现自己不可能从这种关系中解脱出来。

en: Today we visited our relative.
zh: 今天我们探望了我们的亲戚。

en: Sam needs to relax, so he is looking forward to a holiday.
zh: 萨姆需要放松，所以他期待着假期。

en: It helps us release anxious thoughts.
zh: 它能帮助我们释放焦虑情绪。

en: The movie will be on release from Christmas.
zh: 影片将从圣诞节开始上映。

en: You can always rely on Jim, he won't fail you.
zh: 你可以永远依靠吉姆，他不会让你失望的。

en: The famous singer died, but her sweet voice will be remembered for ever.
zh: 这位著名歌手去世了，但她甜美的声音将永远被铭记。

en: He reminded me that I ought to do it at once.
zh: 他提醒我应该现在就去做这件事。

en: The house is in need of repair.
zh: 那幢房子需要整修。

en: The students can not only operate the machines with safety but also repair them.
zh: 学生们不仅能安全地操作这些机器，而且还能修理这些机器。

en: Though I repeated the phone number many times, the foreigner still couldn't write it down.
zh: 虽然我把电话号码重复了好多次，这个外国人还是不能把它写下来。

en: He never replied to the letters.
zh: 他从来都不回信。

en: Silence is the best reply to calumniation.
zh: 沉默是对诽谤的最有力回击。

en: She has given us a progress report on how the project is going.
zh: 她给我们作了关于项目进展的报告。

en: John reported the two robberies to the police just now.
zh: 刚刚约翰向警方报告了这两起抢劫案。

en: It is reported that two-thirds of the fruits in that supermarket are from Hainan Island.
zh: 据说，该超市三分之二的水果来自海南岛。

en: The reporter described the accident in detail.
zh: 记者详尽地描述了那起意外事件。

en: the People's Republic of China
zh: 中华人民共和国

en: All passengers are required to fasten their seat belts during takeoff.
zh: 所有乘客在起飞时都被要求系好安全带。

en: Learning a new language requires time and patience.
zh: 学习一门新语言需要时间和耐心。

en: The historical background to the play has been very carefully and thoroughly researched.
zh: 已对这个剧本的历史背景进行了细致全面的研究。

en: The latest research shows that regular exercise can improve mental health.
zh: 最新研究表明，定期锻炼可以改善心理健康。

en: This country is rich in natural resources.
zh: 该国自然资源丰富。

en: I respect him for his diligence.
zh: 我敬佩他的勤奋。

en: The Double Ninth Festival reminds us to respect the elderly.
zh: 重阳节提醒我们要尊重老人。

en: She has received a response from that college to her application.
zh: 她已经收到那所大学对她申请的答复。

en: We need to take responsibility for looking after our own health.
zh: 我们必须对自己的健康负责。

en: Being responsible means taking ownership of your mistakes and learning from them.
zh: 有责任感意味着要对自己的错误负责，并从中吸取教训。

en: The doctor advised him to take a rest for a few days.
zh: 医生建议他休息几天。

en: The rest of us were allowed to go home.
zh: 我们中的其他人被允许回家。

en: You need to rest from your labour. You look very tired.
zh: 你看上去很疲劳，需要放下工作休息一下。

en: I shall leave the restaurant unless the waiter comes soon.
zh: 除非服务员马上来，否则我就离开饭店。
rewrite: I shall leave the restaurant if the waiter doesn't come soon.

en: Remember, the harder you work, the more good results you will get.
zh: 记住，你越努力工作，你越会得到好的结果。

en: The retired workers receive money from the government till they die.
zh: 退休工人从政府那里领取养老金直到去世为止。

en: He returned the books to the library yesterday.
zh: 他昨天把书还给了图书馆。

en: After some time, small plants begin to grow. Animals return soon after the plants return. This again makes an eco-system.
zh: 过了一段时间之后，幼苗开始生长。万物复苏，动物也回来了。这又形成了一个生态系统。

en: The return of warm weather signals the arrival of spring.
zh: 温暖天气的回归预示着春天的到来。

en: The same water was reused after chemical treatment.
zh: 原来的水经过化学处理之后被再度利用。

en: The college published a drama review.
zh: 学院出版了一份戏剧评论刊物。

en: Have you reviewed what we covered in class yesterday?
zh: 昨天我们课堂上讲的东西你们复习了吗？

en: He was given the job as a reward for running a successful leadership bid.
zh: 因为成功组织了领导职位竞选活动，他得到了这份工作。

en: Make the extra effort to impress the buyer and you will be rewarded with a quicker sale.
zh: 多用心去打动顾客, 货物就会更快售出。

en: The southerners prefer rice and the northerners prefer food made from flour.
zh: 南方人比较喜欢吃米饭, 北方人爱吃面食。

en: A lot of people think that happiness is about being rich, but I disagree.
zh: 很多人认为幸福就是富有, 但我不同意。

en: It's not easy to rid oneself of a habit.
zh: 要改掉一个人的习惯是不容易的。

en: Now my father rides his bike to work every day instead of driving.
zh: 现在我的父亲每天骑自行车去上班而不是开车去。

en: Since it was raining heavily, John offered to give me a ride to work.
zh: 由于下大雨, 约翰主动提出载我去上班。

en: I'll try to do whatever is right.
zh: 只要是正当的事, 我都尽力去做。

en: It's quite late. We'd better go home by taxi right now.
zh: 太晚了, 我们最好现在打车回家。

en: It's on your right.
zh: 它在你右边。

en: Let's hurry up. The electric bell is ringing.
zh: 我们快点。电铃响了。

en: Her laughter rang out in the room.
zh: 她的笑声在房间里回荡。

en: I will give you a ring tonight.
zh: 今天晚上我给你打电话。

en: The river is rising after the rain.
zh: 雨后河水涨了起来。

en: These factories are trying their best not to pollute the river any longer.
zh: 这些工厂正在尽力不再污染河流。

en: We should drive carefully on the road.
zh: 在道路上我们应该小心驾驶。

en: You've made a fire fit to roast an ox.
zh: 你生的火很旺，足以烤一头牛了。

en: She worked like a robot.
zh: 她工作起来如同一个机器人。

en: Astronauts have brought back specimens of rock from the moon.
zh: 宇航员从月球带回了岩石标本。

en: She prefers rock music to classical.
zh: 比起古典乐，她更喜欢摇滚乐。

en: The boat rocked gently on the lake.
zh: 小船在湖面上轻轻摇晃。

en: This space rocket carries two satellites.
zh: 这枚宇宙火箭搭载了两颗卫星。

en: Three boys were unhappy because they got no roles to play last week.
zh: 三个男孩很不开心，因为上周他们没有分到表演角色。

en: This is a three-metre-high room.
zh: 这是一个3米高的房间。

en: There is no room for your piano in your room.
zh: 你房间里没地方放钢琴了。

en: The roots of this plant go deep.
zh: 这种植物的根扎得很深。

en: Money is the root of all evil.
zh: 金钱是万恶之源。

en: Maggie asked me to cut the rope to a length of two metres.
zh: 麦琪让我把绳子剪到两米长。

en: He picked her a rose.
zh: 他给她采了一朵玫瑰花。

en: It's just a very rough translation.
zh: 这只是一篇非常粗糙的翻译。

en: The child had a round face.
zh: 那孩子是圆脸。

en: A crowd soon gathered round.
zh: 很快围拢了一群人。

en: They were sitting round the kitchen table.
zh: 他们正围坐在餐桌旁。

en: A row of children are standing in front of a row of chairs.
zh: 一排小孩站在一排椅子前。

en: There is a pile of rubbish in the corner of the building.
zh: 在大楼的角落有一堆垃圾。

en: It's very rude of her to leave without telling us.
zh: 她不向我们打声招呼就走了，这是非常无礼的。

en: You should obey the traffic rules.
zh: 你应该遵守交通规则。

en: The king rules that country.
zh: 国王统治着那个国家。

en: Rabbits run fast.
zh: 兔子跑得快。

en: He runs a company.
zh: 他经营一家公司。

en: After a six-mile run, Jackie returns home for a substantial breakfast.
zh: 跑了 6 英里之后，杰姬回家吃一顿丰盛的早餐。

en: The students rushed into the classroom as soon as the bell rang.
zh: 铃声一响，学生就奔跑进教室。

en: He left the house in a rush.
zh: 他匆匆忙忙离开了家。

en: We are very sad and angry to hear that our football team suffered a defeat again.
zh: 听到我们的足球队又输球了，我们非常难过，非常生气。

en: Sadly, after eight years of marriage they had grown apart.
zh: 不幸的是, 结婚 8 年后, 他们的感情日渐淡漠了。

en: Friends are the people you feel safe because you know they care about you.
zh: 朋友就是那些能让你有安全感的人, 因为你知道他们关心你。

en: Only her husband knows the number to open the safe.
zh: 只有她丈夫知道打开保险柜的密码。

en: The plane landed safely at last after flying in the storm for about one hour.
zh: 这架飞机在风暴中大约飞行了一个小时以后, 最终安全着陆。

en: All pilots are responsible for their passengers' safety.
zh: 所有飞行员都应对乘客的安全负责。

en: He had a steak and a green salad.
zh: 他要了一块牛排和一份生菜色拉。

en: He was engaged at a salary of $1,000 a month.
zh: 他以月薪 1000 美元受聘。

en: Our school organized a charity sale for the homeless in that area.
zh: 我们学校在该地区为无家可归者组织了一场慈善义卖。

en: Salt occurs naturally in sea water.
zh: 盐天然存在于海水中。

en: The dish is too salty.
zh: 这道菜太咸了。

en: James, Catherine and I have been friends since we were at the same primary school.
zh: 自从我和詹姆斯还有凯瑟琳在同一所小学读书起，我们就一直是朋友。

en: Girls were given the same chance as boys to apply for the job by the manager.
zh: 经理给了女孩和男孩一样的机会去申请那份工作。

en: — Good luck and have a nice holiday. — The same to you.
zh: ——祝你好运，假期愉快！——你也一样。

en: To make a ham sandwich, you put a slice of ham between two slices of bread.
zh: 把一片火腿夹在两片面包之间就做成了火腿三明治。

en: When she had finished her meal, she gave a satisfied smile.
zh: 吃完饭后，她露出了满意的笑容。

en: It's very satisfying to see so many of you here.
zh: 在这里见到大家，我感到非常满意。

en: He went abroad last Saturday.
zh: 他上星期六出国了。

en: The sauce tastes too sweet.
zh: 这酱汁味道太甜。

en: Although the doctors did everything they could to save the sick boy, they failed at last.
zh: 虽然医生们尽力挽救这个生病的孩子，但最终还是失败了。

en: “There's still a long way to go before you succeed,” the teacher said to the class.
zh: 老师对全班学生说：“在你们成功之前还有很长的路要走。”

en: Last but not least, at the end of the interview, don't forget to thank the interviewer and say goodbye.
zh: 最后但同样重要的是，在面试结束时，别忘了感谢面试官并说再见。

en: “There's no smoke without fire”, as the saying goes.
zh: 常言道：“无风不起浪。”

en: Because of her busy schedule, it is impossible for her to spend much time travelling.
zh: 由于她的日程安排很紧，她不可能花很多时间旅行。

en: A presidential election was scheduled for last December.
zh: 总统大选原定去年12月举行。

en: — John was seriously injured in the school bus accident. — I'm sorry to hear that.
zh: ——约翰在校车事故中受了重伤。——听到这个消息我很难过。

en: Though he is only eight years old, he knows more about science than his father.
zh: 虽然只有8岁，但他比他父亲更了解科学。

en: Mr. Ren, a Chinese scientist, began to study global climate change more than a decade ago.
zh: 中国科学家任先生在10多年前就开始研究全球气候变化。

en: Nick didn't do very well in the final exam, but his scores are better than last year's.
zh: 虽然尼克期末考试考得不是很好，但他的分数比去年要好。

en: He scored the winning goal in the fourth round of the football matches.
zh: 他在足球比赛的第4轮中打进了制胜一球。

en: You can see him on the TV screen quite often.
zh: 你可以经常在电视屏幕上见到他。

en: We generally go to the sea for our holidays.
zh: 我们通常去海边度假。

en: There's an excellent seafood restaurant near here.
zh: 离这儿不远有一家非常不错的海鲜餐馆。

en: We searched here and there, but could not find her.
zh: 我们到处找她，但还是找不到。

en: — Why do millions of online users visit the home page of the government? — To read the news and search for the information they need.
zh: ——为什么有数百万的在线用户访问政府的主页？——为了看新闻和搜索他们需要的信息。

en: The lost book came to light after a long search.
zh: 经过长时间的寻找，那本遗失的书得以重见天日。

en: Let's go to the seaside at the weekend!
zh: 周末我们去海滨吧！

en: The seasons change, independent of anyone's wishes.
zh: 四季变化不受任何人约束。

en: The teacher made me move my seat to the front of the classroom.
zh: 老师把我的座位换到了教室的前面。

en: Our team gets a second.
zh: 我们队得了第二名。

en: The average flow of the river is 200 cubic metres per second.
zh: 这条河平均流量为每秒 200 立方米。

en: I finished in the second place in the 800-metre race, just behind Jack.
zh: 我在 800 米赛跑中获得第 2 名，仅次于杰克。

en: And second, we shouldn't substitute our personal feeling for policies.
zh: 其次，我们不应该拿个人感情代替政策。

en: In secondary school, children get more advanced knowledge.
zh: 在中学，孩子获得更深一些的知识。

en: She made no secret of her greed.
zh: 她毫不掩饰自己的贪婪。

en: He asked that the matter should be kept secret.
zh: 他要求对这件事保密。

en: She is secretary to the master.
zh: 她是校长的秘书。

en: The chapter falls into three sections.
zh: 这一章共分 3 节。

en: The events were faithfully recorded in a section of the local museum's files.
zh: 这些事件被如实记录在当地博物馆的一份档案卷宗里。

en: The light is on. I see them watching a slide show.
zh: 灯亮着。我看见他们正在看幻灯。

en: The farmers are scattering seed.
zh: 农夫们在播种。

en: The baby seems to be asleep.
zh: 那婴儿好像是睡着了。

en: I don't like western food. I seldom eat it unless I go to MacDonald with my daughter.
zh: 我不喜欢吃西餐。我很少吃，除非与我的女儿去麦当劳。

en: Kitty seldom read detective stories before going to school, did she?
zh: 上学前姬蒂很少读侦探故事，是吗？

en: Which place in the world would you select as your perfect home?
zh: 你会选择世界上哪个地方作为你最理想的安家之地呢？

en: The book written by that writer didn't sell well last year.
zh: 那位作家写的这本书，去年销售情况不好。

en: China first sent scientists to Antarctica in 1980.
zh: 中国在1980年首次派出科学家到南极。

en: Honours were automatically awarded to senior officials just because they were senior.
zh: 荣誉顺理成章地授予资深官员，就因为他们资格老。

en: I haven't got a very good sense of direction, so I easily get lost.
zh: 我的方向感很差，因此我容易迷路。

en: The dog sensed danger and started barking loudly.
zh: 狗意识到危险，开始狂叫。

en: Please make a whole sentence when you answer the question.
zh: 回答问题时请说完整的句子。

en: Our school will begin on September 1.
zh: 我们学校将在9月1日开学。

en: If you have a serious disease, such as heart disease, you'd better not travel there.
zh: 如果你有严重的疾病，如心脏疾病，你最好不要去那里。

en: The 70-year-old man was seriously ill and died a few months later.
zh: 那个70岁的男子患了重病，几个月后就去世了。

en: Our teacher asked us to take the exam seriously and avoid careless mistakes.
zh: 老师要求我们认真对待考试，避免出现粗心错误。

en: The waiter did his best to serve the customers politely and promptly.
zh: 那位服务员尽量礼貌及时地招待顾客。

en: Peter has served the company for 25 years, first as office boy and finally as sales manager.
zh: 彼得在这家公司服务了 25 年，开始是办公室工作人员，最后成为销售经理。

en: The customers are pleased with the service of the restaurant.
zh: 顾客对这家餐厅的服务很满意。

en: He set an example of wholehearted service to the people.
zh: 他树立了全心全意为人民服务的榜样。

en: The director was impressed with the details of the set.
zh: 导演对场景的细节印象深刻。

en: The meeting will take place in the set conference room.
zh: 会议将在指定的会议室举行。

en: Both sides are looking for ways to settle their differences.
zh: 双方都在寻求消除分歧的方法。

en: Dr. Hu has collected several proofs to show the conclusion is correct.
zh: 胡博士收集了若干证据，以证明这个结论是正确的。

en: Shaking hands is a traditional way to greet each other in many places.
zh: 在许多地方握手是一种传统的问候方式。

en: Shall I get the key to the bike?
zh: 我去拿自行车钥匙好吗？

en: What a shame you couldn't attend the graduation ceremony!
zh: 你不能参加毕业典礼，太可惜了！

en: She felt a deep sense of shame.
zh: 她深感羞愧。

en: I keep practising yoga after work because it helps me keep in good shape.
zh: 我下班后坚持练习瑜伽，因为它有助于我保持良好的身材。

en: The artist shaped the metal into a delicate piece of jewellery.
zh: 艺术家将金属塑造成一件精致的珠宝。

en: Ideas are always shared by my students in class.
zh: 在课堂上，学生总是分享各自的想法。

en: The old man used to raise many sheep to make a living in the west of China.
zh: 老人过去常常靠养羊在中国的西部谋生。

en: You may choose any of the toys on the shelf. But only one for each.
zh: 你们可以选择架子上的任何玩具。但每人只能拿一个。

en: — The sun shines brightly. Why not go out for a walk in the Zhongshan Park? — Good idea.
zh: ——阳光这么好。到中山公园去散散步怎样？——好主意。

en: Are you going to America by plane or by ship the day after tomorrow?
zh: 后天你去美国是乘飞机还是坐船？

en: Do you know the man wearing a white shirt?
zh: 你认识那个穿白衬衫的人吗？

en: You don't mind if I take my shoes off, do you?
zh: 你不介意我把鞋子脱了，是吧？

en: It's not available in the shops.
zh: 商店里都没货。

en: He always shopped at that shop.
zh: 他总在那家商店购物。

en: How could you do it in such a short period of time?
zh: 你是怎么在如此短的时间里做到的？

en: Sometimes I am not as brave as I should be.
zh: 有时我表现得不够勇敢。

en: We should not ask others to do what we can’t do ourselves.
zh: 我们不应该要求别人做一些我们自己也做不到的事情。

en: Don’t shout at me!
zh: 不要对我大声叫喊！

en: The decision was greeted with shouts of protest from the crowd.
zh: 这项决定遭到了大众的大声抗议。

en: My parents showed me some old pictures that brought back sweet memories.
zh: 我的父母给我看了一些能唤起我甜蜜记忆的老照片。

en: Charlie can’t go with us because he is showing a professor around our company.
zh: 查理不能和我们一起走，因为他正陪同一位教授参观我们公司。

en: She didn’t go to see the dolphin show with us because she had seen it already.
zh: 她不和我们一起去看看海豚表演，因为她已经看过了。

en: She took two showers a day.
zh: 她每天洗两次澡。

en: Lucy shut her eyes.
zh: 露西闭上了眼睛。

en: The store was shut when we arrived.
zh: 我们到的时候商店关门了。

en: At first he was a little shy in class, but now he acts more naturally.
zh: 起初他在班里有点害羞，不过现在表现自然多了。

en: On the twelfth day, the sick boy came to life.
zh: 在第 12 天，患病的男孩活过来了。

en: The students have put some flowers on either side of the corridor and hung some nice pictures on the wall.
zh: 学生们在走廊的两边摆了一些花，在墙上挂了一些漂亮的图片。

en: With a two-screen phone, you can watch movies on one side and check emails on the other.
zh: 有了双屏手机，你可以在一边看电影，另一边查看电子邮件。

en: My sight is failing.
zh: 我的视力在下降。

en: Did you do any sightseeing there?
zh: 在那儿你游览观光了没？

en: Many people choose to have a baby in the year of the dragon because dragon is a sign of power and status.
zh: 很多人选择在龙年生孩子，因为龙是权力和地位的象征。

en: He persuaded her to sign the document.
zh: 他说服她在文件上签字。

en: A red lamp is often a danger signal.
zh: 红灯常常是危险的信号。

en: The alarm system signaled an intruder in the building.
zh: 警报系统示意大楼里有入侵者。

en: He generally keeps silent at a meeting.
zh: 他通常在会上保持沉默。

en: The dress was made of ivory silk.
zh: 这件连衣裙是用象牙色丝绸做成的。

en: That's a silly question.
zh: 那是个愚蠢的问题。

en: The accident was similar to one that happened in 1931.
zh: 这次事故和 1931 年发生的那起很像。

en: The operation of this machine is simple.
zh: 这台机器的操作很简单。

en: Because of the bad service, the restaurant has received a lot of complaints since last December.
zh: 因为糟糕的服务，自去年 12 月以来这家餐厅已收到许多投诉。

en: Since Jennifer is the tallest girl in the class, you can find her easily in the classroom.
zh: 由于珍妮弗是班里最高的女孩，在课堂上很容易找到她。

en: Since you have made up your mind to lose weight, you'd better eat less in the evening.
zh: 既然你已经下定决心要减肥，你最好晚上少吃点。

en: How beautifully you sing!
zh: 你唱得多美呀！

en: My mother is a singer in a famous band.
zh: 我妈妈是一个著名乐队的歌手。

en: Never just memorise single English words. Learn by heart the whole sentences and the phrases so we may know how to use the words.
zh: 不要只背单个英语单词，要记住整个句子和词组，这样我们就可以知道如何使用这些单词。

en: Dear Sir, I am very glad and honoured to write to you.
zh: 亲爱的先生，我能给你写信真是感到十分荣幸。

en: She's as clever as her sister is.
zh: 她和她的妹妹一样聪明。

en: The grown-ups will sit at one table and the children at another.
zh: 大人坐一桌，孩子坐另一桌。

en: A troublesome situation has grown up.
zh: 出现了使人感到棘手的局面。

en: I'd like to change this dress for one in a larger size.
zh: 我想把这件衣服换成大号的。

en: I like winter, because I like to skate.
zh: 我喜欢冬天，因为我喜欢滑冰。

en: Finding the main idea in a paragraph is just one of these reading skills.
zh: 在段落里找中心思想只是阅读技能之一。

en: Is it true that drinking much water prevents the skin from drying out?
zh: 多喝水能防止皮肤干燥，这是真的吗？

en: It's a nice skirt.
zh: 这条裙子很漂亮。

en: A bright moving object appeared in the sky at sunset.
zh: 日落时分，天空中出现了一个移动的发光物体。

en: The boy was too excited to sleep well last night.
zh: 昨晚那个男孩太兴奋了，根本睡不好。
rewrite: The boy was so excited that he couldn't sleep well last night.

en: Nature seems to be wakened from a dead sleep.
zh: 大自然似乎从沉睡中被唤醒了。

en: It is impossible for him to finish the job in two hours. He is so slow.
zh: 他的动作是如此缓慢，不可能在2个小时内完成这项工作。

en: The cars moved slowly because of the heavy snow.
zh: 因为大雪，车辆缓慢地移动。
rewrite: The cars moved slowly because it snowed heavily.

en: My parents often tell me we should care for small creatures.
zh: 我的父母经常告诉我，我们应该关心小动物。

en: He thinks he's smarter than Sarah.
zh: 他认为他比萨拉聪明。

en: Coffee is ready. How nice it smells! Would you like some?
zh: 咖啡好了。闻起来真香啊！您来点儿吗？

en: It has a nice smell.
zh: 它的气味真好闻。

en: When he saw me, he smiled and waved.
zh: 他一看见我，就微笑着朝我挥挥手。

en: “There are some sandwiches if you're hungry,” she said with a smile.
zh: 她笑着说道：“你要是饿的话，这有一些三明治。”

en: The house is full of smoke.
zh: 满屋子都是烟。

en: Since you are badly ill, you'd better give up smoking.
zh: 由于你病得厉害，你最好戒烟。

en: I only have a snack at lunch time.
zh: 午饭我只吃了点小吃。

en: The mountains were crowned with snow.
zh: 山上积满了雪。

en: In winter the more heavily it snows, the happier the children will feel.
zh: 在冬天雪下得越大，孩子们就会越快乐。

en: I liked to walk in fields on snowy days and to see my footprints left behind.
zh: 我喜欢在下雪天走在田野里，看看我留下的脚印。

en: Some kinds of computers are so tiny that people may be unaware of them.
zh: 有些种类的电脑是如此小，以至于人们可能都没有注意到。

en: It was amazing for us to see so many beautiful places on the way.
zh: 让我们惊叹的是一路上看到这么多美丽的地方。

en: Martin and his friends didn't eat up all the food they ordered, so they took the rest away.
zh: 马丁和他的朋友没有吃完他们所点的食物，所以他们把剩下的打包了。

en: Team sports help to develop a child's social skills.
zh: 集体体育运动有助于培养孩子的社交能力。

en: Do you think we ought to learn to be useful to the society?
zh: 你是否认为我们应该学着成为对社会有用的人？

en: I like this silk dress, and it feels so soft and comfortable.
zh: 我喜欢这件丝绸连衣裙，它摸上去是这么的柔软舒适。

en: “My father,” said Lucie, softly laying her hand on his.
zh: “爸爸，”露西叫了一声，温柔地把手放在他的手上。

en: A soldier must obey his superior officers.
zh: 士兵必须服从上级军官。

en: Finally, they found a solution to the problem.
zh: 最后，他们找到了解决问题的办法。

en: It is very difficult to solve the problem of air pollution.
zh: 解决空气污染问题是非常困难的。

en: Here is some information on the best cities for your studying abroad.
zh: 这儿有最适合您出国留学的城市的一些信息。

en: Would you like some apple juice?
zh: 你要来点苹果汁吗？

en: He asked for money and I gave him some.
zh: 他向我要钱，我给了他一些。

en: You needn't tell me about this. Someone sent me a message about it three days ago.
zh: 你不必告诉我了。3 天前有人发消息给我说过这件事了。

en: I can't connect my computer to the internet. There must be something wrong with it.
zh: 我的电脑连不上网。一定是哪里出问题了。

en: We have to admit sometimes the most expensive one is not always the best one.
zh: 我们不得不承认，有时候最贵的并不总是最好的。

en: Her son looked sad when he learned that he hadn't passed the final exam.
zh: 当得知自己没通过期末考试，她的儿子看起来很悲伤。

en: We have learned three English songs since last week.
zh: 自从上个星期以来，我们已经学了 3 首英文歌曲。

en: We'll have a three-day holiday soon. What about going to Chongming Island?
zh: 不久我们将有 3 天假期。去崇明岛怎么样？

en: We must finish cleaning the office as soon as possible.
zh: 我们必须尽快打扫完办公室。

en: I'm sorry for giving so much trouble.
zh: 对不起，给你添了这么多麻烦。

en: — Sorry for keeping you waiting for me so long. — That's OK.
zh: ——对不起，让您久等了。——没关系。

en: At the foot of the hill, you can hear nothing but the sound of the running water.
zh: 在山脚下，除了流水声，你什么都听不到。

en: What you said sounds reasonable. But it still needs to be discussed.
zh: 你说的话听起来很合理。但它仍然需要加以讨论。

en: The restaurant serves various soups.
zh: 这家饭店供应各种各样的汤。

en: I'm lost, which direction is south?
zh: 我迷路了，哪个方向是南？

en: We lived in a village on the south coast.
zh: 我们住在南部海岸的一个小村庄里。

en: The birds flew south for the winter.
zh: 鸟类飞去南方过冬。

en: Linda and her friends had a discussion about space planes.
zh: 琳达和她的朋友们进行了有关太空飞机的讨论。

en: He spaced the plants two feet apart to give them room to grow.
zh: 他把植物间隔两英尺栽种，给它们生长空间。

en: The spaceship went back to the earth successfully.
zh: 宇宙飞船成功地重返地球。

en: He doesn't often read books in the library in his spare time.
zh: 在业余时间他不经常在图书馆看书。

en: Can you tell me who will speak at the class meeting next Monday?
zh: 你能否告诉我下星期一谁将在班会上发言？

en: Tom speaks French most fluently in his class.
zh: 汤姆在他班里是法语讲得最流利的。
rewrite: Nobody else in Tom's class can speak French as fluently as he.

en: His accent is quite special.
zh: 他的口音非常特别。

en: Damon received a special gift on his fifth birthday.
zh: 达蒙在他5岁生日那天收到了一份特别的礼物。

en: The scientist gave a lot of speeches on environmental protection.
zh: 这位科学家做了很多关于环境保护的演讲。

en: Our speed averaged out at 50 km an hour.
zh: 我们的平均速度是每小时 50 公里。

en: He sped his car through the street.
zh: 他开车加速穿过街道。

en: He doesn't spend much time on his homework.
zh: 他花在作业上的时间不多。

en: She feeds the baby with a spoon.
zh: 她用汤匙给婴儿喂食。

en: More than two hundred students took part in the school sports meeting yesterday.
zh: 昨日，200 多名学生参加了学校运动会。

en: The bird spread its wings.
zh: 鸟儿展开翅膀。

en: I could smell the spring in the air.
zh: 我在空气中闻到了春天的气息。

en: The cat sprang onto the table to catch the toy mouse.
zh: 猫咪跳上桌子去抓玩具老鼠。

en: What a wonderful concert they are putting on in the city square!
zh: 他们正在城市广场上演出一场多么美妙的音乐会啊！

en: A board four feet square contains 16 square feet.
zh: 4 英尺见方的木板面积为 16 平方英尺。

en: She is on friendly terms with most of the school staff.
zh: 她和学校大多数员工友好相处。

en: He doesn’t need much money for his collection of stamps.
zh: 他集邮不需要很多的钱。

en: We stood because there were no seats.
zh: 没有座位，我们只好站着。

en: The sun is a star.
zh: 太阳是一颗恒星。

en: The shy boy wondered, “How should I start my speech?”
zh: 那个害羞的男孩想知道如何开始他的演讲。
rewrite: The shy boy wondered how to start his speech.

en: The runners lined up at the start.
zh: 赛跑选手在起跑线排成一行。

en: His apartment was in a terrible state of disorder.
zh: 他的公寓凌乱不堪。

en: We must pay taxes to the State.
zh: 我们必须向国家纳税。

en: How far is the train station from your home?
zh: 你家离火车站有多远？

en: An experienced Indian guide is provided during your stay.
zh: 在你逗留期间给你配备了一位经验丰富的印第安向导。

en: Did Mary tell you how long she would stay with us?
zh: 玛丽有没有告诉你她要和我们住在一起多久？

en: Old people had better exercise every day to stay healthy.
zh: 老年人最好每天锻炼以保持身体健康。

en: I ate four steaks yesterday.
zh: 昨天我吃了4块牛排。

en: The suspect admitted stealing the valuable vase after the detective showed him the proof.
zh: 当侦探给这个犯罪嫌疑人看了证据后，他承认偷了贵重的花瓶。

en: Steam can be seen rising from the wet clothes near the fire.
zh: 我们可以看见水蒸气从靠近火的湿衣服中升起。

en: He decided to steam the vegetables for a healthier meal.
zh: 为了吃得更健康，他决定把蔬菜蒸一下。

en: We are too tired and hungry, so our steps are getting slower and slower.
zh: 我们又饿又累，所以我们的脚步越来越慢。

en: He steps the pavements.
zh: 他在人行道上行走。

en: What's wrong with this stamp? It won't stick.
zh: 这邮票怎么回事？粘不住了。

en: He picked up sticks to make a fire.
zh: 他拾些小树枝来生火。

en: My grandpa is in his seventies but still very strong and healthy.
zh: 我的爷爷七十多岁了，但依然身强体健。

en: Keep still while I fasten your shoe.
zh: 站着别动，我给你系鞋带。

en: On Christmas Eve I hung up my stocking along with my sisters’.
zh: 圣诞夜，我把我的长筒袜跟姐妹们的挂在了一起。

en: Henry got a stomachache and asked to be excused.
zh: 亨利肚子疼，请求离开一下。

en: Ancient men made tools of stone.
zh: 古人制作了石头工具。

en: Stop complaining about the traffic. Just think about what we can do to improve it.
zh: 别抱怨交通。好好想想，我们能为此做些什么来改善。

en: It’s six in the evening. Why not stop to have supper?
zh: 晚上 6 点了，为什么还不停下来吃晚饭？

en: There’s a bus stop near the school.
zh: 学校附近有个公共汽车站。

en: She opened a hat store in Paris.
zh: 她在巴黎开了一家帽子店。

en: Tinned milk can be stored for a long time.
zh: 罐装牛奶可储藏很长时间。

en: One day we met with a big storm.
zh: 有天我们遇上了一场暴风雨。

en: Mr. Black told us several funny stories at the party last night.
zh: 昨晚在聚会上布莱克先生给我们讲了一些有趣的故事。

en: Keep the boat in a straight line.
zh: 让船保持直线航行。

en: Jack didn't notice the motorcycle and walked straight across.
zh: 杰克没注意到摩托车，径直走了过去。

en: She was a strange sort of person; I couldn't make her out.
zh: 她这个人有些古怪，我搞不懂她。

en: Strawberry is in season this month.
zh: 这个月草莓正当令。

en: I hate the dogs that create a lot of mess in the streets.
zh: 我讨厌狗把街道搞得乱七八糟。

en: Stress may act as a trigger for these illnesses.
zh: 压力可能会成为引发这些疾病的原因。

en: They also stress the need for improved employment opportunities, better transport and health care.
zh: 他们同时强调需要增加就业机会，改善交通和医疗保健服务。

en: As a student, you have to be strict with yourself.
zh: 作为一名学生，你必须严格要求自己。

en: The boxer struck his opponent with a powerful blow.
zh: 拳手一记重拳打在了对手身上。

en: The employees went on a strike to show their dissatisfaction with the company's policies.
zh: 雇员们举行了罢工以表示对公司政策的不满。

en: Mr. Baker is still very strong in his nineties, and he often goes out for a walk.
zh: 贝克先生 90 多岁了依然很硬朗，还经常出去散步。

en: I was stuck at home with flu.
zh: 感冒把我困在了家中。

en: Students can learn more effectively by discovering the answers for themselves.
zh: 学生通过自主探寻答案，能更高效地学习。

en: The students had an enjoyable time when they went for an outing.
zh: 当学生们去郊游时，他们度过了一段愉快的时光。

en: We can study in the classroom.
zh: 我们可以在教室里学习。

en: Biology is the study of how living things work.
zh: 生物学是研究生物功能的学科。

en: They were stupid not to follow your advice.
zh: 他们不听你的劝告真傻。

en: Each piece of furniture in their home suited the style of the house.
zh: 他家里的每件家具都与房子的风格相配。

en: The students took the PISA test in three subjects: reading, maths and science.
zh: 学生参加了 PISA 3 个科目的测试：阅读、数学和科学。

en: You won't succeed unless you put in the effort and stay focused.
zh: 除非你付出努力并保持专注，否则就不会成功。

en: I think my friends will succeed in winning the basketball match.
zh: 我认为我的朋友会在篮球赛中获胜。

en: The young actor's debut was a great success.
zh: 那位年轻演员的处女秀取得了巨大成功。

en: His attempt to become a civil servant came very close to success.
zh: 他差一点儿就当上公务员了。

en: I don't know how I can be a successful English learner.
zh: 我不知道怎样才能成为一名成功的英语学习者。
rewrite: I don't know how to be a successful English learner.

en: Miss Li's new teaching method was successful in attracting students' attention.
zh: 李老师的新教学方法成功吸引了学生们的注意力。

en: He was proud of having such a good friend.
zh: 他为有这样的好朋友而自豪。

en: Such are the most powerful voices of our times!
zh: 这些就是我们时代最有力的声音！

en: Suddenly, all the lights went out and people had to wait in the darkness.
zh: 突然，所有的灯都熄灭了，人们不得不在黑暗中等待。

en: I often suffer from unaccountable headaches.
zh: 我常莫名其妙地头疼。

en: Students observed the solution of sugar in tea.
zh: 学生们观察了糖在茶中溶解的情况。

en: I suggested teaching the foreign students how to use chopsticks.
zh: 我建议教外国学生如何使用筷子。

en: It's raining heavily. I'd suggest you call a taxi home now.
zh: 雨下得很大。我建议你此刻还是叫一辆出租车回家吧。

en: Shall I give you a written suggestion?
zh: 需要我给您一份书面建议吗？

en: David didn't know where he was going to spend his holiday this summer.
zh: 今年夏天戴维不知道要去哪里度假。

en: I want to sit in the sun.
zh: 我想在太阳下面坐一坐。

en: There were many visitors in the Science Museum last Sunday.
zh: 上星期日科学博物馆有许多游客。

en: Because of the warm and sunny weather, oranges grow very well here.
zh: 因为气候温暖、阳光充足，这儿的橘子长得很好。

en: We had a super time at the party last night.
zh: 我们在昨晚的派对上玩得超级开心。

en: How far is it from the school to the nearest supermarket?
zh: 从学校到最近的超市有多远？

en: Neither Betty nor Peter has potatoes for supper.
zh: 无论是贝蒂还是彼得晚餐都没有吃土豆。
rewrite: Betty doesn't have potatoes for supper. Neither does Peter.

en: He did a part-time job so that he could support his family.
zh: 为了养家，他做了一份兼职工作。

en: I support International Milan while my son supports AC Milan.
zh: 我支持国际米兰队，而我儿子却支持 AC 米兰队。

en: They gave me so much support.
zh: 他们给了我很大的支持。

en: I suppose prices will go down.
zh: 我想物价会下降。

en: Suppose rooms are fully booked on that day — what then?
zh: 假定那天房间都订满了——那怎么办？

en: Don't worry about the exam. You should be sure of yourselves.
zh: 不要为考试担心。你们应该相信自己。

en: Now boys and girls, be sure to come here on time tomorrow morning.
zh: 好了，孩子们，明天早上务必准时到这里。

en: About three-fourths of the earth's surface is covered by water.
zh: 大约四分之三的地球表面被水覆盖。

en: I have a surprise for you.
zh: 我要告诉你一件意想不到的事。

en: The fans were so surprised to know his death.
zh: 粉丝们惊讶地得知他去世的消息。

en: You will be surprised at how quickly the world around you will change.
zh: 你会惊讶于周围的世界变化如此之快。

en: We surveyed 500 customers about their shopping habits last month.
zh: 上个月我们调查了 500 名顾客的购物习惯。

en: Some households participated in the survey on community safety.
zh: 一些家庭参与了这项针对社区安全的民意调查。

en: It's important that these upland farms continue to survive.
zh: 重要的是，这些高原农场能继续存在下去。

en: You cannot sweep it up.
zh: 你无法清除它。

en: Her voice was as soft and sweet as a young girl's.
zh: 她的声音和小女孩的一样温柔悦耳。

en: Eating too many sweets is bad for your teeth.
zh: 吃太多甜食对牙齿不好。

en: Nobody taught me how to swim. I learnt it by myself.
zh: 没有人教我如何游泳。我是自学的。

en: When can we go for a swim?
zh: 我们什么时候可以去游泳？

en: The dove is a universal symbol of peace.
zh: 鸽子被普遍认为是和平的象征。

en: For the banking system, however, there are still signs of dislocation.
zh: 不管怎样，就银行体系来说仍然存在混乱的迹象。

en: This ticket belongs to my brother. Yours is on the table.
zh: 这张票是我兄弟的。你的在桌子上。

en: The teacher agreed to let us take the test papers home.
zh: 老师答应让我们把试卷带回家。

en: “Dear passengers, don’t forget to take your belongings with you when you get off,” the bus conductor said.
zh: 售票员说：“亲爱的乘客们，下车时不要忘了随身携带的物品。”

en: The local government is taking actions to stop polluting the river.
zh: 当地政府正在采取措施防止污染河流。

en: Take this medicine three times a day.
zh: 这个药一天三次。

en: Students don’t have to take crowded buses any more. They can take special school buses.
zh: 学生再也不用乘拥挤的公共汽车，他们可以乘专用校车。

en: It takes him one hour to finish his homework.
zh: 他花了一个小时完成他的作业。
rewrite: He spends one hour finishing his homework.

en: — Would you like me to take a photo of you in front of the church? — Yes, please.
zh: ——你要我帮你在教堂前拍张照片吗？——好的。

en: The mother found that her son had a musical talent.
zh: 母亲发现儿子有音乐天赋。

en: The President gave a talk on TV.
zh: 总统在电视上作了一次演讲。

en: Sure, you can talk to me!
zh: 你当然可以和我讲话！

en: Tommy is the tallest student in our class.
zh: 汤米是我们班最高的学生。

en: A dripping tap wastes water.
zh: 滴水的龙头会浪费水。

en: It's too noisy. I cannot hear the tape clearly.
zh: 太吵了。我都听不清磁带了。

en: The second task is to do something useful.
zh: 第二项任务是做一件有意义的事情。

en: The fruit from Hainan tastes nice. Will you taste some more?
zh: 来自海南的水果味道不错。你要多尝一些吗？

en: This is my fifth try to make the curry chicken taste right.
zh: 这是我第五次尝试把咖喱鸡做得味道正宗。

en: The freshly baked bread smelt so good that all the customers wanted to have a taste.
zh: 刚烤好的面包闻起来太香了，以至于所有顾客都想尝一尝。

en: No, she dislikes the taste of it.
zh: 不，她不喜欢这种味道。

en: I don't often go to school by taxi.
zh: 我不经常坐出租车去学校。

en: — Sorry I'm late, Tony. The minibus broke down, and there were no taxis. — That's all right.
zh: ——托尼，对不起，我迟到了。因为中巴车抛锚了，又没有出租车。——没关系。

en: Tea is the most popular drink in the world besides water.
zh: 除了水，茶是世界上最流行的饮料。

en: To make lessons lively, our teacher taught us English in a special way.
zh: 为了使课堂气氛活跃，老师用一种特殊的方式教我们英语。

en: Eric won't start the experiment until his teacher shows him how to do it.
zh: 直到老师教他如何做实验，埃里克才开始动手。

en: However, film-making is team work. You probably need many other people to help you.
zh: 不管怎样，电影制作是团队工作。你可能需要许多人来帮助你。

en: The school volleyball team were welcomed when they returned with a championship of the match.
zh: 校排球队获得冠军，回来时受到了欢迎。

en: Her eyes filled with tears.
zh: 她双眼噙满泪水。

en: The development of 5G technology will change our daily life greatly.
zh: 5G 技术的发展将极大地改变我们的日常生活。

en: Board games are more and more popular among teenagers.
zh: 棋类游戏在青少年中越来越流行了。

en: I'll telephone you as soon as I get home.
zh: 我一到家就给你打电话。

en: They usually exchanged messages by telephone.
zh: 他们一般通过电话互通消息。

en: The Smiths were watching TV when the telephone rang.
zh: 史密斯一家正在看电视，这时电话响了。

en: Who can tell me the meaning of that sign?
zh: 谁能告诉我那个标志的含义？

en: What useful information my father has told me!
zh: 父亲告诉了我多么有用的信息啊！

en: The food and medicine must be kept at a low temperature.
zh: 食品和药物必须在低温下保存。

en: Do you know where this temple is?
zh: 你知道这座寺庙在哪里吗？

en: I practise playing tennis every weekend.
zh: 我每周末都练习打网球。

en: George has made less progress in English this term than before.
zh: 乔治这学期的英语进步比以前小。

en: It is terrible to tell a lie.
zh: 说谎是件很糟糕的事。

en: Either measure the temperature with a thermometer or test the water with your wrist.
zh: 要么用温度计测量水温，要么用你的手腕来试水温。

en: The teacher wondered if Edward had corrected his mistakes in the test paper.
zh: 老师想知道爱德华是否已纠正试卷上的错误了。

en: The text is too difficult for me to understand.
zh: 这篇课文对我来说太难理解了。

en: Please remember to text me when you arrive safely.
zh: 安全到达后别忘了给我发短信。

en: He is more talented than she thinks.
zh: 他比她想象的更有天赋。

en: Mary used to be the tallest girl in Class Two, but now Alice is taller than Mary.
zh: 玛丽曾是二班最高的女生，但现在爱丽丝比玛丽高。

en: — Thank you for offering us such a good meal. — I'm glad you all enjoyed it.
zh: ——谢谢您为我们提供了这么可口的一餐。——我很高兴你们吃得满意。

en: Thanks a lot.
zh: 非常感谢。

en: The local people are thankful that the whole nation are helping them rebuild the town.
zh: 当地群众感激全国人民帮助他们重建家园。

en: The old man is so thankful that he almost comes to tears.
zh: 这位老人感激得差点儿流泪了。

en: That house is for sale.
zh: 那套房子正在出售。

en: The traffic in Cairo is much heavier than that in Tokyo.
zh: 开罗的交通比东京的还要拥挤。

en: “Don't always make Michael do this or that. He is already a big boy, dear,” Mr. Bush said to his wife.
zh: 布什先生对他的妻子说：“亲爱的，不要总是让迈克尔做这做那。他已经是个大男孩了。”
