en: Everyone knows that human life is limited.
zh: 谁都知道，人的生命是有限的。

en: During our visit to London we often went to the theatre.
zh: 我们在伦敦逗留期间常去看戏。

en: Then she began to cry.
zh: 然后她就开始哭。

en: I live near my school. It takes me only ten minutes to walk there.
zh: 我住在学校附近。我步行到那里只需 10 分钟。

en: There was a deadly silence after the manager finished speaking at the meeting.
zh: 经理在会上发言结束后，现场一片死寂。

en: Both he and I are very busy these days. We have decided not to go there.
zh: 这些天我和他都很忙。我们已决定不去那儿了。

en: These are my children.
zh: 这些是我的孩子。

en: The blue book is thick.
zh: 那本蓝色的书很厚。

en: It's difficult to decide which way to take in a dark and thick forest.
zh: 在漆黑茂密的森林里，很难决定走哪条路。

en: That boy is the thinnest one in his class.
zh: 那个男孩是全班最瘦的。

en: Water is a good thing.
zh: 水是个好东西。

en: We all think James will possibly be an artist when he grows up.
zh: 我们都认为詹姆斯长大后可能会成为一名艺术家。

en: — Would you pass me something to drink? I'm a bit thirsty. — What about some juice?
zh: ——给我一些喝的，好吗？我有点口渴了。——果汁怎样？

en: I like this coat better than that one.
zh: 相比那件，我更喜欢这件大衣。

en: First prize will go to the best performance this evening.
zh: 一等奖将颁发给今晚最好的节目。

en: This is my brother.
zh: 这是我哥哥。

en: Those children are lovely.
zh: 那些孩子很可爱。

en: These apples are bigger than those I bought last week.
zh: 这些苹果比我上周买的那些大。

en: Thought helps us solve problems.
zh: 思考帮助我们解决问题。

en: The thief was climbing through the window when the police arrived.
zh: 警察到达时，小偷正从窗户爬出去。

en: The team achieved success through hard work and dedication.
zh: 团队凭借努力工作和奉献取得了成功。

en: New scientific centres have been established throughout China.
zh: 中国各地建立了许多新的科学研究中心。

en: Don't throw rubbish everywhere!
zh: 别乱丢垃圾！

en: With a swift throw, she managed to hit the target and win the prize.
zh: 她快速一掷，成功命中目标并赢得了奖品。

en: Thanksgiving Day is celebrated on the fourth Thursday in November in the U.S.A. every year.
zh: 美国每年在 11 月的第 4 个星期四庆祝感恩节。

en: Sarah doesn't know how she can book a plane ticket by telephone.
zh: 萨拉不知道怎样通过电话预订机票。
rewrite: Sarah doesn't know how to book a plane ticket by telephone.

en: Edward, you have grown up. You should learn to make your own room tidy.
zh: 爱德华，你已经长大了。你应该学会自己整理房间。

en: Family ties can provide a sense of belonging and security in times of need.
zh: 家庭纽带可以在需要时提供归属感和安全感。

en: Then she managed to tie it to a tree beside the road.
zh: 然后她想办法把它拴在路边的一棵树上。

en: The two teams tied in the final match.
zh: 两只队伍在最后的比赛中打成平局。

en: There are tigers in the forest.
zh: 森林里有老虎。

en: They had to wait till Monday to phone the bank.
zh: 他们不得不等到星期一才打电话给银行。

en: Please don’t get off the bus till it stops.
zh: 请等车停了再下车。

en: You never know what you can do till you try.
zh: 直到尝试了，你才会知道自己能做什么。

en: It is time for lunch.
zh: 吃中饭的时间到了。
rewrite: It is time to have lunch.

en: That was a difficult time in my life.
zh: 那是我人生中一个艰难的时期。

en: What time is it now?
zh: 现在几点了？

en: This is the fifth time our city has held the International Marathon.
zh: 这是我市第五次举办国际马拉松赛事。

en: Life was very different in ancient times.
zh: 在古代，生活非常不同。

en: Do you have any small bills for the tip?
zh: 你有没有给小费的小额钞票？

en: They were all very tired, but none of them stopped to have a rest.
zh: 他们都非常疲惫，但没有一个人停下来休息。

en: The title of the article is Aliens.
zh: 这篇文章的标题是《外星人》。

en: It is time to go to school.
zh: 到上学的时间了。
rewrite: It is time for school.

en: The weather is pleasant today.
zh: 今天天气令人愉快。

en: Is there any news in today's newspaper?
zh: 今天的报纸上有什么新闻？

en: What a nice day! Let's go for a picnic on the beach together.
zh: 天气真不错啊！我们一起去沙滩上野餐吧。

en: Sally, together with some other students, is always ready to help others.
zh: 莎莉，连同一些其他学生，总是乐于帮助别人。

en: She spread some tomato paste on the fried fish.
zh: 她在炸好的鱼上涂了一些番茄酱。

en: Jane doesn't want to see the film War and Peace with her friend tomorrow.
zh: 简明天不想和她的朋友一起去看电影《战争与和平》。

en: Let me look carefully at tomorrow's arrangements.
zh: 让我仔细看一下明天的安排。

en: Tom asked me if I was going to see the film tonight.
zh: 汤姆问我今晚是否要去看电影。

en: Tonight is the opening night of the opera.
zh: 今晚是这部歌剧的首演之夜。

en: It's not safe for teenagers to give out too much information about themselves on the internet.
zh: 青少年在互联网上提供太多有关自己的信息, 这是不安全的。

en: The gardener's tools are kept in the shed.
zh: 花匠的工具放在小屋里。

en: It is necessary for everyone to brush his teeth after each meal.
zh: 对每个人来说, 餐后刷牙是必要的。

en: If you don't clean your teeth regularly, you will get toothache.
zh: 如果不定期清理牙齿, 你会牙痛的。
rewrite: Unless you clean your teeth regularly, you will get toothache.

en: On the top of the building, tourists can enjoy a nice view of the city.
zh: 在大楼的顶层, 游客可以欣赏城市的美景。

en: Even the top students in our class can't work out this problem, so it must be very difficult.
zh: 甚至连我们班上的尖子生也答不出这个问题，所以一定很难。

en: Let's change the topic!
zh: 我们换个话题吧！

en: When the baby touched the hot pot, he was aware of the danger.
zh: 宝宝碰到热锅时，意识到了危险。

en: The blind man relied on his sense of touch to navigate through the unfamiliar room.
zh: 这个盲人靠触觉在陌生的房间里寻找方向。

en: Shall we take a tour to the Summer Palace, Mrs. White?
zh: 怀特太太，我们去颐和园游览好吗？

en: The band plans to tour Asia this summer to promote their new album.
zh: 这个乐队打算今年夏天在亚洲巡回演出，以推广他们的新专辑。

en: Tourists enjoy swimming in the sea at the beautiful beaches in Bangkok.
zh: 在曼谷美丽的海滩，游客享受着在海中游泳的乐趣。

en: She walked towards the door.
zh: 她向门口走去。

en: The Oriental Pearl TV Tower has attracted tens of millions of visitors since 1995.
zh: 自 1995 年以来，东方明珠电视塔已吸引了数千万名游客。

en: The ancient oak tree towers above the rest of the forest.
zh: 这棵古老的橡树比森林里其他树都高。

en: We went to look around the town.
zh: 我们去参观了这个小镇。

en: — Shall I buy this toy for little David? — You'd better not. He might already have it.
zh: — 我给小戴维买这个玩具好吗？— 你最好不要。他可能已经有了。

en: Countries in the world differ in historical tradition.
zh: 世界各国在历史传统上各有不同。

en: Some Western people have traditional turkeys for Christmas dinner.
zh: 一些西方人会在圣诞晚餐时享用传统的火鸡。

en: We should obey traffic rules.
zh: 我们应该遵守交通规则。

en: It is cheaper to travel by train than by air.
zh: 乘火车旅游比乘飞机便宜。

en: Has the train from Xizang arrived? I'm looking forward to meeting my old friends.
zh: 从西藏来的火车到了吗？我期待着见到我的老朋友们。

en: He is training for the astronaut.
zh: 他为成为宇航员正在接受培训。

en: The students were asked to translate this text into English yesterday.
zh: 学生昨天被要求把这篇文章翻译成英文。

en: A helicopter was used to transport the wounded.
zh: 一架直升机被用来运送伤员。

en: The extra money could be spent on improving public transport.
zh: 多余的资金可以用于改善公共交通。

en: The company will provide transportation.
zh: 公司会提供交通工具。

en: Travel broadens the mind.
zh: 旅行使人心胸开阔。

en: Most people think that travelling abroad can enrich one's knowledge.
zh: 大多数人认为，出国旅游可以丰富自己的知识。

en: I would rather travel by train than by plane.
zh: 我宁愿乘火车也不愿乘飞机旅行。

en: How often do the students in our school plant trees?
zh: 我们学校的学生多久种一次树？

en: He played a dirty trick on me by refusing to do what he had promised.
zh: 他对我耍了个伎俩，拒绝做他所许诺的事。

en: We will have a one-week family trip to Harbin in the coming February.
zh: 在即将到来的二月，我们将有一次为期一周的家庭之旅去哈尔滨。

en: I wonder how I can deal with the trouble.
zh: 我想知道怎样解决这个麻烦。
rewrite: I wonder how to deal with the trouble.

en: Losing a little money doesn't trouble me.
zh: 损失一点钱，我并不在意。

en: I'm afraid this pair of trousers is too small. Would you please show me another pair?
zh: 恐怕这条裤子太小了。请您另外拿一条给我看看好吗？

en: He has been driving a truck for years and never had an accident.
zh: 他开了好几年卡车，从没出过岔子。

en: The golden fish said to the fisherman, “All your wishes will come true.”
zh: 金鱼对渔夫说：“你所有的愿望都会成真。”

en: There’s a feeling of warmth and trust here.
zh: 这里有一种温暖和信任的感觉。

en: Ben didn’t trust anyone to look after his pets properly.
zh: 本不相信有人能照看好他的宠物。

en: The police will try to find out the truth of the traffic accident.
zh: 警方将试图查明这起交通事故的真相。

en: Danny opened his heart to Mrs. Morgan and told her the truth.
zh: 丹尼向摩根夫人敞开心扉，告诉她真相。

en: Try to think how you will feel if you are hurt by others’ unfriendly behaviours.
zh: 如果你被别人不友好的行为伤害，试着想想你会有怎么样的感受。

en: Rose still failed in the examinations, though she tried her best.
zh: 尽管露丝尽力了，她考试还是不及格。

en: Have another try!
zh: 再试一试！

en: This Tuesday is Earth Day.
zh: 本周二是世界地球日。

en: Many people eat turkey for Thanksgiving Day.
zh: 许多人在感恩节吃火鸡。

en: Leaves turn yellow in autumn.
zh: 秋天树叶变黄了。

en: Would you turn down the radio a bit? We are making a plan for the coming term.
zh: 你把收音机音量调低一点好吗？我们正在为即将到来的学期做一项计划。

en: When you are in trouble, you can always turn to your friends for help.
zh: 当你遇到麻烦时，总是可以向朋友们求助。

en: It's your turn.
zh: 轮到你了。

en: Our school newspaper is published twice a month.
zh: 我们学校的报纸每月出版两次。

en: Unemployment here is twice the national average.
zh: 这儿的失业率是全国平均数的两倍。

en: He has a twin brother.
zh: 他有一个孪生兄弟。

en: I love this type of book.
zh: 我喜欢这类书籍。

en: Could you type this letter for me?
zh: 你能为我打这封信吗？

en: The weather in London is changeable, so you should take an umbrella with you.
zh: 伦敦的天气多变，所以要随身带把伞。

en: My uncle began to learn Chinese painting in his forties.
zh: 我叔叔在 40 多岁时开始学画中国画。

en: He took a deep breath before he went under.
zh: 他下去之前，深深地吸了口气。

en: There are special tickets for children under the age of 12.
zh: 12 岁以下儿童有特价票。

en: I found a convenient spot in the underground car park.
zh: 我在地下停车场找到一个方便的停车位。

en: The underground is quicker than the bus.
zh: 地铁比公共汽车快。

en: Read the passage and underline the topic of each paragraph.
zh: 阅读这篇文章，划出每段的主题。

en: Please pay attention to the underlined words.
zh: 请注意划线部分的单词。

en: I didn't understand what my teacher said in class, so I raised my hand.
zh: 我没听懂老师在课堂上讲的内容，所以我举手了。

en: It seems unfair on him to make him pay for everything.
zh: 让他承担一切费用似乎对他不公平。

en: The surfing was an unforgettable experience for both of us.
zh: 那次冲浪运动是我们两人都难以忘怀的经历。

en: Unfortunately, my time is limited.
zh: 可惜的是，我的时间有限。

en: Though I felt unhappy, I chose to smile and start a new day.
zh: 尽管我感到不开心，我还是选择微笑，开启新的一天。

en: The public got angry when they knew unhealthy food was fed to children at school.
zh: 当公众得知孩子们在学校吃了不健康的食物时，他们很愤怒。

en: John is fat and unhealthy because he doesn't take enough exercise.
zh: 约翰又胖又不健康，因为他没有进行足够的锻炼。

en: In our school, every student has to wear a uniform from Monday to Friday.
zh: 在我们学校，每个学生从星期一到星期五都必须穿校服。

en: The family is a social unit.
zh: 家庭是一个社会单位。

en: They got united as one man.
zh: 他们团结得就像一个人。

en: My uncle is a university teacher. He is loved by all his students.
zh: 我的叔叔是一名大学教师。学生们都爱他。

en: I'll be able to finish the project on time unless there are unexpected delays.
zh: 除非出现意外延误，否则我能按时完成这个项目。

en: We shan't know the results of the test until tomorrow.
zh: 我们明天才能知道考试结果。

en: We didn't start our discussion until everybody arrived.
zh: 等大家都到了，我们才开始讨论。

en: April Fool's Day is an unusual holiday. You can play a trick on anybody around you.
zh: 愚人节是一个不寻常的节日。你可以捉弄身边任何人。

en: “How are you?” is a very unusual question. It's a question that often doesn't need an answer.
zh: “你好吗？”是一个很不寻常的问题。这个问题往往不需要回答。

en: He always gets up late.
zh: 他总是很晚起床。

en: They were climbing up a narrow mountain road.
zh: 他们正爬上一条狭窄的山路。

en: What makes you so upset?
zh: 是什么让你心烦意乱？

en: You'll find it upstairs.
zh: 你能在楼上找到。

en: Her job is to show the customers how to use the computer.
zh: 她的工作是教客户如何使用电脑。

en: Is this book any use?
zh: 这本书有用吗？

en: It is a very useful book for language learners to improve writing skills.
zh: 对语言学习者提高写作能力来讲，这是一本非常有用的书。

en: What a useful tool the computer is!
zh: 电脑是多么有用的工具啊！

en: His advice was useless because he didn’t understand my real problem.
zh: 他的建议毫无用处，因为他根本不了解我真正的问题。

en: He came home later than usual.
zh: 他回家比平时晚。

en: I usually go to school by underground.
zh: 我通常乘地铁去学校。

en: Our value system does not match theirs.
zh: 我们的价值体系与他们的并不相同。

en: These old bottles have no practical value, but we can reuse them for decoration.
zh: 这些旧瓶子没有实际用途，但我们可以再次利用来做装饰。

en: I’ve done business with Mr. Weston before. I value the work he gives me.
zh: 我以前和韦斯顿先生有过业务往来，我很重视他给我的业务。

en: We have a variety of electronic products.
zh: 我们经营各种电子产品。

en: At the Import Expo, you can see various new products from different countries.
zh: 在进博会上，你能看到来自不同国家的各式各样的新产品。

en: I prefer vegetables to meat because they are good for my health.
zh: 比起肉我更喜欢吃蔬菜，因为它们对我的身体健康有好处。

en: Tony's words made his mother feel very excited.
zh: 托尼的话让他的母亲感到非常兴奋。

en: The football team's victory brought great excitement to the entire city.
zh: 这支足球队的胜利让整座城市兴奋不已。

en: The video cameras are so nice. I really don't know which to choose.
zh: 这些摄像机都这么好。我真的不知道该选哪个。

en: I am in favour of your view on spending pocket money. It's reasonable.
zh: 我赞成你有关花零用钱的看法。这是合理的。

en: Water pollution is one of the most serious problems in that village.
zh: 在那个村里，水污染是最严重的问题之一。

en: Mary plays the violin very well.
zh: 玛丽小提琴拉得很好。

en: We started our visit to the United States on February 13.
zh: 2月13日，我们开始了对美国的访问。

en: Many foreign tourists come to China primarily to visit the Great Wall.
zh: 许多外国游客来中国主要是参观长城。

en: Every day, we examine the visitors' passports carefully before they check in.
zh: 每天旅客入住前，我们都要仔细检查他们的护照。

en: She speaks in a soft voice.
zh: 她说话声很柔和。

en: We play volleyball after class.
zh: 放学后我们打排球。

en: The volunteers run with the runners to make sure they arrive safely in the end.
zh: 志愿者们跟随运动员一起跑，以确保他们最终安全到达。

en: Why don't you volunteer the information?
zh: 为什么你不自愿提供消息呢？

en: As we all know, it's not polite to keep others waiting for a long time.
zh: 我们都知道，让别人久等是不礼貌的。

en: Mary's brothers work as waiters in a five-star hotel.
zh: 玛丽的兄弟在一家五星级酒店当服务员。

en: We asked the waitress for another glass of wine.
zh: 我们请那位女侍者再来一杯酒。

en: Dona woke up and found herself in a hospital bed.
zh: 多娜醒来发现自己躺在医院的病床上。

en: While we were walking around our neighbourhood after supper, it began to rain.
zh: 晚饭后，我们在家附近散步时，天开始下雨了。

en: Why not have a walk?
zh: 为什么不出去走走呢？

en: The wall was painted blue.
zh: 墙壁被漆成蓝色。

en: There isn't much bread here, but you can take a little if you want to.
zh: 这里没有多少面包，但如果你想要你可以拿一点。

en: Susan wants to be an engineer.
zh: 苏珊的愿望是成为一名工程师。
rewrite: Susan's wish/hope is to be an engineer.

en: The war made millions of people homeless.
zh: 战争使数百万人无家可归。

en: It is warm in spring.
zh: 春天天气暖和。

en: The sun's rays helped warm the earth after a long winter.
zh: 漫长的冬季过后，太阳的光线帮助温暖了大地。

en: The police officer warned the children not to play near the busy road.
zh: 警察告诫孩子们不要在繁忙的马路边玩耍。

en: Mum has washed the carpet twice and now it's spotlessly clean.
zh: 妈妈把地毯洗了两次，现在是一尘不染。

en: I need to give my car a good wash this weekend.
zh: 这周末我得好好洗一下车。

en: Please take a short shower and don't waste water.
zh: 请快速冲个淋浴，不要浪费水。

en: What a waste to throw it away!
zh: 扔掉它多浪费！

en: Charlie found that he had the same watch as the driver.
zh: 查理发现他有块和司机一样的手表。

en: Watch your step! The floor is very slippery.
zh: 当心脚下！地板很滑。

en: Frank held his breath under the water to search for his ring in the swimming pool.
zh: 弗兰克在水下屏住呼吸，在游泳池里寻找他的戒指。

en: Please tell me whether you have watered the flowers.
zh: 请告诉我你是否已给花浇过水了。

en: He gave me a wave of the hand to say goodbye.
zh: 他向我挥手告别。

en: Jessica caught sight of Lois and waved to her.
zh: 杰茜卡看到了洛伊丝，向她挥手致意。

en: Beating and scolding a child is not a good way to make the child successful.
zh: 让孩子成才，打骂不是一个好方法。

en: She spoke in a weak voice.
zh: 她用微弱的声音说话。

en: Good health is true wealth.
zh: 健康是真正的财富。

en: They can see the words on the blackboard clearly, so they don't have to wear glasses.
zh: 他们可以看到黑板上的字，所以不需要戴眼镜。

en: I don't like the weather in February this year because there were many rainy days.
zh: 我不喜欢今年2月的天气，因为有很多雨天。

en: What fine weather! Let's go to fly kites.
zh: 多么好的天气啊！我们去放风筝吧。

en: Hundreds of internet service providers and web companies tested IPv6 on their websites.
zh: 数百家互联网服务商和网络公司在他们网站上对互联网协议第6版进行了测试。

en: I couldn't get much news of the exhibition of clean-energy products from the website.
zh: 我从网站上看不到很多关于清洁能源产品展览会的消息。

en: The meeting has been put off until next Wednesday afternoon.
zh: 会议已推迟到下星期三下午。

en: Some questions were raised in their class meeting last week.
zh: 在上星期的班会上有人提了一些问题。

en: He goes to school on weekdays.
zh: 他工作日去学校上学。

en: We used to stay at the Browns' for the weekend.
zh: 我们常常待在布朗家过周末。

en: How much does that typewriter weigh?
zh: 那台打字机有多重？

en: She weighs the pros and cons before making any major decisions.
zh: 她在做任何重要决定前都会权衡利弊。

en: How can Lisa lose weight so successfully in such a short time?
zh: 莉萨如何能在这么短的时间内减肥成功？

en: Fruit and vegetables are sold by weight.
zh: 水果和蔬菜是称重出售的。

en: He received a warm welcome at Cambridge.
zh: 他在剑桥受到了热烈的欢迎。

en: The visitors will be welcomed when they come to Shanghai.
zh: 游客来到上海时将受到热烈欢迎。

en: Welcome, friends!
zh: 朋友们，欢迎你们！

en: Members who are no longer welcome can easily be frozen out.
zh: 不再受欢迎的成员很容易被排挤掉。

en: I don't feel well today.
zh: 我今天感到不舒服。

en: How well Charles did at the school sports meeting this year!
zh: 查尔斯在今年的学校运动会上表现得多好啊!

en: An encyclopedia is a well of knowledge.
zh: 百科全书是知识的源泉。

en: Well, perhaps that's true.
zh: 嗯, 也许那是真的。

en: Well done!
zh: 做得好! 干得好!

en: The wind was blowing lightly from the west.
zh: 风从西面轻轻吹来。

en: The West Lake is famous for its beautiful scenery.
zh: 西湖以风景优美著称。

en: He decided to travel west to explore new territories.
zh: 他决定向西前行, 探索新的领地。

en: Which kind of food do you prefer, Chinese or Western?
zh: 你喜欢吃中餐, 还是喜欢吃西餐?

en: It is wet in the South, while the North is dry.
zh: 南方雨水充沛, 北方则比较干燥。

en: What is your name?
zh: 你叫什么名字?

en: What about going for a walk?
zh: 去散散步怎么样?

en: What an important city Yan'an was in the history of China!
zh: 在中国历史上延安是一座多么重要的城市啊!

en: What does it matter?
zh: 这有什么关系?

en: We will discuss what to teach during the next term.
zh: 我们将讨论下学期要教什么。

en: Susan is terribly sorry for what she has done.
zh: 苏珊为她所做的事情感到非常抱歉。

en: A good friend always gives you a helping hand when you're in trouble.
zh: 当你遇到麻烦时，好朋友总会向你伸出援助之手。

en: Could you tell me when they are going to set out?
zh: 你能否告诉我他们什么时候出发？

en: When did you last see Margaret?
zh: 你最近一次见到玛格丽特是什么时候？

en: Joyce has a good memory. She still remembers where she lived in her childhood.
zh: 乔伊丝记忆力很好。她还记得童年生活过的地方。

en: Stand where I can see you.
zh: 站在我能看得到你的地方。

en: I don't know whether you like flowers, sir.
zh: 我不知道您是否喜欢花，先生。

en: Sarah asked whether the boy had understood her instructions.
zh: 莎拉问这个男孩是否理解了她的指示。

en: Which T-shirt do you like better, the red one or the blue one?
zh: 你更喜欢哪件 T 恤衫，红色的还是蓝色的？

en: Which is the fifth day of a week?
zh: 一个星期的第五天是哪一天？

en: My father was preparing for his speech while my mother was doing some washing last night.
zh: 昨晚当我母亲在洗衣服时，我父亲在为他的演讲做准备。

en: He excels in math, while his brother excels in art.
zh: 他擅长数学，而他的兄弟擅长艺术。

en: I'll be back in a while.
zh: 我一会儿就回来。

en: Another world-famous building in Washington is the White House.
zh: 华盛顿另一座世界著名的建筑物是白宫。

en: Angels are usually shown in pictures dressed in white.
zh: 画中的天使通常身穿白衣。

en: Who do you think will win the first prize?
zh: 你觉得谁会赢得第一名呢？

en: Although Yuan Longping has left us, his remarkable achievements in hybrid research will always have great influence on the whole world.
zh: 袁隆平虽然离开了我们，但他在“杂交水稻”方面的杰出贡献将对整个世界产生巨大影响。

en: Did you know whom Bill was waiting for?
zh: 你知道比尔在等谁吗？

en: Whose books are these?
zh: 这些书是谁的？

en: Nobody knows why Betty has become so forgetful in recent years.
zh: 没有人知道为什么近年来贝蒂变得如此健忘。

en: They came to a wide river.
zh: 他们来到了一条宽阔的河边。

en: With the development of China, Chinese has become an international language and is widely used all over the world.
zh: 随着中国的发展, 汉语已成为一种国际语言, 在世界各地被广泛使用。

en: The town government has decided to widen this main street.
zh: 市政府决定拓宽这条主街。

en: Mr. Smith and his wife seldom drive their car to work, do they?
zh: 史密斯先生和他的妻子很少开车上班, 是吗?

en: We should protect wild animals.
zh: 我们应该保护野生动物。

en: Our headmaster will make a speech to the parents on the School Open Day.
zh: 在学校开放日, 我们的校长将向家长发表讲话。

en: Will you go to the zoo with us tomorrow?
zh: 你明天愿意和我们一起去动物园吗?

en: Nothing can stop a man with a strong will from achieving success.
zh: 没有什么能阻挡一个意志坚定的人获得成功。

en: Nobody knows which player will win the game until the last moment.
zh: 不到最后一刻没人知道哪位运动员会赢得这场比赛。

en: Wind is a motive power.
zh: 风是一种动力。

en: Could you possibly open that window for me?
zh: 你能为我打开那扇窗吗？

en: What fun it is to surf on a windy day!
zh: 在有风的日子冲浪是多么有趣啊！

en: You won't be able to make the best wine unless you choose the perfect grapes only.
zh: 只有选用极好的葡萄，才能酿造出最好的酒。
rewrite: Choose the perfect grapes only, or you won't be able to make the best wine.

en: Friendship is love without wings.
zh: 友谊是无翼之爱。

en: Wu Liangyong is one of the winners to get the State Preeminent Science and Technology Award.
zh: 吴良镛是国家最高科学技术奖的获奖者之一。

en: Miss Lin asked Dick if he was going to visit the Great Wall this winter.
zh: 林小姐问迪克今年冬天他是否要去游览长城。

en: Wisdom is more precious than wealth.
zh: 智慧比财富更珍贵。

en: They made a wise decision to leave there in a hurry before the heavy rain.
zh: 他们做了一个明智的决定，大雨前匆忙离开了那里。

en: My wish is to become a scientist when I grow up. What is yours, Betty?
zh: 我的愿望是长大后成为一名科学家。贝蒂，你的愿望是什么？

en: I wish you good health and a long life.
zh: 祝您健康长寿。

en: The famous actor often plays with his children in the park.
zh: 那位著名演员经常和他的孩子们在公园玩。

en: He passed me a knife to cut the birthday cake with.
zh: 他递过来一把刀，让我切生日蛋糕。

en: Although the expenses at Harvard University are high, students often pay less with the help of scholarships.
zh: 虽然哈佛大学的学费昂贵，但学生在奖学金的帮助下往往只要支付一点点。

en: The room is cooled with air conditioner.
zh: 这房间用空调降温。

en: The house is within eyesight.
zh: 这幢房子在视线范围之内。

en: The firemen arrived at the scene within five minutes after the call.
zh: 消防员在接到电话后5分钟之内就赶到了现场。

en: Without the glasses, he can't see the words on the blackboard clearly.
zh: 没戴眼镜，他看不清黑板上的字。

en: Nobody can solve that complex case without gathering sufficient evidence.
zh: 缺乏足够的证据，没人能侦破那个复杂的案件。

en: They want to kill the wolf.
zh: 他们想要把狼打死。

en: These women doctors have saved many children's lives since they worked in the hospital.
zh: 自从这些女医生在医院工作，她们救了很多孩子的生命。

en: Many women are more independent than before because they have jobs and earn money.
zh: 许多妇女比以前更独立，因为她们有工作、能赚钱。

en: I wonder when the university campus in China will open to the public.
zh: 我想知道中国的大学生校园什么时候将对公众开放。

en: Many people consider the internet to be one of the wonders of modern technology.
zh: 许多人认为，互联网是现代科技的奇迹之一。

en: We had such a wonderful time at his birthday party.
zh: 在他的生日聚会上，我们度过了如此美好的时光。

en: How wonderful this kind of computer is!
zh: 这种电脑多棒啊！

en: Paper is made from wood.
zh: 纸是由木头制成的。

en: Mr. Smith has recently built a wooden bridge over his pool in the garden.
zh: 史密斯先生最近在花园里的池塘上建造了一座木桥。

en: I can't understand the sentence though there are no new words in it.
zh: 我无法理解这句句子的意思，尽管句中没有新单词。

en: Alice was so surprised to hear about the death of her good friend that she couldn't say a word.
zh: 爱丽丝听到她好友去世的消息时太惊讶了，以至于一句话也说不出来。

en: The firemen didn't stop working until all the workers were saved.
zh: 直到所有的工人都得救了，消防队员才停止工作。
rewrite: The firemen stopped working when all the workers were saved.

en: The watch just stopped working.
zh: 这块手表刚坏了。

en: What important work the scientists are doing! Let's learn from them.
zh: 科学家所做的工作是多么重要啊！让我们向他们学习。

en: Nothing can be learned well without hard work.
zh: 不努力学习，什么也学不会。

en: In my opinion, this is Rembrandt's greatest work.
zh: 我认为这是伦勃朗最伟大的作品。

en: The workers were asked to go back to work at once.
zh: 工人们被要求立刻回去工作。

en: Shanghai attracts a lot of visitors from all over the world every year.
zh: 每年上海吸引很多来自世界各地的游客。

en: You have already tried your best, so you needn't worry too much about the exams.
zh: 你已经尽力了，所以不必太担心这次考试。

en: Mother's illness was always a great worry to me.
zh: 母亲的病一直是我非常担心的事。

en: It isn't worth spending so much time on gardening.
zh: 不值得花这么多时间在园艺上。
rewrite: It's a waste of time to spend so much time on gardening.

en: She said she would come.
zh: 她说过她会来的。

en: Would you like me to show you how to work out the math problem?
zh: 要我告诉你如何解答这道数学题吗？

en: My wound is still painful.
zh: 我的伤口还在痛。

en: This is the wounded soldier.
zh: 这就是那位受伤的战士。

en: He wrote his first symphony when he was 16.
zh: 他 16 岁时写了自己的第一部交响曲。

en: She has written four novels.
zh: 她写了 4 篇小说。

en: I wrote to let him know that I had arrived in Beijing.
zh: 我写信告诉他我已到达北京。

en: Who is the writer of the book War and Peace?
zh: 《战争与和平》这部书的作者是谁？

en: It's wrong of you to make fun of the disabled boy. You should apologise to him.
zh: 你取笑那个残疾男孩是不对的。你应该向他道歉。

en: What changeable weather it is this year!
zh: 今年的天气真是多变啊！

en: Yellow is my favourite colour.
zh: 黄色是我最喜欢的颜色。

en: Grandma's garden is full of bright yellow flowers.
zh: 外婆的花园种满了明艳的黄色花卉。

en: In yesterday's games, Switzerland beat the United States two to one.
zh: 在昨天的比赛中，瑞士队 2 比 1 打败了美国队。

en: What an amazing story he told us the day before yesterday!
zh: 前天他告诉我们的是一个多么令人惊叹的故事啊！

en: Has Danny given up smoking yet?
zh: 丹尼戒烟了吗？

en: The girl hasn't finished the project herself yet.
zh: 这个女孩自己还没有完成项目。

en: Do you have any low-fat yogurt?
zh: 你有没有低脂的酸奶？

en: She must be at least forty, but she likes dressing up as a young girl.
zh: 她至少有 40 岁了，但她喜欢打扮成年轻的姑娘。

en: It's a sunny late winter day, just a few degrees above zero.
zh: 这是晚冬晴朗的一天，只有零上几度。

en: There are two zeros in 1008.
zh: 在 1008 中有两个零。

en: Please take me to the zoo.
zh: 请带我去动物园。

en: The patient became a bit better after taking some medicine.
zh: 服药后，病人感觉好点了。

en: Danny has worked as a newspaper reporter for a couple of years.
zh: 丹尼担任报社记者已有几年了。

en: Apple is a kind of fruit.
zh: 苹果是一种水果。

en: This shop sells all kinds of watches from different countries.
zh: 这家商店出售来自不同国家的各种手表。

en: Although the World Expo was over, a lot of visitors still go to the China Pavilion to enjoy themselves and take photos.
zh: 虽然世博会结束了，但还是有很多游客去中国馆参观、拍照。

en: There is a pair of glasses on the desk.
zh: 桌子上有一副眼镜。

en: What an important piece of information it is!
zh: 这是一个多么重要的信息！

en: Above all Susie is a good and tireless writer.
zh: 首要的一点，苏茜是一位优秀的、不知疲倦的作家。

en: According to the traffic rules, a baby can not sit on an adult's lap in a car.
zh: 根据交通规则，婴儿不能坐在车内成年人的腿上。

en: Taking a different route to school can add variety to your day.
zh: 走不同的路线去上学，能为你的一天增添趣味变化。

en: He failed after all.
zh: 最终他还是失败了。

en: After all, practice makes perfect, so keep working on improving your skills.
zh: 毕竟，熟能生巧，所以继续努力提高你的技能吧。

en: I agree with you.
zh: 我同意你的意见。

en: He was very well thought of all over the district.
zh: 他在整个地区评价很高。

en: All right, I accept your apology.
zh: 好吧，我接受你的道歉。

en: Did you run all the way here?
zh: 你是一路跑来的吗？

en: Disneyland is an amusement park.
zh: 迪士尼是一个游乐园。

en: She spends her day doing housework, watching television, reading, and so on.
zh: 她用一天的时间来做家务、看电视、看书，等等。

en: You must apologize to her for having kept her waiting.
zh: 让她等了这么久，你必须为此向她道歉。

en: I arrived in Shanghai yesterday.
zh: 我昨天到的上海。

en: The food in Shanghai is not as hot as that in Sichuan.
zh: 上海的食物不像四川的食物那么辣。

en: It's okay to disagree as long as we respect each other's views.
zh: 只要我们尊重彼此的观点，有不同意见没关系。

en: As soon as George heard the bad news, his face turned pale.
zh: 乔治一听到坏消息，脸色就变得煞白。

en: She sings beautifully, and she can dance as well.
zh: 她歌唱得好，也会跳舞。

en: It is wonderful playing sports in this club and I have made lots of friends as well.
zh: 在这个俱乐部里运动太棒了，我还结交了很多朋友。

en: Miss Wu is our class teacher and our friend as well.
zh: 吴小姐不仅是我们的老师，还是我们的朋友。
rewrite: = Miss Wu is not only our class teacher but also our friend.

en: I’ll ask for your help if I can’t work out the problem.
zh: 如果我解不出这题，我会请你帮忙。

en: My family talk to each other at breakfast/lunch/supper.
zh: 我的家人在早/午/晚餐时交流。

en: The election went against him at first, but he won at last.
zh: 选举开始时对他不利，但最终他获胜了。

en: I have nothing to do at home.
zh: 我在家没事可做。

en: If all businesses go paperless, at least one million tons of paper will be saved.
zh: 如果所有的企业实现无纸化，至少能节省 100 万吨的纸。

en: The work will be completed inside four hours at most.
zh: 这项工作至多在 4 小时内完成。

en: If you see something strange, act at once and call the police.
zh: 如果你看到可疑情况，要立刻行动并报警。

en: More and more foreigners are living and working in Shanghai at present.
zh: 目前越来越多的外国人在上海生活和工作。

en: At the end of August, many students are doing their homework in a hurry.
zh: 在8月底，许多学生在赶作业。

en: When playing basketball, we can enjoy the sunshine and fresh air at the same time.
zh: 打篮球时，我们可以同时享受阳光和新鲜的空气。

en: Willy doesn’t do any housework with his mum at weekends.
zh: 威利周末不跟他妈妈一起做任何家务。

en: I’m at work.
zh: 我正在工作。

en: Success is based on diligence.
zh: 成功是建立在勤奋的基础上的。

en: If you save a few coins every day, you’ll be able to buy a mobile in a year.
zh: 如果你每天节省几个硬币，你就可以在一年内购买一部手机。

en: Chemistry isn’t very difficult. You needn’t be afraid of it. You can come and ask for help.
zh: 化学不是很难。你不必害怕。你可以来寻求帮助。

en: “Tom, don’t be afraid of speaking in public. You are no longer a small boy,” said Mum.
zh: 妈妈说：“汤姆，不要害怕在公众场合讲话。你不再是个小男孩了。”

en: My father was extremely angry with me when he came back from the parents meeting last week.
zh: 上周父亲开完家长会回来，对我非常生气。

en: Digital life is convenient but we should be aware of its disadvantages.
zh: 数字生活十分便捷，但我们应当意识到它的弊端。

en: It is bad for your health.
zh: 这个对你的健康有害。

en: He was born in Shanghai in 1979.
zh: 他1979年在上海出生。

en: He rarely goes to the gym recently because he is too busy with work.
zh: 他最近工作太忙，很少去健身房。

en: He is busy preparing for the examination.
zh: 他正忙着准备考试。

en: Be careful with this knife, Richard, or you'll hurt yourself.
zh: 理查德，小心这把刀，否则你会伤到自己。

en: His illness is believed to be connected to bad habits.
zh: 他的病被认为与不良习惯有关。

en: What makes you suppose him to be connected with them?
zh: 什么使你想到他和他们有联系？

en: The earth is covered with water.
zh: 地球被水覆盖。

en: The textbooks you're using are different from ours.
zh: 你们使用的课本和我们的不同。

en: The Oriental Pearl TV Tower is familiar to all Shanghai citizens.
zh: 东方明珠电视塔为所有上海市民所熟知。

en: Drivers should be very familiar with the traffic signs and rules.
zh: 司机应该通晓交通标志和规则。

en: This restaurant is famous for serving dishes in a romantic way.
zh: 这家餐厅以用浪漫的方式呈上菜肴而闻名。

en: Teenagers are very fond of cartoons.
zh: 青少年非常喜欢漫画。

en: The hall is full of people.
zh: 大厅里挤满了人。

en: Tim is good at singing and doing magic, so he is very popular at his friends' parties.
zh: 蒂姆擅长唱歌和变魔术，所以他在朋友的聚会上非常受欢迎。

en: He is poor at Chinese.
zh: 他的语文学科比较差。

en: Steve Jobs was interested in computers when he was very young.
zh: 史蒂夫·乔布斯很年轻时就对电脑感兴趣了。

en: Angel is keen on all kinds of pop music.
zh: 安杰尔喜爱各种流行音乐。

en: If John doesn’t get up immediately, he will be late for the meeting.
zh: 如果约翰不马上起床，他开会将要迟到了。
rewrite: = Unless John gets up immediately, he will be late for the meeting.

en: John, please don’t be late for school again.
zh: 约翰，上学请别再迟到了。
rewrite: = You mustn’t come to school late again, John.

en: Where will the Olympic Park be located?
zh: 奥林匹克公园将建在哪儿？

en: The bakery is located in the new shopping centre.
zh: 这家面包店位于新的购物中心内。

en: His house is located on the edge of the city.
zh: 他的房屋坐落在市区的边缘。

en: The earth is mainly made of iron and silicon and things like that.
zh: 地球主要由铁、硅之类的物质构成。

en: The organisation is made up of ten people.
zh: 这个组织由 10 人组成。

en: Helen’s teacher was so pleased with the great progress she made this term.
zh: 海伦的老师对她这学期取得巨大进步很满意。

en: We are so pleased with what they have done in the Paris Olympic Games.
zh: 我们对他们在巴黎奥运会上的表现很满意。

en: That famous hotel is proud of its spotless rooms, tasty food and good service.
zh: 那家著名的酒店以其一尘不染的房间、美味的食物和优质的服务引以为豪。

en: The order will be ready for delivery next week.
zh: 这批订货将于下周备好待发。

en: A headmaster is the person who is responsible for a school.
zh: 校长是学校的负责人。

en: Alex was satisfied with Julia's honesty.
zh: 亚历克斯对朱丽亚的诚实很满意。

en: We expected them to be more similar to one another.
zh: 我们期望它们彼此间会更相似。

en: One should be strict with oneself.
zh: 一个人应该严格要求自己。

en: The whole conference as totally disorganised and nobody knew where they were supposed to be or what they were supposed to be doing.
zh: 整个会议安排混乱无序，既没人知道该坐哪里，也没人知道该做什么。

en: Louise won the first prize in a maths contest. We were surprised at the news.
zh: 路易斯获得了数学竞赛一等奖。我们对这一消息感到惊讶。

en: I am thankful to you for all this help.
zh: 感谢你的所有帮助。

en: My grandmother used to wash clothes by hand, but now she is used to doing it with the washing machine.
zh: 我的祖母过去常常用手洗衣服，但现在她习惯用洗衣机了。

en: Jenny stays with a Chinese family for two years. Now she's used to the life in China.
zh: 詹妮在一个中国家庭暂住了两年。现在她习惯了在中国的生活。

en: Because of the strong wind, a large number of leaves fell to the ground.
zh: 由于大风，许多树叶掉到了地上。

en: Aunt Liu says these books aren't hers. They belong to the gentleman over there.
zh: 刘阿姨说这些书不是她的。书属于那边那位绅士。

en: It might not seem like a big deal, but it can have an effect on how you see yourself and how others see you.
zh: 这也许并不是什么重要的事情，却可以对你如何看待自己以及他人如何看待你产生影响。

en: Both Rose and Danny went to the car exhibition yesterday.
zh: 罗斯和丹尼昨天都去了汽车展览会。
rewrite: = Rose went to the car exhibition yesterday. Danny went there, too.

en: The virus caused the computer to break down (= stop working).
zh: 病毒导致计算机出故障了。

en: A thief broke into the shop in our neighbourhood last night and stole several expensive items.
zh: 昨晚一个小偷闯进了我们街区的商店，偷走了好几件贵重物品。

en: I go to Beijing by bus/train/plane.
zh: 我乘公共汽车/火车/飞机去北京。

en: Among all the Christmas cards, mine is the best. I made it by myself.
zh: 在所有的圣诞贺卡中，我的圣诞贺卡是最好的。这是我亲手做的。

en: By the way, what time is it?
zh: 顺便问一下，现在几点了？

en: Calm down, there's nothing to worry about.
zh: 你冷静一下，没有什么可焦虑的。

en: Lucy thinks young people can learn how to care for others by keeping pets.
zh: 露西认为，年轻人可以通过养宠物来学习如何照顾他人。

en: I don't much care for sweets.
zh: 我不太喜欢吃糖果。

en: The weather in spring is so changeable that many of us have caught a cold.
zh: 春天的天气多变，我们中有很多人都感冒了。

en: Nothing can make me change my mind.
zh: 什么也不能使我改变主意。

en: I want to check in.
zh: 我想办理登机手续。

en: I come from China.
zh: 我来自中国。

en: Come on!
zh: 快来！

en: I think he will come to no good end.
zh: 我认为他没有好下场。

en: All things will come true if you can become hard-working.
zh: 只要努力，一切都会实现。

en: Several of the members have come up with suggestions of their own.
zh: 有几位成员提出了自己的建议。

en: Computers are used to help us communicate with others easily.
zh: 电脑能帮助我们轻松地与他人进行交流。

en: Lin Lin often communicates with her American friend to practise English.
zh: 琳琳经常通过与她的美国朋友交流来练习英语。
rewrite: = Lin Lin often practises English by communicating with her American friend.

en: She competed with her rival for a prize.
zh: 她为了奖品与对手展开竞争。

en: He never complained about working overtime.
zh: 他从来不抱怨加班。

en: Does the new product consist of four main parts inside?
zh: 这个新产品主要由四部分组成吗？

en: He cut the tree down.
zh: 他把这棵树砍倒了。

en: Why did Jeff cut down the expenses on clothes?
zh: 为什么杰夫减少了在衣服上的花销？

en: You must cut down on sugar to lose weight.
zh: 你必须少吃糖以减轻体重。

en: She spent years dealing with an unsolved case from history.
zh: 她花费数年时间处理了一个未解决的陈年旧案。

en: Would you please tell me how I should deal with it for the time being?
zh: 请您告诉我该怎么处理眼下这件事？
rewrite: = Would you please tell me how to deal with it for the time being?

en: A friend is somebody that we can depend on when we are in trouble.
zh: 朋友是我们在遇到麻烦时可以依靠的人。

en: People are dying of cancer more and more often.
zh: 死于癌症的人越来越多了。

en: Don't do harm to animals.
zh: 别伤害动物。

en: We did our best, but he is still not pleased with us.
zh: 我们尽力了，可他还是对我们不满意。

en: Did the doctors do their best to operate on the wounded?
zh: 这些医生尽最大努力为伤员动手术了吗？

en: Do me a favour and close the window.
zh: 帮我把窗户关上。

en: Can you do some shopping for me?
zh: 你能替我买些东西吗？

en: I wouldn't dream of studying abroad in the near future.
zh: 近期内我不考虑出国留学。

en: They all dressed up to take part in the New Year's party.
zh: 他们都盛装打扮，去参加新年晚会。

en: John and Mary had known each other pretty well before they got married.
zh: 约翰和玛丽结婚前已经相当了解对方了。

en: Miss Green is kind and patient. She always encourages Roddy to put up his hand in her class.
zh: 格林老师和善又耐心。在她的课上她总是鼓励罗迪举手发言。

en: At the yesterday's English Evening, all of us enjoyed ourselves.
zh: 昨天的英语晚会上，我们都玩得很开心。

en: I can fall asleep anytime and anywhere.
zh: 随时随地我都能入睡。

en: He lives far away (from us).
zh: 他住的地方 (离我们) 很远。

en: He helped us to fill in a big gap in our knowledge.
zh: 他帮我们填补了知识上的巨大空白。

en: You can look up the dictionary and find out the meaning of the word.
zh: 你可以查词典找出这个词的意思。

en: We need to focus our efforts on getting the work done.
zh: 我们需要集中精力完成这项工作。

en: For example, the performance of actors and actresses is very important in your film.
zh: 例如，在你的电影中，演员的表现是非常重要的。

en: You can get it for free.
zh: 你可以免费获取。

en: They tasted defeat for the first time.
zh: 他们第一次尝到失败的滋味。

en: She’s staying with her aunt for the time being.
zh: 她暂时住在她姨妈那里。

en: I can see Hieks at the library from time to time.
zh: 我在图书馆有时能看见希克斯。

en: I’m sure you’ll get on well with your classmates if you are kind and friendly to them.
zh: 如果你对同班同学和蔼友好，我敢肯定你会与他们相处融洽的。

en: We should get into the habit of keeping good hours.
zh: 我们应该养成早睡早起的习惯。

en: As soon as he got off the bus, the poor man realized he had left his wallet on it.
zh: 一下车，这个可怜人就意识到他把钱包遗忘在车上了。

en: The bus is coming. Be careful when you get on the bus.
zh: 车来了。上车时小心。

en: Our class teacher asked us if we had got ready for the final exams.
zh: 老师问我们是否已为期末考试做好了准备。

en: Jane gets angry easily. She’d better get rid of it.
zh: 简容易发怒。她最好改掉这个毛病。

en: I never get tired of watching the landscape.
zh: 我对这景色百看不厌。

en: Have we got to the zoo yet?
zh: 我们到动物园了吗？

en: Yesterday morning I got up early so as not to be late for the exam.
zh: 为了考试不迟到，昨天早上我很早起床。

en: The youth gave me his hand when I was lifting my baggage.
zh: 当我正要提起行李时，那个年轻人帮了我。

en: Never giving up is certainly one of the key factors for the old man’s achievement.
zh: 永不放弃无疑是这位老人取得成就的关键因素之一。

en: Cross the street and go ahead.
zh: 过马路，一直往前走。

en:
— Do you mind if I open the window?
— Not at all. Go ahead.
zh:
你介意我开窗吗？
完全不会，你开吧。

en: I go to the gym for a swim.
zh: 我去健身房游泳。

en: They may go hiking around the island, or swimming in the ocean.
zh: 他们可以环岛徒步旅行或在海里游泳。

en: After the movie, we went home.
zh: 看完电影，我们就回家了。

en: Which events is he going in for at the Olympics?
zh: 他将在奥运会上参加什么项目？

en: They wanted me to go in for film work.
zh: 他们要我从事电影工作。

en: Many people go in for golf.
zh: 许多人喜欢打高尔夫球。

en: Now (that) he is well again, he can go on with his English study.
zh: 现在他既已恢复了健康，就可以继续学习英语了。

en: Maybe you need to go on a diet.
zh: 或许你应当节食了。

en: Mr. Smith will go on a picnic this Saturday unless the weather is bad.
zh: 史密斯先生将于本周六去野餐，除非天气不好去不了。

en: They went on with their basketball match in spite of the rain.
zh: 他们冒雨继续进行篮球比赛。

en: He went on reading the text.
zh: 他继续读这篇课文。

en: The concert lasted only a few minutes before the power went out.
zh: 音乐会只持续了几分钟就停电了。

en: You may fail to pass the examination unless you do your best to go over the lessons.
zh: 除非你尽力复习，否则你可能无法通过考试。

en: I want to go sailing to relax myself.
zh: 我想去航海放松一下。

en: Since the rain has stopped, why not go shopping now?
zh: 现在既然雨停了，为什么不去购物呢？

en: Did you go sightseeing last Sunday?
zh: 上星期天你是否去观光游览了？

en: It is time for me to go to bed.
zh: 我睡觉的时间到了。

en: I would like all my children to go to college.
zh: 我希望我的孩子们都考上大学。

en: How do you go to school?
zh: 你怎么去上学？

en: I am too excited to go to sleep.
zh: 我太兴奋了，睡不着。

en: She wished to go to the cinema/movie(s) yesterday.
zh: 她昨天想去看电影。

en: After feeling unwell for several days, John decided to go to the hospital.
zh: 难受了几天，约翰决定还是去医院看一下。

en: Your computer will go wrong without any anti-virus software.
zh: 你的电脑没有任何杀毒软件会出问题的。

en: Children must be educated to serve their country when they grow up.
zh: 必须教育孩子长大后为国家效力。

en: You'd better eat a healthy diet, and more importantly, do exercise regularly.
zh: 你最好养成健康的饮食习惯，更重要的是，定期做运动。

en: You had better not forget to bring a power bank when you travel.
zh: 你去旅行最好不要忘了带充电宝。

en: What a disappointing excuse you've made when failing to hand in your project on time!
zh: 你没能按时交项目，找的借口太让人失望了！

en: We happened to discover that we had a friend in common.
zh: 我们碰巧发现我们有一个共同的朋友。

en: An odd thing happened to him this morning.
zh: 他今天早晨遇到一件怪事。

en: I'm afraid I must be going now. I have a class at ten.
zh: 我想我现在得走了。我10点有课。

en: You have eight lessons every day, don't you?
zh: 你每天有8节课，不是吗？

en: We had a very good time at the evening party.
zh: 我们在晚会上玩得很愉快。

en: Peter doesn’t have breakfast at school every day.
zh: 彼得不是每天都在学校用早餐的。

en: I have no idea what to do.
zh: 我不知道该怎么办。

en: I always have pity on the beggars.
zh: 我总是对乞丐心怀怜悯。

en: Does he have sports every day?
zh: 他每天运动吗？

en: You’ve got to come.
zh: 你必须来。

en: I hear from her every week.
zh: 我每星期都能收到她的来信。

en: I heard of his death last week.
zh: 我上周听说了他的死讯。

en: Jane will help me with the maths problem.
zh: 简将帮助我做数学题。

en: We went here and there looking for berries.
zh: 我们四处寻找浆果。

en: We’ll hold a meeting to exchange experiences.
zh: 我们将开个会来交流一下经验。

en: Could you please hold on?
zh: 请别挂电话好吗？

en: I can hold my breath for about one minute.
zh: 我大约可以憋气一分钟。

en: They have huge amounts of money.
zh: 他们很有钱。

en: Please dress up in a hurry!
zh: 请快点打扮！

en: The English teacher isn’t here. She has gone to the office and she will be back in a minute.
zh: 英语老师不在这里。她已经去了办公室，一会儿就回来。

en: In addition, you can get to know a circle of people at your age while playing sports.
zh: 另外，在运动时，你可以认识一群同龄人。

en: There are fifteen books on the first shelf, twenty-one on the second, that makes thirty-six in all.
zh: 书架的第一层有 15 本书，第二层有 21 本书，总共是 36 本书。

en: In brief, my hometown is a place which is worthy of being visited.
zh: 简而言之，我的家乡是一个值得游览的地方。

en: The teacher is in charge of the class.
zh: 这位教师负责这个班。

en: Tom pays attention in class.
zh: 汤姆上课非常专心。

en: Did the Red Cross provide any medical services to the victims in danger?
zh: 红十字会是否为处于危险中的受害者提供医疗服务？

en: He wrote a report in English yesterday.
zh: 昨天他用英语写了一份报告。

en: In fact, he has gone abroad.
zh: 事实上，他出国了。

en: Are you in favour of this plan?
zh: 你赞成这个计划吗？

en: Jane felt nervous when she made her first speech in front of the whole school.
zh: 当简在全校师生面前第一次演讲时，她感到紧张。

en: He was in hospital in Washington.
zh: 他在华盛顿住院了。

en: Professor Brown is still very active and enjoys hiking even though he is already in his fifties.
zh: 尽管布郎教授已经 50 多岁了，他仍然非常活跃，喜欢徒步旅行。

en: In my opinion he is not right.
zh: 在我看来，他是错的。

en: Jack provided some more evidence in order to prove his point.
zh: 杰克提供了更多证据来证明自己的观点。

en: He became, in other words, a great hero.
zh: 换句话说，他成了一位伟大的英雄。

en: What did you give him in return?
zh: 你给他什么作为报答呢？

en: Are you surprised when someone looks at you in surprise?
zh: 当有人惊异地看着你时，你感到惊讶吗？

en: In the end, Tom successfully fixed his bicycle without the help of his father.
zh: 最后，汤姆没靠爸爸帮忙，成功修好了他的自行车。

en: He does not know what will happen in the future.
zh: 他不知道将来会发生什么事。

en: He positioned the lamp in the middle of the table.
zh: 他把灯放在桌子中间。

en: The book was banned in the past.
zh: 这本书过去是禁书。

en: What makes him behave in this way?
zh: 是什么原因使他这样做的？

en: You must hurry up or you cannot finish it in time.
zh: 你必须抓紧些，否则你来不及完成。

en: The young policeman always helps the old when they are in trouble.
zh: 这个年轻警察在老人有困难时总会帮助他们。

en: Lin Dong should learn to solve problems by himself instead of asking others.
zh: 林东应该学会独自解决问题，而不是求助别人。

en: The experienced detective never jumps to a conclusion when dealing with a new case.
zh: 这位经验丰富的侦探处理新案件时从不草率下结论。

en: Oh, my goodness. I left my dictionary in the reading-room just now.
zh: 啊，天哪！我刚才把词典忘在阅览室里了。

en: I want to keep a diary, but I can't.
zh: 我想记日记，可我做不到。

en: The machine kept running.
zh: 机器一直在运转。

en: I practise yoga to keep fit.
zh: 我练瑜伽来保持健康。

en: I don’t want to keep you from your work.
zh: 我不想耽误你的工作。

en: How does Jack keep in touch with his friends in America every week?
zh: 杰克每周是如何与美国朋友保持联系的？

en: The policeman told the boys to keep off the grass.
zh: 警察告诉男孩们勿踩草地。

en: If you won’t keep quiet, you can get out!
zh: 如果你不保持安静，那就只好请你出去了！

en: That job will keep you busy for a long time.
zh: 那项工作会使你忙碌很长时间。

en: It’s impolite to laugh at people in trouble.
zh: 嘲笑处于困境中的人们是不礼貌的。

en: The girl came in and laid the table for supper.
zh: 女孩进来，把桌子摆好准备吃晚饭。

en: She learned everything from me.
zh: 她什么都是向我学的。

en: May I leave a message, please?
zh: 请问，我可以留个口信吗？

en: I’ll leave for Beijing tomorrow.
zh: 我明天动身去北京。

en: I had to seek a living before I left secondary school.
zh: 我中学没毕业就去谋生了。

en: The production of this factory is less than that of that factory.
zh: 这个工厂的产量少于那个工厂。

en: He did more than the rest of us did together.
zh: 他做的比我们其余人合在一起做的还要多。

en: I'm talking to you, Jack. Please listen to me carefully.
zh: 杰克，我在跟你说话，请仔细听我讲。

en: She still lives on her parents.
zh: 她仍依靠父母生活。

en: Most of Asians live on rice.
zh: 多数亚洲人以大米为主食。

en: As middle school students, we should know how to look after ourselves.
zh: 作为中学生，我们应该知道如何照顾自己。

en: The pupils are all looking at the chart on the wall.
zh: 学生都瞧着墙上的图表。

en: Her sister wanted to further her study instead of looking for a job.
zh: 她妹妹想要继续深造，而不是找工作。

en: Little Adam is looking forward to meeting his friend next week.
zh: 小亚当期待下周见到他的小伙伴。

en: He looks like a scholar.
zh: 他看上去像个学者。

en: The police reminded the public to look out for pickpockets in crowded areas.
zh: 警方提醒公众在拥挤区域要提防扒手。

en: You'd better not look up every new word in the dictionary because you can guess it from the context.
zh: 你最好不要用词典去查每一个新词，因为你能从上下文中猜到它的意思。

en: He had to look up to see the top of the skyscraper.
zh: 他不得不抬头才能看到摩天大楼的顶部。

en: He didn't want to lose his life in the battle field.
zh: 他不想在战场上送命。

en: If you don't take the map with you, you may lose your way to Shanghai Museum.
zh: 如果不带上这张地图，你去上海博物馆可能会迷路。
rewrite: = Take the map with you, and you can find the way to Shanghai Museum.

en: Father lost temper after he was told his daughter stole a mobile phone from her deskmate.
zh: 父亲得知女儿偷了她同桌的手机后，大发脾气。

en: Danny has decided to go on a diet because he wants to lose weight.
zh: 丹尼决定节食，因为他想减肥。

en: You can make a decision right now. You can also think it over for a couple of days.
zh: 你可以现在就做决定，也可以再考虑几天。

en: They want to make a film in Shanghai.
zh: 他们想在上海拍电影。

en: Then we started to make a fire.
zh: 然后我们开始生火。

en: He makes a living by writing.
zh: 他以写作为生。

en: Tom's father looked angrily at Tom because he had made so many mistakes.
zh: 父亲生气地看着汤姆，因为他犯了那么多错误。

en: If you make a noise, you'll scare off the animals.
zh: 如果你弄出声响就会把动物吓跑。

en: Nobody likes to make friends with dishonest people.
zh: 没有人喜欢与不诚实的人交朋友。

en: We should not make fun of the weak.
zh: 我们不应该取笑弱者。

en: We begin to consistently make money.
zh: 我们开始持续地盈利。

en: It's nice of Andy to help me with my English and I've made some progress.
zh: 安迪真好，他帮我学英语。我已经取得了一些进步。

en: Please make sure the door is securely locked before you go to bed.
zh: 睡前请务必确认门已经牢牢地锁好。

en: Does she make the bed in the morning?
zh: 她早上整理床铺吗？

en: They made up their minds to sell the house.
zh: 他们决定把房子卖掉。

en: He forgot the charger for his mobile phone.
zh: 他忘了带手机充电器。

en: I sat next to a girl whose name was Diane.
zh: 我坐在一个名叫黛安的女孩旁边。

en: Tom, you are no longer a little boy. You should learn to be independent.
zh: 汤姆，你不再是一个小男孩了。你应该学会独立。
rewrite: = Tom, you are not a little boy any longer. You should learn to be independent.

en: He is not worried at all.
zh: 他一点都不担心。

en: Now and then we heard shots in the woods.
zh: 我们不时听到从森林里传来的枪声。

en: He was quite polite, of course, but somehow I didn't like his manner.
zh: 当然，他相当有礼貌，但我就是有点儿不喜欢他的举止。

en:
— May I come with you to see Swan Lake?
— Yes, of course.
zh:
——我可以和你一起去看《天鹅湖》吗？
——当然可以。

en: How many times do you dine out per week on average?
zh: 你每星期通常下几次馆子？

en: Has he gone to Paris on business or for pleasure?
zh: 他去巴黎是出差还是游玩？

en: Today they came here on foot.
zh: 今天他们是步行过来的。
rewrite: = Today they walked here.

en: I'm on holiday next week.
zh: 我下周休假。

en: I wish she would be on my side.
zh: 我希望她能站在我这边。

en: He is naughty, but on the other hand, he is clever.
zh: 他是调皮，但另一方面，他很聪明。

en: You are wanted on the phone.
zh: 有人打电话找你。

en: There is little bread in my fridge. Please buy some on your way home.
zh: 冰箱里没有面包了，请你在回家的路上买一些。

en: Remember to take the pills I gave you on time, one at a time.
zh: 记得按时服用我给你的药，一次一片。

en: The office is open from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. on weekdays.
zh: 办事处工作日从上午 9 点到下午 5 点开放。

en: Olympic is held once every four years.
zh: 奥运会每四年举办一次。

en: I'll repeat the question once more.
zh: 我把这个问题再重复一次。

en: They went into the classroom one after another.
zh: 他们一个接一个地走进教室。

en: She went out of the room, taking the flowers with her.
zh: 她带着花走出了房间。

en: A few of the tanks had run out of ammunition.
zh: 有几辆坦克的弹药已经用光了。

en: This kind of machine is out of date.
zh: 这种机器过时了。

en: He performed his experiment over and over, working till midnight.
zh: 他一次次地进行实验直到深夜。

en: The teacher told the student to pay attention to his spelling.
zh: 老师提醒那个学生要注意拼写。

en: How much did you pay for the book?
zh: 那本书你付了多少钱？

en: Let's pick out the bad potatoes from the basket.
zh: 我们把坏掉的土豆从篮子里挑出来吧。

en: I picked up your book by mistake.
zh: 我错拿了你的书。

en: Watching the old man, she was going to play a trick on him.
zh: 观察了一下这个老人，她决定捉弄他一把。

en: The kid was playing with his ball.
zh: 这个孩子在玩球。

en: She had plenty of imagination.
zh: 她有丰富的想象力。

en: He pointed out that there was little chance of success.
zh: 他指出成功的机会很少。

en: The teacher praised him highly for his honesty.
zh: 老师大大地表扬了他的诚实。

en: I prefer chemistry to physics.
zh: 我喜欢化学甚于物理。

en: I prefer staying at home to going outside on a wet day.
zh: 下雨天我宁愿待在家里，也不愿外出。

en: The students in our school are busy preparing for our School Art Festival.
zh: 我们学校的学生正忙着准备学校的艺术节。

en: All of us should try to keep fit and prevent ourselves from eating too much.
zh: 我们大家应该努力保持健康，避免吃得过多。

en: Nobody can prevent him from running the risk.
zh: 没有人能够阻止他去冒险。

en: Trees should be well protected from the cold during winter.
zh: 冬天要保护好树木以防冻坏。

en: This restaurant provides customers with various food choices.
zh: 这家餐厅为顾客提供各种各样的美食选择。

en: We've decided to put off the spring outing till next week because of the bad weather.
zh: 因为天气不好，我们已经决定将春游推迟到下周。

en: Please put on your jacket.
zh: 请穿上夹克衫。

en: A film will be put on.
zh: 电影即将上映。

en: The firemen fought bravely and put out the forest fire in the end.
zh: 消防队员英勇奋战，最终扑灭了森林大火。

en: Please put up your hand if you have any questions.
zh: 谁有问题，请举手。

en: We'd better put up a notice here.
zh: 我们最好在这儿贴一张通知。

en: We often refer to these books in our work.
zh: 我们工作中经常参考这些书。

en: Being independent means believing in yourself without relying on others.
zh: 独立意味着相信自己，不依赖他人。

en: When I saw a wolf, I ran away.
zh: 当我看见狼时，拔腿就跑。

en: We have run out of petrol.
zh: 我们的汽油已用完。

en: He wanted to save her life at all cost.
zh: 他要不惜一切代价挽救她的生命。

en: They searched all the drawers for the missing paper.
zh: 他们翻了所有的抽屉找寻那份遗失的文件。

en: I will see you off at the railway station.
zh: 我会去火车站送你。

en: The shop sold out all its shirts.
zh: 那家商店的衬衫都卖光了。

en: Set out early, or you won’t reach your hometown before midnight.
zh: 早点出发，否则你午夜前到不了家乡。

en: The government has set out to make many needed reforms.
zh: 政府着手进行诸多必要的改革。

en: He warmly shook hands with those customers around the table.
zh: 他与坐在周围的客户热情握手。

en: Nowadays many people share photos with their friends on the internet.
zh: 现在很多人在互联网上和他们的朋友分享自己的照片。

en: Could you tell me the way to the shopping mall?
zh: 你能告诉我去购物中心怎么走吗？

en: She likes to show herself off.
zh: 她喜欢自我炫耀。

en: Before you start to work, I’ll show you around the factory.
zh: 开始工作前，我先领你参观一下工厂。

en: I wish she would shut up!
zh: 她要是闭嘴该多好！

en: So far neither of the parcels I sent has arrived yet.
zh: 到目前为止，我寄的两个包裹都还没到。

en: Speak louder so that everyone in the meeting room can hear you clearly.
zh: 请你大声点，以便会议室的每个人都能清楚地听到你的讲话。

en: In social studies, students learn about the relations of people in a country.
zh: 在社会研究中，学生可以了解一个国家中人与人之间的关系。

en: We will meet again some day.
zh: 我们后会有期。

en: The police will find him sooner or later.
zh: 警方早晚会找到他的。

en: What does N.E. stand for?
zh: N.E. 这两个字母代表的是什么呢？

en: Unluckily, my laptop crashed last night, so I had to stay up late to rewrite the report.
zh: 不幸的是，我的笔记本电脑昨晚死机了，所以我不得不熬夜重写这份报告。

en: AIDS is a kind of dangerous disease. Actions must be taken to stop it from spreading.
zh: 艾滋病是一种危险的疾病。必须采取行动阻止它蔓延。

en: We dislike people such as him.
zh: 我们不喜欢像他这样的人。

en: I seldom watch TV. But I always surf the internet on weekends.
zh: 我很少看电视。但周末我总是上网。

en: You ought to open your eyes and take a look at reality.
zh: 你应该睁开眼睛去看看现实。

en: Can I take a message for him?
zh: 我能替您给他捎个口信吗？

en: We must take action to keep up with new developments.
zh: 我们必须采取行动来跟上新的发展形势。

en: We had no choice but to take an underground to make it on time.
zh: 为了准时赶到，我们不得不坐地铁。

en: The teacher didn't leave until all the students were taken away by their parents.
zh: 直到所有的学生都被他们父母接走，老师才离开。

en: You needn't worry about your son. He can take care of himself.
zh: 你不必担心你的儿子。他会照顾自己。

en: The policeman said he would take charge of the gun.
zh: 那位警察说他负责看管这支枪。

en: She took hold of his hand.
zh: 她握住他的手。

en: We should take notes in class.
zh: 我们上课应该记笔记。

en: Please take off your coat. It's very hot inside the room.
zh: 请脱下外衣。房间里非常热。

en: The plane took off on time.
zh: 飞机准时起飞。

en: I will take your advice.
zh: 我会听从你的劝告。

en: I take out my glasses from my bag.
zh: 我从包里取出眼镜。

en: I don't think he will come and take part in the meeting, will he?
zh: 我认为他不会来参加会议，他会来吗？

en: Twelve students will take part in the final of the memory competition.
zh: 12 名学生将参加这场记忆大赛的决赛。

en: The accident took place on the fifth day of their journey.
zh: 事故发生在他们旅程的第五天。

en: Most people were sleeping when the big earthquake took place in that area.
zh: 大地震发生时，那个地区的大部分人正在睡梦中。

en: He will take the place of you and go to the meeting.
zh: 他将替你去开会。

en: The lady took up dancing as a hobby in her sixties, and she is really good at it now.
zh: 这位女士 60 多岁开始把跳舞作为一种爱好，现在她的舞确实跳得很好。

en: We talked about what to do.
zh: 我们谈到了该怎么办。

en: Since she joined the sports club, she has become very active and enjoys meeting and talking to others.
zh: 自从加入体育俱乐部，她就变得很活跃并且喜欢聚会，喜欢与其他人交谈。

en: Some teenagers don't like to talk with their parents, but I am different from them. I love to talk with my parents.
zh: 一些青少年不喜欢跟他们的父母交谈，但我与他们不同。我喜欢跟我的父母交谈。

en: Can you tell her from her twin sister?
zh: 你能分辨她和她的双胞胎妹妹吗？

en: It is wrong to tell a lie.
zh: 撒谎是不对的。

en: He works in the same workshop as I do.
zh: 他和我在同一个车间干活。

en: He'll return to London the week after next.
zh: 他将于下下周返回伦敦。

en: I will think about your suggestion.
zh: 我会考虑你的建议。

en: Will you think of me after I've left?
zh: 我离开之后，你会想我吗？

en: Henry, think over your major choice before making your decision.
zh: 亨利，做决定前仔细考虑一下你的专业选择。

en: What a waste to throw it away!
zh: 扔掉它多浪费！

en: To my great joy, my lost watch was found.
zh: 让我极为高兴的是，我那块丢失的手表找到了。

en: To my surprise, he could work out the problem alone.
zh: 令我吃惊的是，他能自己解决这个问题。
rewrite: = I was surprised that he could work out the problem by himself.

en: Mrs. Brown was too old to walk upstairs to the twelfth floor of the building.
zh: 布朗夫人年纪太大，以至于爬不到这幢大楼的 12 层。

en: As a tour guide, it's important to be knowledgeable about the local culture and landmarks.
zh: 作为一名导游，了解当地文化和地标很重要。

en: I'd like to try on that blue wool coat.
zh: 我想试穿那件蓝色的羊毛外套。

en: “Turn down the radio, Jim. It's too noisy.” said his grandfather.
zh: “把收音机音量调低，吉姆。太吵了。”他的祖父说。

en: If you are cold, you can turn the heater up.
zh: 如果你觉得冷，你可以把暖气开大。

en: He finds it easier to memorise information by turning it into a song.
zh: 他发现把信息编成歌曲会更容易记忆。

en: When you leave your classroom, remember to turn off the lights.
zh: 当你离开教室时，记得关灯。

en: Don't turn on the MP3 too loud. It's bad for your ears.
zh: 不要把 MP3 开得太大声。对你的耳朵不好。

en: I imagined solving the problem easily, but it turned out to be much harder.
zh: 我原本以为能轻松解决这个问题，结果却困难得多。

en: It turns out that he was right.
zh: 最后证明他是对的。

en: Turn over, or your back will get sunburnt.
zh: 翻过身去，不然你的后背要被阳光灼伤的。

en: He used to be a good movie director but nowadays he is only busy making money.
zh: 他曾经是一位很好的电影导演，但现在他只忙着赚钱。

en: Although Edward is over seventy, he still walks as fast as he used to.
zh: 虽然爱德华 70 多岁了，但他仍然和过去一样走得很快。

en: Sarah used to ride a bike to work, but now she drives.
zh: 莎拉过去经常骑车去上班，但现在她开车去。

en: He had to wait for a few months for the visa to come through.
zh: 他必须等待几个月才能获得签证。

en: In the early morning, Jerry woke up to the pleasant smell of the food on the table.
zh: 清晨，杰瑞被桌上食物的诱人香味唤醒。

en: What's more, we became good friends.
zh: 而且我们变成了好朋友。

en: You must use this instrument with great care.
zh: 这种仪器使用时必须非常小心。

en: I will help you with pleasure.
zh: 我很乐意帮助你。

en: I read English magazines with the help of a dictionary.
zh: 我借助词典翻阅英文杂志。

en: With the help of them, we could finish the work in time.
zh: 在他们的帮助下，我们能够按时完成这项工作。
rewrite: = They helped us so much that we could finish the work in time.

en: Jessica worked out/dealt with/solved the physics problems without any help.
zh: 在没有任何帮助的情况下，杰西卡解出了这道物理题。

en: It wasn't too long before we had worked out a plan acceptable to all.
zh: 没多久我们就制订出一个大家都能接受的计划。

en: You really don't have to worry about your weight. You look just right.
zh: 真的，你不必担心你的体重。你看起来正好。

en: Would you like/love to go somewhere?
zh: 你想要去个什么地方吗？

en: They would rather use the colour like orange because it's much brighter than others.
zh: 他们宁愿使用像橙色这种颜色，因为它比别的颜色鲜艳。
